Head of Solutions Architecture and Sales Engineering — AI / GPU Cloud (NeoCloud) - CONFIDENTIAL
Reports to:
CBO Team:
People-leader for a team of Sales Engineers / Solutions Architects (player-coach at hire, scaling to full leader) Location:
[Remote / Hybrid — primary hubs TBD] · Some travel to customer sites, data centers, and NVIDIA GTC / partner events

Why this role exists

Our product is the orchestration layer that turns raw, disaggregated GPU infrastructure into a multi-tenant, production-ready AI cloud — without locking companies into a single hyperscaler or hardware vendor. We sell accelerated compute: GPU clusters, bare metal, and managed AI infrastructure to Neoclouds, AI-native startups, enterprise AI teams, research labs, and sovereign/regulated buyers. These are technical, high-value, long-cycle deals where the sale is won or lost on credibility: whether we can architect the right cluster, model the real TCO, prove performance, and de-risk a customer's move onto our platform.

This person owns the technical win. They build and lead the sales engineering function that turns "interested" into signed, multi-year committed-capacity contracts, and they set the
pre-sales bar as we scale headcount and deal volume.

This is not a demo-jockey role. We need someone who has genuinely stood up training and inference workloads, argued interconnect topology with a customer's ML infra lead, and closed large deals with cycles measured in quarters, not weeks.

What you'll own

Lead and build the SE / Solutions Architect team

Hire, coach, and retain a team of sales engineers and solutions architects; define the presales operating model as the org scales.
Build the reusable machinery: discovery frameworks, reference architectures, TCO/benchmark models, POV playbooks, demo and benchmark environments, RFP response libraries.
Set and hold a technical quality bar across the team; run enablement so every SE can speak credibly to GPU architecture, networking, and orchestration.

Own the technical win in large, complex deals

Partner with Account Executives as the technical lead on strategic and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.
Run qualification with a real methodology (MEDDPICC or equivalent) — surface the economic buyer, decision criteria, and the technical champion, and build the win plan around them.
Architect solutions across compute, networking, storage, and orchestration; produce sizing, capacity plans, and TCO comparisons vs. hyperscalers and selfbuild.
Design and drive POCs/POVs: define success criteria up front, run benchmarks, and convert results into commercial momentum.

Be the technical voice of the customer internally

Feed structured product and capacity requirements back to product, platform, and supply/capacity planning.
Work alongside the NVIDIA field and partner ecosystem (Cloud Partner program, reference architectures, joint pursuits) to strengthen deals.
Influence roadmap and packaging based on what you learn in the field.

Must-have qualifications

Real, hands-on AI/ML infrastructure experience

You have actually run or stood up ML workloads — distributed training and/or production inference — not just talked about them.
Practical fluency in the training and inference lifecycle: data pipelines, distributed training (multinode/multi-GPU), fine-tuning, and serving; you understand where bottlenecks actually live (interconnect, memory bandwidth, I/O, scheduling).
Comfortable in the frameworks and tooling customers use — PyTorch and the surrounding ecosystem (e.g., NCCL, CUDAlevel concepts, containers, schedulers).

Deep knowledge of the NVIDIA platform and GPU products

Current on the NVIDIA compute stack across the Hopper and Blackwell generations (e.g., H100/H200, GB200 NVL72 / B200class systems, GraceHopper superchips) and the referencesystem families (DGX, HGX, MGX); aware of what's coming next-generation.

Networking fluency: NVLink/NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand (Quantum) vs. SpectrumX Ethernet fabrics, RDMA/RoCE, DPUs — and why fabric choice makes or breaks large training clusters.
Software and platform layer: NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM, NeMo, Triton / TensorRTLLM, Base Command, Run:ai / GPU orchestration, and the NGC ecosystem.
Understands the NVIDIA Cloud Partner motion and how to cosell with NVIDIA.

Enterprise sales engineering on long, high-value cycles

Track record supporting complex B2B deals with cycles of 6–18+ months and large ACV/TCV, ideally including multiyear committed-capacity or reserved-capacity structures.
Skilled at multistakeholder navigation — ML/infra leads, platform engineering, procurement, finance, security, and executive sponsors.
Can build and defend a TCO/ROI model against hyperscaler and onprem alternatives, and translate performance benchmarks into commercial value.

Proven team leadership

Has hired, developed, and led a sales engineering / solutions architecture team (or clearly demonstrated the readiness to), including building process and enablement from a light or greenfield starting point.
Playercoach mindset: still credible in the room on the hardest deals, while scaling others to do the same.

Strongly preferred
Experience selling GPU cloud, HPC, or specialized infrastructure — ideally at a NeoCloud / GPUcloud provider, hyperscaler AI org, or acceleratedhardware vendor.
Handson with cloud-native and cluster orchestration for AI: Kubernetes (and GPU operators / device plugins), Slurm, and multicluster management approaches; familiarity with virtualized GPU / KubeVirtstyle patterns is a plus.
Storagefor-AI literacy — highthroughput parallel/object storage and its role in training pipelines.
Experience with data center economics and constraints: power, cooling, rack density, and how capacity availability shapes deals.
Exposure to sovereign, regulated, or government AI buyers.

You will be responsible for guiding matrixed teams to own the end-to-end lifecycle of Labs solutions and Security Review operational processes—from identifying critical market gaps to scaling adoption across the Trailblazer ecosystem. Strategic Guidance & Ecosystem Governance

Multi-Year Roadmap Advisory: Set and champion the 2–3 year strategic vision for the Labs portfolio, ensuring close alignment with core corporate initiatives and platform releases.
Executive GM Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to Cloud GMs and Product Management teams on Labs investment strategies, retirements, and how the portfolio drives ecosystem value.
Cross-Functional Influence: Build and maintain highly durable, collaborative partnerships across matrixed organizations, including Legal, Product Security, Marketing, Solution Engineering, and Trailblazer Community teams.

Security Review Program & Operations

Product Security Partnership: Act as the primary operational liaison to the Product Security team to co-design ecosystem security programs, review methodologies, and compliance frameworks.
Escalation Management: Serve as the designated lead for high-priority partner security escalations, unblocking technical reviews and resolving critical vulnerabilities with executive stakeholders.
Commercial Fee Architecture: Own the business and operational strategy for the Security Review fee structure, balancing ecosystem growth with program cost-recovery objectives.
Ecosystem Security Guardrails: Partner deeply with Product Managers and Product Security to optimize the technical baseline, significantly reducing the cycle time for complex ISV and Labs solutions to clear the AgentExchange Security Review.

AI-Accelerated Program Architecture

AI Tooling & Automation Strategy: Architect and own the AgentExchange Security & Labs AI-tooling roadmap to automate highly repetitive operational processes and scale ecosystem programs.
Advanced Content Automation: Lead the strategy for leveraging generative AI to build "Content-in-a-Box" deployment kits (including demo scripts, technical blog posts, and enablement decks), maintaining strict brand voice while shortening go-to-market timelines.

Data-Driven Insights & Reporting

Executive Narratives: Synthesize complex data regarding program health—such as install rates, user reviews, security posture, failure reasons, and platform adoption—into compelling, executive-level health reports for senior leadership.
Data Synthesis at Scale: Direct the harmonization of large, disparate datasets into clear, actionable, executive-ready "sources of truth" dashboards.
Strategic Lifecycle Actions: Translate ecosystem telemetry into definitive operational recommendations, such as sunsetting underperforming solutions or doubling down on trending technical categories.

Ecosystem Engagement & Thought Leadership

Public Representation: Present as a trusted platform expert at major community events and conferences (e.g., Dreamforce, World Tours, Community Dreamin’ events), demonstrating the "Art of the Possible" using Labs solutions.
Demand Generation Strategy: Coordinate with Marketing teams to drive visibility, organic demand, and community engagement for high-impact Labs solutions via social channels and the Trailblazer network.

Required Experience & Qualifications

10+ Years of Leadership: Extensive experience in program management, technical product management, or GTM strategy within a high-growth SaaS enterprise.
Proven Influence Without Authority: Documented success leading massive, cross-functional matrixed initiatives and aligning executive stakeholders up to the SVP/EVP level without direct reports.
Security Program Experience: Strong background navigating complex software security reviews, managing high-stakes client/partner escalations, or designing program operational structures.
AI & Automation Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience embedding LLM/AI workflows into business operational workflows to compress cycle times or scale organizational output, backed by measurable lift metrics.
Salesforce Ecosystem Expertise: Deep architectural and conceptual familiarity with the Salesforce platform (Admin, Developer, and Architect personas), AgentExchange, and the Trailblazer ecosystem.
Preferred Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform Developer I, and Platform Developer II.

Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

to support the Army Research Laboratory (ARL) Information Technology Modernization and Support Services program in Adelphi, Maryland.

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About The Role

Join our dynamic, fast-growing fintech company that's revolutionizing financial services through technology. As Director of Engineering, you will be a senior leader responsible for shaping the vision and execution of our engineering organization and drive innovation and operational excellence across our critical systems. You will be responsible for solution architecture for critical business initiatives, including expansion of new products while driving a culture of engineering quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. Partnering with other engineering managers, you will align technology initiatives with our ambitious growth strategy, ensuring our platforms remain robust, scalable, and secure.

If you are passionate about building and scaling high-performance financial infrastructure and aligning technology execution with business outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a transformational impact on the future of our brokerage platform.

What You’ll Do

Architectural Excellence: Oversee the design and development of scalable, resilient, and secure systems, leveraging modern architectures such as microservices, API-driven, and event-driven designs
Platform & Partner Account Architecture: Lead solution architecture for sub-account and partner-level ledger capabilities, enabling multi-tenant account structuring across the brokerage platform
Execute the Strategic Vision for the Brokerage Platform: Deliver critical business-driven products and enhancements across multiple asset classes and other product features. Experience with Digital Assets, Options or Reg-T Margin is a huge plus
Core Platform Development: Contribute to the development of architecture framework, common libraries, developer tools to improve developer velocity
AI/Automation: Identify and execute opportunities to embed Agentic AI/automation in business processes and products
Team Empowerment: Lead, mentor, and expand high-performing engineering team(s), fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and other senior leaders to prioritize initiatives and deliver mission-critical solutions on schedule
Operational Mastery: Champion best practices in agile development, CI/CD, automated testing, and proactive monitoring to ensure 24x7 operational excellence and regulatory compliance
Innovation & Quality: Drive the adoption of cutting-edge technologies including AI and methodologies that optimize performance, reduce costs, and enhance system reliability

You Bring

Extensive Experience: 12+ years in engineering leadership, with a proven track record of scaling engineering team(s) in fast-paced, technology-driven environments
Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge in architecting and implementing high-availability, scalable systems, including microservices, API-driven, and event-driven architectures using Java, Kafka, SQL/No SQL databases
Cloud & Container Proficiency: Significant experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)
Brokerage Experience in B2B setting: A solid understanding of financial services technology, particularly within brokerage platforms in a B2B setting;
Communication Skills: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a knack for fostering strong stakeholder relationships and cross-functional collaboration
Innovative Mindset: A passion for solving complex problems and a relentless drive to push technological boundaries while balancing strategic vision with day-to-day execution
Expertise in advanced architectural patterns and distributed systems
Experience modernizing legacy systems and driving cost optimization within capital markets or financial services

Special Knowledge (Nice To Have, But Not Required)

Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) for scaling agile practices across large organizations
Deep knowledge of brokerage operations, digital assets including margin, clearing, settlements, and regulatory compliance
Hands-on experience with the mind set of rolling up sleeves as needed

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York, NY - Hybrid

If based in New York: This role is expected to come into the office 3 days a week on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time

Pay Range
: $250,000 - $280,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Job Description

The Director, Software Engineering
will lead Reuters' content management systems engineering organization, with direct responsibility for the platform underpinning content creation, editorial workflows, and publishing on Reuters.com. Reporting to the VP, Software Engineering, this leader will direct the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of Reuters' CMS platform through a major transition, building and leading the engineering, editorial-tooling, and delivery teams responsible for its day-to-day operation and long-term evolution.

This is a hands-on leadership role: the Director is expected to act as a principal engineer when needed, providing direct technical guidance on both front-end and back-end challenges, not just organizational oversight. This leadership position will shape the technical roadmap for Reuters' CMS platform, translating editorial and business requirements into a scalable, reliable architecture.

The ideal candidate will build and lead a high-performing engineering organization spanning platform engineering, editorial tooling, and delivery operations, while establishing the standards, processes, and talent needed to support Reuters' journalism at scale. Success requires deep technical expertise in modern web and cloud architecture, proven people leadership across multiple teams, and a clear point of view on where AI can responsibly accelerate how the organization builds and ships software.

Relocation Support & Travel: Available upon discussion; minimal travel expected.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical architecture and long-term roadmap for Reuters' content management platform, directing design decisions around scalability, performance, and cost across backend services and AWS infrastructure.
Establish and maintain uptime and reliability standards for a production platform serving external customers at scale, while evaluating and guiding the platform's modern web rendering strategy.
Partner with editorial stakeholders to translate newsroom workflows into platform requirements, directing the roadmap for editorial tooling and identifying opportunities for AI-assisted content workflows that support without compromising journalistic standards.
Lead the teams responsible for platform delivery, including release management and production support, while owning the technical execution of the platform transition and establishing metrics to track platform health and operational risk.
Build, mentor, and lead a multi-team engineering organization, including managers and individual contributors, while fostering a high-performing culture grounded in ownership and continuous improvement across distributed teams.
Communicate technical strategy and tradeoffs credibly to engineers, product partners, executives, and customers while championing AI upskilling and adoption programs across the engineering organization.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing engineers, including experience managing managers or leading multiple teams
Demonstrated ownership of a production platform serving external customers at scale with experience in Agile methodologies and DevOps practices
Deep knowledge of AWS, serverless architecture, and distributed systems; strong grasp of modern web rendering (server-side and client-side rendering, React, build tooling); and working knowledge of HTTP, caching semantics, and CDN behavior in high-traffic environments
Experience with microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), test automation frameworks, and browser/system performance testing methodologies
Ability to communicate technical concepts credibly to engineers, product partners, executives, and customers, with demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams across multiple functions

Experience in SaaS or platform businesses where developers are among customers
Background in publishing, media technology, or content management systems, or experience leading an organization through platform consolidation or modernization
Familiarity with enterprise-scale CDN providers (particularly Akamai or CloudFront) and cloud cost optimization at scale
Experience integrating teams with divergent engineering cultures under shared standards, or exposure to AI/ML technologies with a track record of adopting AI into engineering workflows responsibly
Resilience and adaptability in the face of ambiguity, with passion for technology and its potential to drive business value; strong advocacy for diversity, inclusion, and cultural sensitivity across distributed organizations

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

jobs.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this, our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.com to learn more about us.

As part of H1’s hiring process, all candidates are required to participate in an in-person final interview. Depending on your location, this may require travel.

H1's Product Engineering organization is the engine behind the products that put our data in front of the people who need it most, health plans, digital health companies, life sciences organizations, and the clinical teams they serve. We build the client-facing products, APIs, integrations, and intelligent workflows that transform H1's rich underlying data into real decisions: which providers belong in a network directory, where clinical trials should run, and how healthcare organizations can operate with greater accuracy and trust. Product Engineering at H1 sits at the crossroads of complex data systems and enterprise software delivery, and our work directly drives revenue, client retention, and patient impact. We move fast, we own our products end-to-end, and we hold ourselves to a high bar — because in healthcare, the quality of what we build has consequences.

What You'll Do At H1

As a Director of Software Engineering at H1, you will own a high-impact product engineering domain and lead the team responsible for the client-facing products, integrations, and workflows within it. You will set the technical vision, build and develop your team, co-own the product roadmap with the PM, and serve as the trusted engineering voice across sales, customer success, and the broader organization. You will operate with real accountability; for delivery, for your people, and for the business outcomes that depend on your domain performing at its best.

You will:

Lead, grow, and develop a high-performing product engineering team; hiring, coaching, performance management, and building a culture where engineers do their best work
Partner with Product Management to co-own the roadmap, translating client needs and business priorities into a clear engineering strategy and delivery plan
Set technical direction; architecture standards, agentic workflow practices, and the bar for what good looks like — while staying close enough to engage meaningfully in system design decisions with your team
Own delivery accountability for your segment: on-time, high-quality releases that meet client SLAs
Run the engineering operating rhythm, manage on-call schedules, sprint planning, triage outages, retrospectives, and incident reviews, with structure and consistency
Manage competing priorities across Customer Support, sales, PM, and engineering, communicating tradeoffs clearly and making calls when the path isn't obvious
Serve as the senior engineering voice in cross-functional conversations; occasionally engaging directly with clients as a subject matter expert, though your primary surface is internal
Own multiple product lines simultaneously, bringing prioritization and clarity across a growing portfolio

About You

You are a seasoned engineering leader who has built and shipped SaaS products in complex data environments, and you know the difference between owning a product and managing a team that builds one. You take genuine pride in your people: you invest in them, challenge them, and measure your success by how they grow. You are comfortable at the intersection of engineering and business, equally capable of walking a client through how your product works and walking your engineers through a hard architectural tradeoff. You don't need to be writing code every day, but you stay close to the technology, you have a clear answer for how you use modern tooling and agentic workflows to stay effective, you understand how data moves through a system, and your engineers trust that when you weigh in on a technical decision, it's grounded in real understanding. You thrive in environments where priorities shift, ambiguity is constant, and the expectation is that you build the structure rather than wait for it. You are a clear communicator, a decisive decision-maker, and the kind of leader people point to when asked who made them better.

Requirements

10–15 years of software engineering experience with 3–5 years leading teams with direct reports
Proven track record owning a SaaS product end-to-end in a complex data environment, from technical architecture through client delivery and operations.
Experience managing multiple product lines simultaneously with a clear approach to prioritization and keeping teams unblocked.
Backend product engineering background: APIs, client-facing integrations, data-driven product surfaces, and visualization layers, this is not a data pipeline, infrastructure, or ML role.
Track record of building and developing engineering teams; people who grew under your leadership.
Able to articulate your agentic workflow and stay meaningfully close to the technology without coding daily; you can engage substantively in architecture and system design conversations with your team.
Strong communicator across audiences; executives, sales leaders, engineers, and clients, and a trusted technical voice in commercial conversations
Decisive under ambiguity; you own stakeholder relationships across CS, PM, sales, and engineering and communicate tradeoffs clearly
Preferred: experience in healthcare, medical, or insurance/payer technology; strongly preferred for the Health Plans role

Compensation

This role pays $190,000 to $265,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to stock options.

The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

New surfaces for the fleet. Applications that let our support engineers diagnose and resolve customer-raised issues remotely, and mobile experiences that let a site leader check on their Digit fleet without sitting at a desk.

who enjoys building as much as leading. You'll help shape how engineering works. We're entering an exciting phase of growth that requires evolving our engineering organization. The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. About this role:

Atria is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our Foundations group — the Platform, DevOps, and Data Engineering teams that the rest of the engineering organization is built on. Foundations exists to accelerate overall engineering throughput via the shared services, infrastructure, and data systems that let product teams ship for members and clinicians without reinventing authentication, caching, EMR data sync, pipelines, or deployments every time. You will own the technical strategy and roadmap across all three teams and be accountable for reliability, security, and delivery across the systems Foundations owns. This role directly manages the 12 member Foundations team, including 3 Tech Leads

Ownership & Execution:

Own the health, technical direction, and output of the Foundations group (Platform, DevOps, and Data Engineering), including the shared services, infrastructure, and data systems the rest of engineering depends on
Maintain end-to-end accountability for complex, multi-team Foundations initiatives from concept through deployment: EMR integrations, the MySQL-to-Postgres migration, background jobs, feature flags, and data platform enhancements

Drive initiatives from definition through delivery, maintaining accountability for outcomes
Identify problems proactively and propose solutions without waiting to be asked

Work cross-functionally with product, data, clinical, security, and executive stakeholders to deliver
Communicate early when blocked, working with colleagues to unblock the team.
Drive and contribute to a culture of direct, constructive feedback

Craft & Quality:

Own architectural direction across integration patterns, caching infrastructure, shared services, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure to ensure consistency and reuse across teams
Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges, maintaining rigorous design standards for reliability, performance, and security through architecture and design reviews
Champion AI-assisted engineering workflows across Foundations; establishing the patterns, tooling, and guardrails that let teams use AI to accelerate delivery safely and consistently
Hold a high bar for the work: simple, maintainable, and built to last
Use AI tools actively to amplify output and accelerate delivery, and teach others how to do so

Continuous Improvement

Establish and promote engineering standards across the group, including architectural patterns, code conventions, and documentation best practices
Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development across Foundations, mentoring engineers and Tech Leads to a rising bar
Champion observability and telemetry standards (Datadog, Sentry, Mixpanel), and drive post-incident reviews and systemic improvements when things break
Create structures to enable the team to easily measure what we build
Share learnings, workflows, and effective patterns with the team and promote them sharing with one another
Raise the standard of the work over time

Compensation:
$230,000 - $290,000

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership experience managing engineering teams and Tech Leads/managers
Track record of developing talent and raising team performance over time
Demonstrated track record leading multiple teams across platform, infrastructure, or data domains in production, and driving technical strategy, architecture, and execution for complex, cross-functional initiatives

Strong systems thinking - ability to see how decisions ripple across users, teams, and products

Ability to make decisions with incomplete information and bring teams along

Experience establishing AI-assisted engineering workflows at a team or organization level

Coordinates the efficient use of labor, material, equipment, and other resources.

Join a leading independent power producer at the forefront of renewable energy development. Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Our focus isn’t just on what we build, but how we build it. We scale technology solutions across the bus

iness. We spearhead product development tools and processes. We collaborate with our partners to provide a seamless experience for our customers. We are obsessed with speed, simplicity and customer outcomes.

Job Summary

The Director, Embedded Control Systems Engineering
provides strategic and technical leadership for the development, integration, validation, and deployment of embedded controls for critical subsystems. This role leads teams of controls engineers and embedded software engineers responsible for requirements development, control algorithm development, integrating, and validating embedded software and control system solutions for drivetrain, braking systems, steering systems, implement systems as well as multi-system integration controls across Caterpillar’s global machine portfolio.

The Director provides critical leadership in program execution and setting strategies for future technology and development practices. The Director helps establish the technical vision for world class development practices, aligns engineering execution with enterprise business objectives, and partners closely with product groups, manufacturing, validation, digital, and customer-facing organizations to deliver industry-leading solutions. This position is accountable for organizational capability development, talent leadership, technology strategy, and engineering excellence across global teams.

Champion modern software development methodologies, digital engineering tools, model-based development, and simulation capabilities.

Communicate engineering strategy, technical risks, and business impacts to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

This position is listed platforms, tools, and shared services that enable engineering teams to deliver software faster and more reliably on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Software Engineering, Platform Services based in United States.

This is a senior engineering leadership opportunity focused on building the platforms, tools, and shared services that enable engineering teams to deliver software faster and more reliably.

You will lead the modernization of developer tooling, engineering practices, and reusable services across a growing technology organization.

A major focus will be defining and scaling AI-assisted and specification-driven software development, with appropriate standards, evaluation, and guardrails.

You will own the developer experience, from development environments and golden-path templates to shared services, automation, and engineering productivity.

The role combines strategic vision with operational accountability, including service reliability, adoption, security, and performance.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role

CrowdStrike stops breaches, and detection content is how we do it. The Cloud Detection Platform team builds the engines that execute detection logic in the cloud at massive scale, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet.

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for our cloud detection engines (scheduled, real-time, and retrospective execution across first- and third-party data) and the supporting infrastructure: content management and deployment pipelines, rule lifecycle and exception management, testing and validation environments, and the observability, quotas, and SLOs that keep rule execution reliable and cost-effective for customers.

This is a high-leverage role at the center of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Your platform serves detection engineers across endpoint, cloud, identity, and next-gen SIEM, and every improvement you ship translates directly into faster, higher-quality protection for thousands of customers.

Drive the evolution toward a unified multi-engine detection architecture, balancing scheduled search, real-time, and retrospective execution across engines
Partner closely with detection engineering, content, product management, and data platform teams to prioritize and deliver against roadmap commitments
Build the guardrails that make shipping detection content safe: pre-release validation, staged deployment, rollback, exclusion management, and end-to-end testing
Anticipate and manage escalations and cross-team dependencies, and represent the platform in architecture and planning forums across the product organization
Drive annual operating plan and organizational planning for your area, and reflect CrowdStrike's culture in how your teams operate

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and 2+ years managing managers
Experience owning large-scale distributed systems in production, ideally data-intensive platforms such as query/search engines, streaming systems, or rule/event processing pipelines
A track record of being fully accountable for strategic outcomes over one-to-two-year horizons, not just project delivery

Excellent communication skills with executives, peers, and engineers

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

AMD is searching for a Director of Silicon Design
to lead the organization-wide adoption of AI-driven methodologies across our x86 Core Development Organization. This role owns the technical vision and execution strategy for embedding AI/ML into engineering workflows spanning functional verification, RTL design, and physical design. You will build and lead a team of engineers and technical leaders, set the multi-year vision for AI adoption in core development, and be accountable for measurable improvements in engineering efficiency and design quality. Alkira, a Lumen company, is a fast-growing cloud networking company that is transforming the way enterprise networks are deployed and managed. As we continue to reinvent networking for the multi-cloud and AI era, we are expanding our Engineering team.

The Role

We are seeking a Director or Senior Director of Engineering to own Alkira's Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) product end to end: the client, the control and management planes, and the team that builds them. You will set the long-term direction, build for scale and security, and deliver results that grow revenue and protect margins. The level will be based on experience and depth of expertise.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. The technology underneath ZTNA has changed before and will change again, and we want a leader who takes on hard problems and is willing to rethink foundational choices.

Responsibilities

Own the long-term vision, architecture, and roadmap for ZTNA, and lead transitions in core technologies such as tunneling, transport, and identity as the product evolves.
Design for scale from the start: customer growth, concurrent users, global distribution, and high availability.
Hire, develop, and lead engineers and managers.
Hire, develop, and lead engineers and managers.
Build for scale: tenant growth, concurrent users, global distribution, and high availability.
Apply zero-trust and secure-by-design principles throughout, and lead threat modeling, security reviews, and vulnerability response for the product.
Lead development of the cross-platform desktop client, and extend it to iOS and Android.
Lead the control and management planes: authentication with enterprise identity providers, device posture, session lifecycle, and provisioning across the platform.
Build in debuggability and self-service so customer admins and support teams can diagnose and resolve issues without escalating to engineering.
Own production health for ZTNA: SLOs, observability, incident management, and capacity planning.
Own the business outcomes of ZTNA engineering: partner with Product Management and Sales on capabilities that win customers and grow revenue, and manage engineering budget, infrastructure cost, and build-versus-buy decisions to protect margins.
Partner with the networking and datapath teams on how access policy is enforced in the network.
Hire, develop, and lead engineers and managers across the US and India, including bringing work delivered by external partners in-house.
Set clear goals and hold the team accountable for predictable delivery and results.

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years building networking, security, or distributed systems software, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and managers. Senior Director candidates bring 15+ years and experience leading multiple teams or a full product line.
A record of shipping products and meeting commitments, including taking a product from early stage to enterprise scale.
Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, DNS, NAT, and VPN and tunneling technologies.
Strong security foundation: applied cryptography, TLS and PKI, identity and access (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, MFA), threat modeling, and secure software development.

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Pawlicy Advisor is a venture-backed startup building the infrastructure that connects pet parents to the right financial protection for their pets, starting with the most trusted pet insurance marketplace in the US, distributed through thousands of veterinary practices nationwide. Pawlicy Advisor has delivered over 1 million unique quotes, has raised $19M+, has found product-market fit, and is now scaling. Pawlicy Advisor is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organization and own how it builds: technical strategy, architecture, quality, security, delivery, and the growth of the engineering team. This is a hands-on role at a profitable business where you will set the bar for how the team builds, including how the company uses AI tools. The role reports directly to the Chief Product Officer and leads an outstanding team of engineers working alongside a senior product manager, senior product designer, and data analyst.

What You Own

Technical Leadership

Key architectural decisions: major tech choices, build vs buy, scalability of the site, and carrier integrations
Security reviews of product and infrastructure changes, plus carrier and vendor security questionnaires and audits
Serving as the technical point of contact and leader with key partners
Release management and deployment: CI/CD, release cadence, rollbacks, and production stability
Prioritizing technical debt and refactoring, balanced against feature velocity
QA and testing processes: automated coverage, manual QA, and quality standards before release

Engineering Management

On-call management: rotation, escalation paths, incident response, and postmortems
Career development of engineers: 1:1s, performance feedback, and keeping the team unblocked
Building the team: hiring and onboarding new engineers as the company grows

Vendor and AI Management

Approval of new software used internally, evaluated on cost, security, and fit, including renewals and replacements
Engineering tooling and infrastructure spend: cloud costs, licenses, and consolidation opportunities
Owning and evolving Pawlicy's AI policy and best practices. Lead the company's rollout and expansion of AI usage while optimizing cost.

Where You Partner

OKRs: creation and ownership of key business goals and objectives
Product: sprint priorities, tech debt vs feature velocity tradeoffs, and delivery timelines with the senior product manager and the Chief Product Officer
Design: front end quality and design QA with the senior product designer
Partnerships and legal: carrier and vendor security questionnaires, audits, and integration requirements
Data and analytics: tooling and reliable data flow across product systems

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

Delivery is stable and predictable: releases ship on a defined cadence, and incidents have owners, escalation paths, and postmortems
Full command of the architecture: the site, quote engine, and carrier integrations, with a prioritized view of technical debt and risk
1:1s and career development running for every engineer
A first version of Pawlicy's AI development policy and best practices in place

First 12 months

A technical roadmap has been executed with security investments sequenced against business priorities
Delivery measurably improved: velocity, quality, and production stability all trend the right way
Carrier and vendor security reviews handled end to end without external help
Engineers are growing against clear development plans, and the team is confident in the technical bar you set
AI-assisted development is ingrained in the culture and adopted with measured results

Requirements

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineers and 2+ years in a senior engineering leadership role (Director, or senior-most technical leader), ideally at an early stage startup or fast-moving environment
The stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node, GraphQL, Postgres, AWS
Proven technical ownership and leadership: you have owned the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for a production consumer product, and built or scaled the team that delivered it
Still hands-on: comfortable reviewing PRs, reading code deeply, and jumping into an incident
Experience with application security and third-party compliance: security reviews, vendor questionnaires, and audits
Track record of excellent cross department communication and relationships leading to business success
Practical enthusiasm for AI-assisted development
Legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
Preferred: experience in insurance or fintech, or with partner API integrations.
Extra points if you love animals and believe pet healthcare is a serious, underserved problem

How You Work

You set your own technical agenda: there is no CTO above you defining priorities, and you generate the roadmap rather than execute one handed down
You fix things nobody asked you to fix: architecture, process, or tooling.
You enjoy teaching non-technical colleagues and working with cross functional teams
You push back, disagree, and align without it becoming political
You lead from the front with AI tool adoption and usage and evangelize across the company

AI and the Hiring Process

We embrace AI at Pawlicy and our work still relies on what the humans bring to it.

So please leave the AI out of interviews and case studies. Prep with it all you like, but in the room, we want your thinking, your questions, your judgment. These stages exist so we can get to know you and how you'd work with our team. We're hiring you, not a model and it is you we want to see.

To be concrete: no AI assistants or chatbots on any device during your interviews, and nobody else feeding you answers. Spell-check, autocomplete and notes you wrote yourself are all completely fine.

If it turns out AI was used where we've asked you not to, it may end your candidacy.

If any part of our process is a barrier because of how you read, write or communicate, email careers@pawlicy.com before that stage and we'll talk through the options. The skills we're assessing stay the same; what changes is the format. Asking has no bearing on how we assess you.

Benefits

Base salary range: $215,000 - $240,000
Startup equity grant
Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) employer contributions; flexible vacation
Remote-first within the United States

Career Path

This role is scoped as Director of Engineering and is the senior-most technical seat at the company, with a path to VP of Engineering as the team grows from :20 today to 25-30 in 2027. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in NYC, Pawlicy Advisor is a licensed insurance agency and the leading pet insurance marketplace in the US.

If you want real technical ownership, thrive in a fast paced environment, and care about developing engineers, Pawlicy would like to talk. Learn more at https://www.pawlicy.com/about-us/

jobs.description:
Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Position Summary

The BU Engineering Director is responsible for leading engineering activities across an assigned business unit and supporting operational performance, manufacturing readiness, reliability improvement, capital project execution, and adoption of enterprise engineering standards across manufacturing plants. This role leads Operating Unit Engineering teams within the business unit while partnering cross-functionally to drive engineering alignment, operational performance, technical issue resolution, and effective execution of prioritized capital initiatives across manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure compliance with company safety standards, engineering standards, and operational procedures.
Lead engineering activities across assigned business unit operations.
Provide leadership, coaching, technical support, and capability-building for Operating Unit Engineers within the business unit.
Drive process optimization, reliability improvement, and engineering performance across manufacturing sites, including uptime, throughput, yield, and scrap reduction.
Lead escalation management and support troubleshooting for complex operational, technical, process, and reliability issues across manufacturing sites.
Drive adoption and implementation of enterprise engineering standards, tools, governance, and best practices across manufacturing sites.
Support manufacturing readiness, startup stabilization, and operational performance improvement initiatives.
Lead prioritization and execution of capital projects within the business unit, ensuring alignment to operational needs, business priorities, engineering standards, scope, schedule, budget, and safety expectations.
Partner with Capital Project Engineering, Operations, and plant leadership to support project planning, readiness, execution, startup, stabilization, and benefits realization for approved capital initiatives.
Perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Essential

10+ years of manufacturing engineering, process engineering, reliability engineering, or technical operations experience.
5+ years of leadership or technical leadership experience supporting manufacturing operations.
Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing operations across 20+ plants.
Experience improving operational performance related to throughput, uptime, reliability, yield, scrap reduction, and process capability.
Experience supporting process troubleshooting, operational stabilization, and manufacturing readiness initiatives.
Experience supporting capital project planning, execution, startup, stabilization, and operational handoff within manufacturing environments.
Experience driving engineering standardization and best practice adoption across manufacturing operations.
Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and cross-functional coordination capability.
Ability to coach, mentor, and support engineering teams across 20+ plants.
Ability to operate effectively within matrixed manufacturing organizations.
Proficiency using common office technology and tools.

Preferred

Experience supporting packaging, plastics, injection molding, extrusion, thermoforming, molded fiber, paper, or related manufacturing operations.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related technical discipline highly preferred.

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $180,000 - $220,000 + bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Novolex, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

The benefits for this role include 401(k) plan with company match, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible spending and health savings accounts, paid vacation, and sick days, paid parental leave, paid holidays and wellness program.

What You'll Get From Us

Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

Training and Development

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Lasko Products
, an industry leader of home environment products for over 100 years, is seeking a Sr. Director of Engineering
. This role can be based in our corporate headquarters, West Chester, PA or in Boston, MA.

The Sr. Director of Engineering
is a key position within the Product Development team that represents a critical integration point between the Engineering team, Domestic Operations and the Strategic Business Units. The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to convert marketing and consumer requirements into technical performance requirements and mentor the engineering team. The Sr. Director of Engineering will provide front-end engineering leadership and vision on engineering technology and best practices to assure accurate scale up of new technology into executable engineering plans and designs for both our domestic and imported goods. The successful candidate will work with strong operations teams, quality teams, and business teams to manage an effective product development process from ideation through end of product life.

This individual will be responsible for partnering with the Product Management team to develop and drive technical innovation that aligns with consumer needs. They will be responsible for creating and implementing the strategic direction of the engineering team. This individual should be a highly motivated, quick learner who enjoys a hands-on, high-speed work environment.
The Sr. Director of Engineering
will report directly to the Vice President of Product Development. This role will manage a team of 4 Mechanical Engineers and 3 Project Engineers

Travel is estimated at about 10% of the time and the successful candidate must be available to travel international for up to 2 week periods.

Other Key Responsibilities Will Include

Create and sustain a culture of creativity and work ethic focused on achieving goals on time and within budget
Creatively resolve conflicting design constraints through analysis and testing
Assure that Engineering resources are aligned with the overall strategy for the business unit
Have experience managing a gated product development process
Direct the development of engineering standards and oversee implementation as they pertain to planning, development, and manufacturing
Foster an environment of continuous improvement and quick to market thinking
Partner with Operations for new product introduction planning including design for manufacturing, project risk assessment, new product costing, new product qualification and product ramp up/ramp down planning
Drive Value Based Engineering (VBE) initiatives into product design through partnerships with manufacturing and supplier initiatives.
Communicate strategic objectives, resource allocation and execute development plans both domestically and globally
Lead Mechanical Engineering team as a shared resource balancing requirements between Domestic Engineering and Import Engineering Teams
Have the ability to assess data objectively and to make scientifically sound decisions
Manage overall domestic project portfolio to ensure team KPI’s are met including on-time launch, unit cost and unit performance metrics
Ensure that both domestic and imported products adhere to safety standards, industry regulations, and quality certifications.
Proactively identify potential risks within the engineering, production, and importation processes, creating mitigation strategies
Oversee the engineering of both domestic and imported goods, ensuring product designs, specifications, and manufacturing processes meet industry standards, quality expectations, and regulatory requirements.
Work closely with the supply chain, procurement, and operations teams to manage the seamless integration of imported goods into the product development and manufacturing lifecycle.
Implement best practices in engineering design and testing to ensure that both domestically produced and imported products are scalable, reliable, and cost-effective.
Oversee the implementation of sustainable engineering practices and compliance with environmental regulations related to both domestic and imported products.

Qualification/Experience

10 plus years of broad technical experience in product development for domestic manufacturing with a proven track record of taking product from ideation through safe product launch.
Minimum of 5 years leading technical product development teams will be required.
Extensive experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing development and manufacturing partners
Strong Design for Manufacturing (DFM)/Design for Assembly (DFA) skills with emphasis on part/assembly tolerance to deliver robust designs for high volume manufacturing
Knowledge of design of plastic injection molded part designs, electromechanical integration and metal stamped part designs
Ability to assess data objectively and to make scientifically sound decisions in an efficient manner and to effectively present data in a format which supports the conclusion
Be Six Sigma trained - a Black Belt is considered a definite plus, a broad proven skill set of lean product development tools
In-depth knowledge of engineering design, quality control, and manufacturing processes for both domestic and imported goods.
Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering discipline
Project management experience with large, complex projects
Strong computer skills, i.e. Excel/Word/PowerPoint/Visio/Statistical Software such as Minitab or Statistics, etc.

About Lasko Products

Love Your Air ™

Lasko Products is the leading air solutions brand with a reputation for reliable products, peak performance, and perpetual innovation – our commitment to our customers for over a century. Founded in 1906 by Henry Lasko in Philadelphia, Lasko has evolved for over a century to become the global leader in air solution products. From our roots in small appliances, fans, and portable heaters, we’ve grown to become the leading home comfort company while maintaining our unwavering commitment to quality and value. Today, Lasko stands as a symbol of innovation, offering consumers around the world high-performance products; portable fans, heaters, air purifiers, humidifiers, and home ventilation solutions. Our well-known brands, Lasko, B-Air, BlueDri, Air King, and Guardian Technologies, serve both consumer and commercial markets across North America and internationally. As an American company for 120 years, we take pride in upholding the spirit of hard work, trust and accessibility, ensuring that Lasko remains available to all, for generations to come. Headquartered in West Chester, Pennsylvania, with manufacturing and distribution facilities in Tennessee and Texas, Lasko intends to set the standard in the air solutions category for another 100 years.
Lasko’s mission is to provide comfort you can trust.

Our company’s success is based on our culture of GRACE
, with five core “ Be ” values outlining how we live it.
Growth Mindset —
Be Bold
We are never the finished product ─ every failure is a data point, every setback is a setup.

Recognition —
Be Together
We win together. We celebrate together! High performance deserves to be seen ─ named, specific, remembered.

Authenticity —
Be Real
No masks. No politics. Show up as you are, say what you mean, and mean what you say.

Clear Communication —
Be Clear
Say it plainly. Say it once. Say it to the right person. Clarity is kindness.

Extreme Ownership —
Be Accountable
No blame. No excuses. Own the win and the loss. No exceptions.

Why Join Lasko?

At Lasko, we believe people do their best work when they’re supported ─ personally and professionally. That’s why we offer flexible hours and a hybrid work schedule for our corporate team, promoting employees to balance life and work in a way that fits their lifestyle. Our dog-friendly corporate headquarters adds a fun, welcoming atmosphere, while our competitive salaries with bonus potential recognize and reward your contributions. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes a strong 401(k) match, wellness incentives, and robust health coverage. Join Lasko and be part of a legacy of innovation – at a company that values flexibility, growth, and a culture where you can thrive.

Base to $200K, dependent on experience
Annual performance bonus, 25% to 30% target, based on company and individual performance

In office, Monday through Friday

Design new concrete products and improve existing ones, balancing structural performance, code requirements, manufacturing capability, and cost
Act as the licensed engineer who signs off on product performance and specifications
Prepare and maintain state and local product approvals, including testing, submissions, revisions, and renewals
Keep product drawings, calculations, specifications, and installation details current
Support customers, architects, engineers, building officials, sales, manufacturing, and quality
Investigate field and product performance issues and deliver practical fixes
Track building code and industry standard changes and decide how they affect the product line
Represent the company with code bodies and industry associations, subject to appointment

Bachelor's degree in civil, structural, or a related engineering discipline
Strongly preferred: active Florida Professional Engineer (PE) license
Strongly preferred: 10+ years in concrete products, structural building products, or a related field
Experience preparing structural calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical submissions
Working knowledge of the Florida Building Code and applicable concrete standards
Experience designing reinforced or prestressed concrete components used in masonry construction
Experience obtaining and maintaining Florida product approvals
Experience taking a new product from testing and approval into production

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Performance Contracting Group is a national employee-owned specialty contractor that offers quality services and products to the commercial, industrial, and non-residential construction markets. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing employees from a diversity of backgrounds and experiences, as well as supporting a culture of safety and inclusiveness that allows you to contribute to your fullest potential. The Director, IT Engineering provides enterprise leadership for the software, data, integration, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 capabilities that enable PCG’s business operations. The role is accountable for designing, building, integrating, modernizing, and sustaining secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. This leader establishes disciplined engineering practices, clear ownership, and outcome-based roadmaps that accelerate business value while improving quality, maintainability and cost effectiveness.

Leadership Mandate

Build an integrated enterprise engineering capability with persistent ownership of custom software, business applications, enterprise data pipelines and products, APIs and integrations, and the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. Set direction, establish operating expectations, and ensure internal teams and partners are accountable for measurable business outcomes, technical quality, secure delivery, operational readiness, and sustainable lifecycle management.

Strategic Outcomes

Faster delivery of business capabilities through modern software engineering, reusable components, automation, and clear alignment to enterprise priorities.
Clear ownership and outcome-based roadmaps for custom software, Microsoft Dynamics 365, enterprise data products, APIs, and integrations.
Reliable, secure, and maintainable applications supported by consistent architecture, development, testing, release, monitoring, and support practices.
Trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise data that enables reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and better operational decisions.
A simplified integration environment that reduces point-to-point interfaces, improves data flow, and connects Dynamics 365 with core enterprise and field systems.
A high-performing engineering organization with strong technical leadership, talent development, financial discipline, and accountability for business outcomes.

Key Accountabilities

Engineering Strategy & Operating Model: Publish and maintain a rolling 18–24-month roadmap for software, data, integration, and Dynamics 365 capabilities; review priorities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and expected business outcomes with technology and business leaders at least quarterly.
Software Engineering: Ensure 100% of actively developed applications have an accountable owner, documented architecture, product backlog, support model, security classification, lifecycle status, and measurable service objectives. Establish automated build, test, security, and deployment controls for all material production releases.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineering: Own the platform roadmap, solution architecture, configuration, extensions, Power Platform components, security roles, integrations, data, release calendar, and partner delivery. Review customizations quarterly and require documented business justification, ownership, testing, and lifecycle plans for all approved extensions.
Data Engineering: Assign accountable owners and service measures to all critical data products and pipelines. Monitor data quality, freshness, availability, lineage, security, and failed processing daily; maintain remediation plans for measures below target.
Integration & API Engineering: Maintain a current inventory of production APIs, interfaces, events, owners, dependencies, service levels, and lifecycle status. Review integration health monthly and deliver an annual plan to retire redundant or unsupported point-to-point interfaces.
Engineering Quality & Operations: Set and report monthly measures for delivery lead time, deployment frequency, failed changes, production defects, availability, incident recovery, automated test coverage, vulnerabilities, and recurring incidents. Require documented production-readiness approval before release.
Architecture, Security & Governance Partnership: Ensure 100% of material solutions complete required architecture, security, data governance, resiliency, and operational reviews before production approval; track exceptions to an accountable owner and target resolution date.
Talent & Culture: Maintain workforce and succession plans for critical roles, complete quarterly talent reviews, establish annual development objectives for all team members, and reduce single-person dependencies through documented cross-training and coverage plans.

Leadership Expectations

Translate business priorities and operational needs into clear software, Dynamics 365, data, and integration strategies, roadmaps, investment decisions, and executable plans.
Create clarity around solution ownership, engineering decision rights, service boundaries, data stewardship, integration responsibilities, technical standards, escalation paths, and definitions of done.
Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, maintainability, user experience, cost, and long-term enterprise architecture.
Engage business stakeholders early, frame operational problems before selecting solutions, and favor standard Dynamics 365 capabilities where they meet business needs before introducing customization.
Communicate complex engineering topics in plain business language and provide transparent visibility into delivery, capacity, risk, quality, cost, technical debt, and realized value.
Develop a leadership bench and career pathways that strengthen critical software, data, integration, and Dynamics 365 capabilities and reduce key-person dependency.

Demonstrated success leading software engineering, data engineering, integration and API engineering, and enterprise business application delivery.
Significant experience governing and delivering Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions, including configuration, extensions, Power Platform, security, data, integrations, release management, and implementation partners.
Experience establishing durable solution ownership, outcome-based roadmaps, engineering standards, governance, budgets, capacity models, and measurable performance outcomes.
Strong knowledge of modern software delivery, cloud and hybrid architectures, automated testing and deployment, APIs, event-driven integration, data platforms, observability, secure development, and automation.
Experience modernizing legacy applications, data pipelines, and integrations while managing technical debt and minimizing business disruption.
Strong executive communication and business partnership skills, including the ability to translate technical choices, risk, capacity, cost, and debt into business impact and investment decisions.
Experience leading internal teams, contractors, managed services, and strategic vendors while developing leaders and technical talent.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software engineering, information systems, data engineering, business, or a related field. Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, cloud, data, integration, or leadership certifications are preferred.

ComPsych Ⓡ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResources Ⓡ and AbsenceResources Ⓡ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.

About The Role

ComPsych is building out its Cloud Engineering function as we move from traditional, on-premise IT to a modern, cloud-native platform the whole organization builds on. We treat the platform as a product: an internal developer portal, CI/CD pipelines, paved roads, tooling, automation, and guardrails that let every team build, ship, and run their software securely and fast. Cloud migration and modernization are part of the journey, but the mission is the platform itself.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You lead the Cloud Engineering function and stay technically credible, setting strategy, standards, and direction and building alongside a very talented Lead/Architect and your team, not directing from a distance. AI isn't a side project here, it's how we build and operate the platform: your team uses AI to build tools, pipelines, and automation, and you set the bar for directing and validating what it produces. Our platform carries behavioral health data for millions of members, so reliability, security, and cost aren't competing conversations, they're the same one.

What You'll Do

You own the Cloud Engineering function end to end. Partnering with a very talented Lead/Architect and your team, you set the strategy, standards, and direction, and stay hands-on enough to be credible, delivering the platform, the pipelines, the tooling, and the guardrails the rest of the organization builds on.

Build the internal developer portal and self-service platform. A service catalog, golden paths, paved roads, and developer experience that let product teams provision, build, deploy, and run their software securely without waiting on you.
Own CI/CD pipelines, platform tools, and solutions. The pipelines, templates, SDKs, and platform services the function ships, built for reuse across every team, coding them hands-on and directing AI to accelerate.
