GENERAL SUMMARY

The Director, System Engineering leads and personally contributes to the system-level development behind our infusion pump platforms, including new product development and on-market sustaining activities. The scope of the department responsibilities includes product requirements, risk analyses, human factors/usability engineering, system-level architecture and design documentation, V&V test planning and execution, root cause analysis, CAPA/NC ownership, on-market change control and QMS updates for related procedures and processes.
This is a hands-on leadership role that brings a strong background in system engineering, medical device development and ability to mentor and lead a team of internal engineers and external contractors as needed. The position requires a solid understanding of system engineering principles while maintaining the flexibility to work within the existing process and toolsets without substantial reinvention. The role operates within our Quality Management System and partners closely with Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Project Management, Quality, and Regulatory to ensure system-level deliverables hold up our business, technical and regulatory requirements.
We are a small, privately held medical device company. We move quickly, avoid internal politics, and our leaders strive to make sound technical and process decisions decisively with data rather than by committee. Our size and scale afford autonomy, a flat and low-drama culture, and flexible working arrangement in support of a healthy work-life balance.

Grow and manage a team of 5 or more junior to senior level engineers.
Work closely with the Chief System Architect and Chief Engineer to oversee and contribute to the architecture specification, implementation and the performance accountability of new products in development.
Facilitate and contribute to the resolution of technical issues and improvements of products in the field through NC and CAPA processes.

Polymath builds technology for tokenizing and managing real-world assets.

At the foundation is Polymesh, its purpose-built blockchain for regulated financial assets. On top of Polymesh, Polymath has developed the Polymath Capital Platform, a SaaS platform that helps companies structure and manage tokenized investment offerings. Confidential Assets, launched on mainnet in 2026, add protocol-level privacy for regulated assets while maintaining the visibility required for audit and regulatory oversight.

In August 2026, Polymath entered into a definitive agreement to combine with TruGolf Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRUG), bringing Polymath to the public markets through a Nasdaq-listed company.

Location:
Remote. We are open to candidates based in North America, the UK and Europe.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Head of Engineering & Delivery to lead engineering across Polymath and Polymesh and own the roadmap, technical direction and delivery.

As the most senior technical leader in the business, you will report to the Interim CEO and own the key technical decisions across architecture, releases, technical debt, production security and incident response.

You will lead a remote engineering team and work closely with commercial leadership to turn business priorities and customer needs into secure, reliable products. The role combines technical judgment, team leadership and responsibility for delivery.

Lead the engineering teams across Polymath and Polymesh, including hiring, developing specialists and managing external development partners.
Own the product and engineering roadmap, priorities and delivery commitments, keeping engineering aligned with business objectives.

A hands-on engineering background and sound technical judgment. You must be able to assess code and architecture, but do not need to write production code.
Experience leading senior technical teams and delivering products across multiple workstreams and time zones.
Experience taking responsibility for production reliability and security in live systems.
Comfort working in regulated or compliance-heavy environments, where controls and change management matter.

Success means engineering runs effectively and independently, the roadmap is clear and tied to commercial priorities, and the team consistently delivers secure, reliable products that meet customer needs.

jobs.description:
Brief Description

HELP CONNECT ARIZONA. BUILD THE FUTURE OF BROADBAND
.

At Wecom Fiber, we're helping bridge the digital divide across Arizona by building and maintaining the communications infrastructure that powers homes, businesses, schools, and communities. As our next Senior Manager of Construction, you'll play a senior leadership role in driving enterprise-wide OSP construction strategy, scaling FTTH deployment operations, and shaping the future of a rapidly growing fiber telecommunications organization.

WHY WECOM?

We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.

Sr. Director of Design and Engineering – Fiber to the Home (FTTH)

Reports to
: Chief Operations Officer

Location:
Phoenix, AZ

Position Summary

The Sr. Director of Design & Engineering – Fiber to the Home (FTTH) at Wecom Fiber is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of outside plant (OSP) network design, engineering, and deployment readiness across our expanding FTTH footprint. This strategic position involves leading and managing a team of CAD drafters, GIS specialists, OSP engineers, and design professionals to ensure the successful delivery of high-quality fiber network designs in the telecommunications industry. The Director will translate Wecom's fiber expansion strategy into actionable engineering plans, own design standards and quality assurance, and serve as the senior technical voice across construction, operations, permitting, and executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Program Execution

Translate Wecom's FTTH expansion strategy into actionable, scalable engineering plans aligned with long-range forecasts and business objectives.
Own the technical vision for all Outside Plant (OSP) design, GPON/XGS-PON architecture, and last-mile delivery infrastructure.
Develop and continuously refine companywide engineering standards, design guidelines, and quality benchmarks for FTTH network builds.
Track and report major milestones across design, permitting, construction, and activation stages of the fiber build lifecycle.
Oversee BEAD-funded projects, ensuring compliance milestones, required documentation, and federal, state, and subgrant reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.
Identify and champion opportunities for process automation, GIS/CAD toolset adoption, and workflow optimization to reduce cycle times and improve deliverable quality.

Network Design & Engineering Quality

Lead and validate fiber OSP project designs for aerial and underground plant, ensuring compliance with company policy, NESC standards, and applicable municipal regulations.
Direct the design of FTTH network architecture including feeder, distribution, and drop plant; review bills of quantities (BOQs), optical link budgets, and splitter configurations.
Oversee quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) programs for internal and vendor-produced designs, ensuring accurate cable records and GIS asset data.
Review and approve engineering designs, cost estimates, and bills of materials (BOMs) for all FTTH build projects.
Evaluate and specify network equipment including ONTs, optical splitters, distribution frames, and related access infrastructure.

Permitting, ROW & Regulatory Coordination

Oversee all permitting and right-of-way (ROW)/easement acquisition processes, coordinating with municipalities, utilities, state DOTs, and property owners.
Manage joint-trench coordination with electric, gas, and water utilities to optimize construction cost and schedule.
Ensure compliance with local franchise agreements, dig regulations, and environmental requirements across all build markets.

Team Leadership & Vendor Management

Lead, mentor, and manage a team of CAD drafters, GIS specialists, OSP engineers, and design professionals, providing guidance, direction, and support for project execution.
Recruit, develop, and manage engineering resources including internal staff, offshore design teams, and engineering subcontractors.
Manage vendor relationships and strategic partnerships for OSP design, GIS services, and network equipment supply.
Lead performance management for all direct and indirect reports, including goal setting, evaluations, feedback, and professional development.
Foster a culture of collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement within the design and engineering department.

Financial & Budget Accountability

Lead capital budget development and administration for FTTH expansion and OSP engineering operations.
Prepare financial estimates, cost evaluation summaries, and project ROI analyses for fiber build projects.
Monitor project budgets and schedules; proactively identify and escalate cost and schedule variances.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including project management, construction, operations, and field personnel to align design and engineering efforts with business objectives.
Oversee the tracking of specific construction projects, ensuring accurate and timely updates on project progress, milestones, and deliverables.
Manage the creation of renderings, maps, GIS outputs, and design documentation to support project planning, implementation, and stakeholder communication.
Present engineering plans, program status, and capital forecasts to executive leadership as needed.
Collaborate with vendors, partners, and external stakeholders to source technologies, tools, and resources that support design and engineering initiatives.
Implement and optimize design and engineering systems, software, and tools to streamline processes and enhance project outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Design, GIS, Telecommunications, or related field.
Proven experience (10 years+ preferred) in a leadership role overseeing design and engineering teams, with a focus on FTTH/OSP network design, CAD drafting, and GIS mapping.
Expert knowledge of Fiber to the Home (FTTH) architecture, GPON/XGS-PON systems, and outside plant (aerial and underground) engineering standards.
Strong technical expertise in design and engineering principles, including CAD software (AutoCAD or equivalent), GIS applications (Esri/ArcGIS, QGIS), and make-ready/permitting workflows.
Demonstrated financial acumen in capital budget planning, cost estimating, and BOM development for large-scale fiber builds.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage with stakeholders, technical teams, municipalities, and senior management effectively.
Strategic thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a results-driven approach to design and engineering projects.
Experience managing geographically distributed teams, offshore design resources, and engineering subcontractors preferred.
Proficiency in design and engineering software, tools, and technologies relevant to the telecommunications industry.
Experience in driving technical excellence, innovation, and quality control in design and engineering processes.

The Benefits Of Joining Our Team

Career Growth & Leadership Opportunity

Influence operational strategy
Build scalable systems and processes
Lead transformational initiatives

Support expansion into new markets
Shape the future of construction management at Wecom

Comprehensive Benefits & Total Rewards

Vice President, Software Engineering

Mastercard Send, part of the Mastercard Move portfolio, powers near real-time money movement to billions of cards, bank, and digital accounts worldwide. The platform enables financial institutions, fintechs, businesses, and digital partners to deliver fast, secure, and reliable payment experiences across domestic and cross-border use cases.

About Us:

Live experiences help people cross today’s digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that’s bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime’s mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.

With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

The Role

Gametime’s Fan Experience team owns how fans discover, decide on, and purchase tickets on the demand side of our marketplace — the core experience for millions of ticket buyers across iOS, Android, mobile web, and desktop. This Engineering Manager
will lead a team of full-stack and front-end engineers building the features and value propositions that define how fans experience Gametime, partnering day-to-day with a dedicated Product Manager and Designer to move quickly from idea to production.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll spend real time on the keyboard alongside your team, and you’ll set the standard for how the team uses frontier models, AI coding tools, and new harnesses to generate, review, test, and monitor code — raising both velocity and quality as the bar for what’s possible keeps moving. This role reports to the VP of Product.

What You’ll Do

Hands-on leadership: spend a meaningful share of your time actually coding alongside the team — you lead from the front, not just from the roadmap
AI-forward engineering: set the standard for how your team uses frontier models, AI coding agents/harnesses, and new tooling to generate, review, test, and monitor code — the primary lever for increasing velocity and quality (i.e. fewer bugs, more stable services, cohesive system architecture) together, not as a trade-off
Cross-functional partnership: partner closely, day-to-day, with a dedicated PM and Designer as a trio; bring a real point of view on what the product and features should be, not just how to build them
Velocity investment: partner with product to identify and invest in what will let the team move faster over time — tooling, domain foundation design, tech debt paydown, and better use of AI in the development loop
Risk partnership: partner with product to surface the risks in what’s being proposed, and bring concrete recommendations and proposals for how to mitigate and eliminate those risks over time
Delivery: own the engineering roadmap and execution plan for your area, balancing speed, quality, and technical debt
Mentorship and talent bar: mentor engineers toward their next career level, hold a high talent bar for hiring and performance on your team, and help level up talent on other teams too
Cross-team technical leadership: partner with engineering leads and counterparts on other teams to improve the marketplace more broadly, technically, over time
A team and roadmap tied directly to fan-facing feature velocity, quality, and business outcomes on the demand side of our marketplace

What You’ll Bring

A hands-on engineering manager — comfortable spending real time writing and reviewing code alongside your team, not just directing from above
Direct experience using frontier models, AI coding agents/harnesses, and modern tooling to meaningfully improve engineering velocity and quality, and a point of view on where this is headed
A track record of shipping consumer-facing product features that moved measurable business outcomes
Strong cross-functional partnership skills — comfortable operating as a true peer to Product and Design, with your own opinions on what should be built, not just executing their specs
Experience managing full-stack and/or front-end engineering teams, with meaningful people-management experience (typically 5+ years in engineering, including several as a manager)
Familiarity with SQL/analytics to diagnose funnel and feature performance
Experience leading full-stack teams with end-to-end ownership of consumer-facing web and mobile products, backend services, and APIs in a high-traffic marketplace or e-commerce environment.
Strong understanding of modern front-end stacks (e.g., React and React Native), backend services, APIs, and full-stack architecture, with the technical depth to lead teams across the stack.
Experience partnering with Product and Design in a fast-moving, iterative environment (feature flags, A/B testing, rapid experimentation)
A data-driven approach to prioritization and technical trade-offs

Nice to Have

Experience in consumer marketplaces or high-intent, high-conversion consumer apps
A track record of building or championing internal tooling/platform investments that compounded team velocity over time

What We Offer

Flexible PTO
Competitive salary & equity package
Monthly Gametime credits for any event ($1,200/yr)
Medical, dental, & vision insurance
Life insurance and disability benefits
Diverse Family-forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
401k, HSA, pre-tax savings programs
Company off-sites and meet-ups
Wellness programs
Tenure recognition

jobs.title: Director, Network Operations Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have in This Role

As Director, Network Operations Engineering, you will lead the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of enterprise network services that support critical business operations and client connectivity. You will be accountable for building resilient, secure, scalable, and cloud‑ready network platforms across campus, data center, colocation, hybrid, and cloud environments.

In this role, you will drive a cloud‑first, automation‑led network strategy, improve operational reliability and recovery, and strengthen governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) maturity. You will lead and grow a high‑performing team of network engineers while partnering closely with product, infrastructure, security, audit, and risk teams to ensure network services meet business, client, and regulatory expectations.

This role reports directly to Network Operations leadership.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Network Architecture & Strategy

Define and lead the design and implementation of complex enterprise network architectures, including LAN, WAN, data center, SD‑WAN, and hybrid cloud environments
Develop and execute network strategies and multi‑year roadmaps aligned with business objectives and industry best practices
Establish enterprise standards for network design, client connectivity, resiliency, and security
Evaluate emerging networking technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and security

Network Operations, Reliability & Performance

Own enterprise‑level network operations, ensuring availability, capacity, performance, and security across on‑prem and cloud environments
Oversee the operation of routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless infrastructure, and cloud networking services
Lead the response to complex network incidents, including root‑cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions
Reduce operational risk by improving testing practices, recovery planning, and standardization of connectivity models
Monitor network performance, utilization, and capacity; sponsor optimization initiatives such as traffic engineering and QoS

Cloud, Automation & Modernization

Lead execution of the cloud and hybrid network strategy, including hybrid connectivity, cloud networking patterns, and cost‑optimization initiatives
Drive adoption of network automation and Infrastructure as Code, leveraging tools such as Ansible, Python, and SDN technologies
Ensure network provisioning, configuration management, and change execution are automated to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors
Establish cloud‑specific operational models, including monitoring, incident management, and financial governance

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Own network‑related governance, risk, and compliance responsibilities
Standardize network documentation, controls, and audit evidence
Track audit findings, remediation actions, and control effectiveness through structured governance forums
Partner with security, risk, and audit teams to ensure ongoing regulatory readiness

Leadership, Delivery & Vendor Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network operations and engineering professionals, with planned growth as demand increases
Set priorities, performance goals, and accountability across the organization
Lead network‑related programs and initiatives, including upgrades, migrations, and technology refreshes
Define project scope, timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure delivery on schedule and within constraints
Evaluate network vendors, support contract negotiations, and manage strategic vendor relationships
Ensure high‑quality network documentation, diagrams, procedures, and knowledge sharing
Communicate network risks, initiatives, and incidents effectively to senior leadership, including executive‑ready presentations (PowerPoint, Visio)

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in network engineering, operations, or infrastructure leadership roles within large, global enterprises
Demonstrated experience leading and developing technical teams
Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent practical experience
Experience supporting regulated or highly audited environments

Talents Needed for Success

Deep expertise in enterprise network architecture and operations
Expert‑level knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including: - TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS
VLAN, STP
Network security protocols (IPsec, SSL/TLS)
Strong experience with data center, hybrid, and cloud networking
Extensive experience with enterprise network devices and vendors
In‑depth understanding of network security principles, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and access control
Proven ability to lead incident response, root‑cause analysis, and operational improvement programs
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills
Demonstrated experience driving organizational process improvement and change

Nice to Have Skills

Experience with Infoblox, Guardicore, or similar network/IPAM/security platforms
Prior ownership of client connectivity platforms or services
Experience building centralized network topology or observability repositories
Advanced network certifications (CCIE, JNCIE)

jobs.title: VP, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

We are in search of a VP of Engineering for our Channels division, the action layer of the Braze technology platform. Our channels are where the Braze platform meets the end user, where our customers create rich messaging that is delivered to their end users via our channels: Email, Push, SMS/MMS/RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, In-App Messages, Content Cards, Banners, Landing Pages, Feature Flags, Webhooks, and more to come. 
You will lead this multi-team division through its next stage of technical and product transformation. This role presents formidable engineering challenges that call for a collaborative and cross-functional approach, necessitating close coordination with product and design teams. You will manage the team and help to grow the organization, leading software engineering via architecture design, growing engineering teams and skillsets, setting vision and goals, process and protocol, and hiring. On the product front - you will solve a number of interesting problems, from developing highly differentiated and sophisticated channel products, to thinking about how we build and position the broad portfolio of channels. On the engineering front - maturation of our systems into a more modular, efficient technology platform, all while delivering best-in-class product, is a major goal. And across both fronts, you will lead this organization through the AI transition: channel products that are increasingly intelligent and agentic, and an engineering org that leverages AI-assisted development to raise its own velocity and quality bar.
WHO YOU ARE

Several years of relevant experience as a manager of experienced managers with a strong track record of transformative success
A durable, motivated, ambitious, high-energy leader
A great people leader, capable of growing a world class team
A great technical leader, who can operate at different levels of granularity, from high level vision to partnering on detailed technology decisions
Deep credibility in large-scale distributed systems, with the ability to go toe-to-toe with senior engineers on architecture, reliability, and cost efficiency
Fluent in AI-assisted engineering, with an informed point of view on how AI agents and tooling change the way engineering organizations build, operate, and are shaped
A great process leader, who understands when to add and remove processes to help the org execute the best it can
An excellent communicator and writer, whose impact and leadership is obvious in the artifacts they create to guide their team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $284,762 and $480,536/year with an expected On Target Earnings ( OTE ) between $320,000 and $540,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.
WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.
From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:
Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.
BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you
OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.
Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:
To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com. 

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Defense Systems sector is looking for a Director
1
of System Security Engineering
to its Strategic Deterrent Systems Division. This position will be located in Roy, Utah
and will support the Sentinel program. Northrop Grumman supports the Air Force’s sustainment, development, production and deployment of hardware and system modifications for Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Ground and Airborne Launch Control Systems, Launch Facilities and associated infrastructure .
This position may offer relocation assistance.

What You Will Get To Do

Direct and lead a multi-disciplinary team in support of Program Protection and Product Protection requirements to include Supply Chain Risk Management, Supply Chain Security, acquisition risk management, and security countermeasure implementation.

You will lead a cross-functional team spanning the CONUS in the performance of System security engineering activities to include: requirements, architecture, design, threat and vulnerability analysis, development, evaluation, assessment and authorization supporting all phases of systems development and production in the areas of Information Assurance (IA) / system security engineering, security Assessment and Authorization (A&A) as per RMF (Risk Management Framework), Supply Chain Security, Operations Security (OPSEC), Protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) under DFARS 252.204-7012, Hardware/Software Assurance, and protection of Critical Program Information (CPI)/Critical Technologies (CT).

Execute on strategic planning and cost / schedule focused delivery and mitigation of program risks tied to milestone execution and management of program baseline scope

Participate as an active program team member in key recurring operations, including NCTA planning and review, program management reviews, recurring status reporting, staff meetings, etc.

Support program level requirements for multi-sector interfaces and activities where required

Provide leadership and guidance to a geographically dispersed cross functional matrixed team

Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
401k

Life Insurance
Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
Paid Time Off
Health & Wellness Resources
Employee Discounts

Experience leading teams/ and or organizations to achieve a common goal
2 years of experience with program financial controls, the business acquisition process and operations, defining and implementing a wide range of performance metrics and dashboards to track trends (Ex. CAM, EVMS)

Strong cost, schedule, technical, management and negotiation skills

A solid understanding of regulatory requirements for protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and DFARS 252.204-7012
Solid understanding of NISPOM and DD254 with implementation and education of security classification guide analysis
Familiarity with key customers, influencers, and decision makers

Excellent written and verbal communications, presentation skills, organizational and time management skills, and a strong sales/marketing presence. Candidate must be able to clearly present ideas to senior management, line management, and customers.
Must be able to travel 5-10% of the time
A solid understanding of Cyber protection, resiliency and survivability
CISSP Certification or other DoDI 8570 or equivalent qualification
Experience with RMF, DIACAP, NIST 800-53, security architecture, software assurance
Experience with Trusted System Networks (TSN) analysis
Familiarity with System Theoretic Process Analysis for Security (STPA-Sec)
Experience with Model-based Systems Engineering concepts and tools
Experience with Agile methodologies
Active TS/SCI

jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader to lead machine learning efforts across Hightouch. While hundreds of companies use Hightouch today to sync data into their SaaS systems to automate and improve operations, there’s a lot of surface area we haven’t touched in helping companies figuring out which customers to message, what content to put in messages, and when to send messages. A lot of this work today is done manually through intuition and guesswork, and we believe that adding machine learning could have a step function impact for our customers. And given our access to data warehouses and databases, Hightouch is perfectly placed to make use of a company’s customer data in building a powerful intelligence layer.

Role

At Hightouch, our engineering leaders serve as both active technical voices and strong people managers. The key outcomes we are looking for from this role include:

Product Development: Lead the team in roadmapping and executing successful development of significant features and products as required to drive the business forward. Uphold a high technical bar, while making pragmatic tradeoffs
Pace: Through a combination of leadership and technical expertise, improve the pace of execution of the team
Recruiting: Be responsible for growing the team, including identifying needs, deciding how to evaluate candidates, and ensuring we hire high impact team members
Reliability: Against the uphill battle of high growth/scale, up-level the team on reliability, resulting in fewer incidents, catching our own issues before our customers do, and a strong incident management hygiene
People: Foster growth of team members and ensure strong engagement and motivation

Some of the problems we’ll be working on include:

Personalization and Product Recommendation: There are often many options for what content a company could message a user with, including which products to show from catalogues. Given this large state space, how can Hightouch help personalize messages with the most relevant content for each user?
Probabilistic Identity Resolution: Many of our customers have multiple datasets and sources of information on their users. How do we stitch these datasets together and decide which profiles are from the same user or household?
Content Generation: Particularly with recent advances in LLMs, how can we help marketers generate text, images, and creatives that are compelling to their customers?
ML Infrastructure: Building the infrastructure to support model training and inference at scale for some of the largest companies in the world.

What We Offer

We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $230,000 - $400,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation.

We have limited inbound applications to one application per candidate. You will be auto-rejected if you apply to multiple roles. Please only apply to the position you are most qualified for.

What You Bring

Real commercial expertise. You're comfortable shaping and pricing proposals and scoping work as the technical authority, without needing to hunt for deals yourself.

jobs.title: Director, Sustaining Engineering - Spark
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Crusoe is a vertically integrated AI Factory company with a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. Our competitive advantage, "Speed is the only moat," is directly tied to our ability to rapidly design, manufacture, and deploy our own modular power and compute infrastructure.

We are seeking a Sustaining Engineering Leader to own how Spark performs after it is deployed. Product Management defines the next generation. New Product Introduction delivers it into production. You own each generation from the moment it leaves ramp: fleet reliability, field failures, configuration, obsolescence, and the design changes that keep deployed units performing for their full service life.

You do not set the roadmap and you do not run the factory. You own the installed base, and you are the evidence source Product Management and NPI both depend on. You will start as the single-threaded owner of this function and build the team as the fleet grows.

First Year Mandate

Spark deployments begin in early 2027. You will build the system before there is a fleet to run it on.

Stand up FRACAS, the root cause evidence standard, and the Failure Review Board.
Establish the as-built configuration baseline before there are units to reconcile.
Define spares, service intervals, and repair versus replace policy for the first generation.
Participate in the production release and ramp readiness reviews for the first deploying generation as the receiving organization.

What You'll Be Working On:

I. Fleet Ownership & Field Issues

Transfer of Ownership: Take technical ownership of each generation once it completes production ramp, through a defined handover from New Product Introduction covering the released configuration, open issues, and known risks.
Fleet Reliability: Own failure rate by subsystem, mean time between failures, and repeat failure rate, and define the telemetry every unit must report to make them measurable. Data Center Facility Operations owns uptime and time to repair.
Closed Loop Corrective Action: Run FRACAS and chair the Failure Review Board. Close every failure with a root cause, a verified fix, and proof it worked. A unit that fails while built within released tolerances is a design issue; attribution unresolved after ten business days proceeds as a Spark-funded fix and escalates to the Spark GM.
Containment: For safety or fleet-wide risk, contain first and settle attribution after. Own the retrofit decision and its sequencing.

II. Change, Configuration & Obsolescence

Post-Release Change Control: Own engineering change for generations in the field, with cost and fleet impact quantified before approval. New Product Introduction owns change control up to production release; you own it after.
Configuration Control: Own the configuration baseline and define what Operations records. Reconcile as-maintained against baseline so a change targets exactly the units that need it.
Obsolescence: Run a proactive DMSMS program. Model last time buys against fleet demand and qualify alternates before a shortage forces the choice.
Retrofit & Maintenance: Issue engineering change packages, kit definitions, preventive maintenance intervals, and acceptance criteria. Operations executes and returns the records; you verify effectiveness.

III. Feeding Product Management and NPI

Requirements into Product: Convert fleet evidence into quantified design requirements. Product Management decides what enters the PRD.
Qualification Requirements into NPI: Supply field-derived requirements and acceptance criteria, so a failure the fleet has already seen must be designed out and proven before the next generation is released.
Total Cost of Ownership: Own the reliability and service inputs to Spark unit economics.
Serviceability Advocacy: Represent serviceability and maintainability in design reviews. You hold no approval authority; you make the case with fleet data.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

Education

Required: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Reliability, or a closely related engineering discipline.

Experience

10 to 15 years in sustaining, reliability, or product support engineering for deployed capital equipment or infrastructure hardware.
Direct ownership of a fielded installed base, with field data converted into design change that measurably reduced failure rate or service cost.
Obsolescence and lifecycle management on a product whose service life exceeds that of the components inside it.
Experience standing a function up from nothing, including the processes and the partner agreements behind it.

Technical Depth

Reliability: FRACAS, structured root cause analysis, and mean time between failures and population failure rate analysis.
Change & Configuration: PLM, change order workflow, as-built control, and serial level effectivity.
Obsolescence: DMSMS practice, end of life monitoring, last time buy modeling, and alternate part qualification.
Systems Fluency: Electrical, mechanical, and thermal command sufficient to adjudicate root cause on a modular power and compute product, including liquid cooling.
Service Economics: Spares, service cost per unit, and the link between availability and revenue.

Additional Qualifications

Experience with modular, containerized, or prefabricated infrastructure products in the field.
Familiarity with liquid cooled data center hardware, including CDU and rack level cooling interfaces.
Mountaineer Spirit: The persistence to chase a root cause past the easy answer, and the judgment to know when a fleet-wide fix is worth its disruption.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation and equity packages
Restricted Stock Units
Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
Employer contributions to HSA account
Paid parental leave
Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
Professional development & tuition reimbursement
Mental health & wellness support
Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
Cell phone stipend
401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
Volunteer time off
Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
Daily meals allowance
Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $225,000-$255,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

The Head of Client Identity Engineering is a senior technology executive responsible for defining and delivering Vanguard's global client identity strategy, architecture, and engineering capabilities. This leader will oversee the design, development, security, resilience, and operation of enterprise-scale identity platforms that support millions of client interactions across digital channels.

This role combines deep technical expertise in identity and access management, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, and software engineering with the ability to influence enterprise strategy, drive innovation, and lead globally distributed engineering teams. Strategy and Industry Leadership

Define and execute the global client identity engineering strategy, target architecture, multiyear roadmap, and investment priorities.
Set the technical vision for identity proofing, authentication, authorization, federation, consent, profile management, digital fraud controls, and identity lifecycle capabilities.
Represent the organization in industry forums and strategic partnerships; anticipate market, regulatory, threat, and technology shifts and translate them into actionable engineering priorities.

jobs.title: Agile Systems Engineering Department Head
jobs.description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please login to Workday to complete the internal application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.
CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.
If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

POSITION SPECIFICS

Your working location will be fully on-site located in State College, PA. This role requires periodic travel to remote locations.

We are searching for a Department Head for the Agile Systems Engineering Department (ASE) of the Materials, Manufacturing and Sustainment Office (MMSO) at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. The Agile Systems Engineering Department is dedicated to the application and training of systems engineering to support the advancement of warfighter capability at the speed of relevance. The department focuses on the rapid development of complex engineering systems requiring the integration of cross-disciplinary solutions and expertise, including system architecture design, functional analysis, requirements development, and model-based engineering. Additionally, the department has a lead role in workforce development and systems engineering training. This role will lead and manage all aspects of the Agile Systems Engineering Department, providing strategic direction, technical leadership, and operational oversight of a department of approximately 10 people. This leadership position requires a visionary leader capable of building and directing a multidisciplinary team focused on tailored application of systems engineering, model-based engineering, architecture development, and rapid, tailored systems integration. This position may be filled as either a Research and Development Engineer or a non-tenure Research Faculty.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.

You will:

Lead and manage all aspects of the Agile Systems Engineering Department, providing strategic direction, technical leadership, and operational oversight, personnel management, workforce planning, talent development, and performance evaluation
Build and direct a multidisciplinary team focused on the application of systems engineering to a diverse set of programs, technologies and sponsors
Mentor systems engineers in applying systems engineering to a variety of complex engineering problems that span levels of technical maturity ranging from early science and technology to system acquisition
Support division leadership in developing and maintaining relationships with sponsors in support of meeting funding objectives
Lead individual research projects and portfolios including developing technical concepts, writing winning proposals, staffing projects, conducting research, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality results
Foster partnerships with U.S. Military Program Offices, defense contractors, systems integrators, and other government laboratories
Lead department personnel in developing and delivering training on systems engineering to ARL staff and external partners
Foster a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and mission focus

Additional responsibilities for the higher-level position includes:

Support development of a comprehensive roadmap for embedded systems and integration methodologies pertinent to systems of interest to the division including but not limited to missiles, hypersonics, and uncrewed aerial systems
Establish and maintain partnerships with U.S. Military Program Offices, defense contractors, systems integrators, and other government laboratories
Build strategic relationships with Defense Industrial Base stakeholders
Collaborate across ARL departments and with external stakeholders as a trusted agent in identifying and applying appropriate systems engineering activities for large U.S. Military development programs

Required skills/experience areas include:

Leading individual research projects and portfolios including developing technical concepts, writing winning proposals, staffing the project, conducting the research, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality results
Past success applying systems engineering techniques for complex system development, with emphasis on streamlined and/or tailored processes
System architecture design, functional analysis, requirements development, system decomposition, and flow down of requirements
System and interface architecture development and testing
Evaluation of communications, messaging, and data architectures

CACI is seeking a Vice President of Engineering to support the Electronic Warfare (EW) Line of Business (LoB).

The ideal candidate will have direct experience working on advanced, complex technical projects requiring innovative solutioning and industry knowledge. In addition, the ideal candidate will have direct experience with all phases of business from strategic capture and corporate investment in next generation technology to program execution through industry standard best practice processes and personnel growth and incentives.

Driving and managing internal investments in new technology into the business
Managing product and systems roadmaps
Creating shared engineering processes and procedures and identifying common engineering tools to support collaboration and accelerate development
Shaping and strengthening workforce talent and growth
Establishing strong collaboration across the entire EW LoB to strengthen CACI’s competitive position in current and new markets

Qualifications

Required:

Proven ability to effectively lead and grow large organizations with highly skilled and talented individuals
Demonstrated ability to interface with Senior leadership teams from both Corporate business and Government.
Demonstrated clear and effective oral and written communications skills regarding technical solutioning and proposals

AI/ML and Agentic Production AI
RF/Signal Processing

Understanding of key markets:
EW
Mission and Platform integration
C5ISR

Communications

Master of Science degree in a technical field (Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or Master of Business Administration (MBA)
Twenty years’ experience in developing innovative technical solutions
Project Management Institute (PMI) certification

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

jobs.description:
Brief Description

Are you ready to embark on an extraordinary career journey? Look no further than The Austin Company, where greatness is not just a goal, but a way of life. As a leading design, engineering, and construction firm with a rich legacy dating back to 1878, Austin offers unparalleled opportunities for growth, innovation, and professional development. Join our dynamic team and be part of a company that is at the forefront of shaping the future of industries worldwide. With a commitment to excellence, a collaborative work environment, and a passion for delivering exceptional results, Austin empowers its employees to reach their full potential and make a lasting impact. Discover the limitless possibilities that await you at www.theaustin.com and embark on a rewarding career journey with Austin.

The Vice President of Design and Engineering will provide technical and engineering leadership for both design-build and engineering only projects and pursuits. The responsibilities of this position include maintaining and, where necessary, establishing standards for Austin’s design and engineering process. The purposes of these standards include ensuring a measure of consistency, defining the level of quality for deliverables, and providing efficient and effective design and engineering processes that support The Austin Method, so that projects are completed on-time, within budget, at the highest quality levels and meet client satisfaction.

Requirements

Education: a bachelor’s degree in engineering or architecture from an accredited engineering school. This position requires professional registration and the ability to secure reciprocity in multiple states via NCEES or NCARB programs.
Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience of which at least five years being the manager or director level of an engineering department.
Skills: Good oral and written communication skills are essential; strong leadership and team management skills; strong understanding of regulatory requirements and compliance standards in the engineering sector; ability to drive change and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement; Experience with financial management and budgeting for engineering projects.

Summary

Provide strategic leadership and direction to the design and engineering team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation. Hold the team accountable for their individual duties and responsibilities.
Develop the vision for engineering success and own the outcome of the overall engineering strategy.
Work with Directors of Engineering to assign resources to project teams. These resources must be capable of supplying the expertise necessary for successful project performance.
Monitor and measure the quality of design and engineering capability and performance in all operations, ensuring that operational teams maintain client satisfaction, produce high quality service and deliverables, and produce a profit that meets or exceeds Austin’s annual plan for both dollar amount and margin.
Ensure distribution to projects and pursuits for all design and engineering personnel to meet established and budgeted amounts.
Maintain and develop new company policies, process, and procedures in connection with the professional and technical aspects of Austin’s design and engineering function. Monitor and ensure the compliance of these policies, processes, and procedures.
Identify and lead the development of market-specific engineering standards, resources, and tools to improve design production and efficiency.
Ensure proper architecture and engineering registration and licenses are maintained in all locations in which Austin operates.
Monitor Austin’s professional architecture and engineering practices to assure compliance with all laws and regulations pertaining to the professional practice of architecture and engineering in all locations where Austin is active.
Investigate significant design errors and implement actions and programs to avoid their repetition as well as to generally reduce engineering overhead costs.
Periodically, review representative drawings, specifications, preliminary studies and reports to ensure conformity with good practice.
Actively participate in professional organizations. Prepare and make presentations to clients and professional organizations.
Review and, if appropriate, recommend for approval requests for computerized equipment and software to support the design and engineering functions, which ensures cost effectiveness, high productivity, and maximum flexibility.
Identify, recommend, and monitor the training and development of designers, architects, and engineers to ensure high-level performance by these individuals.
Approve succession plans throughout the engineering department and ensure that training and development for key individuals are completed so that the individuals are prepared to take on increased responsibilities when appropriate.
Assist marketing, communication, and sales when their need involves design or engineering information to assist in the success of Company’s sales and marketing efforts.
Review and submit for management approval annual budgets for the engineering department.
For historical and planning purposes maintain a monthly index of engineering backlog.
Maintain liaison with Risk Management on all matters of professional liability to assist in successful prevention of liability problems and successful defense of possible liability cases should they occur.

Austin offers a comprehensive benefit package including Medical and Dental, Life, STD, LTD, and 401K with matching as well as a competitive salary with opportunity for advancement.

The Austin Company is an EEO and DFWP Employer

Austin is wholly owned subsidiary of Kajima.

At least 7 years of HW architecture design.
Experience in AI Rack architectures & future roadmaps.
Experience developing customer relationships at the leadership level
Experience communicating across all levels of business and executive leadership presence

For this role, we anticipate paying $200,000 - $225,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

Closely collaborate with other squads across the fleet keeping user's requirements and delivery timelines in mind

Experience working across multiple diverse technology and production teams

Deep understanding of Kafka

Experience in troubleshooting and debugging distributed production systems and code

Advanced Python Development
Knowledge of Flink is a plus

Job Description:

AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering is the senior leader responsible for the strategy, architecture, engineering, operations, reliability, and continuous improvement of AssetMark's cloud and infrastructure platforms.

This role owns the technology foundation that enables the business, including Azure Cloud, DevOps and platform engineering, Infrastructure as Code, databases, data platforms, enterprise networking, office connectivity, wireless, firewalls, SD-WAN, load balancing, F5, and Azure networking services.

Cloud and Infrastructure Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering strategy. The VP will lead through senior managers, technical leads, and engineering teams across the following capability areas:

jobs.title: Director Systems Engineering, North America
jobs.description:
Director, Systems Engineering — North America

Title flexible to Senior Director or Field CTO for exceptional candidates

Location: United States (Remote / Field)

Travel: Around 25%, primarily to EBCs and customer sites in North America
Eligibility: Candidates must be US Citizens or US Permanent Residents.

Why This Role

You'll be RtBrick's first senior technical leader in the US: the primary technical interface between our engineering core and US customers, carrying carrier-grade software that is already in production into a market we're just entering. You start as the hands-on technical lead and build the systems engineering team as US accounts land.

About RtBrick

RtBrick builds the software that lets operators run their network edge the way cloud providers run data centers. Our platform, RtBrick Full Stack (RBFS), replaces monolithic, proprietary edge systems with cloud-native, disaggregated software that runs on Broadcom DNX-based white boxes and on cloud instances.
RBFS is a full Multiservice Edge (broadband network gateway, CGNAT, peering, aggregation and edge routing) on one software base built on open APIs.
RBFS is also built for AI-assisted operations. Every RBFS element includes an MCP server that lets AI agents diagnose and operate the network. Each agent action goes through the same authenticated, audited and reversible commit path as an operator's change, and humans approve what gets applied.
The software is proven in production. Deutsche Telekom has approved RBFS for deployment in its network, where it delivered a significant reduction in five-year total cost of ownership versus the incumbent approach. RBFS has carried subscriber and business traffic for years with service providers in Austria, Germany, Canada and Taiwan, through failures, upgrades and traffic peaks. Backed by major telco investors, we are now opening the US market.

The Role

You'll own the architecture conversation with US customers from the first whiteboard session through production deployment. You'll report to: Head of Professional Services.
The work is architectural. You'll design how operators move from monolithic edge platforms to disaggregated, cloud-native infrastructure: subscriber management at scale, CGNAT, peering and aggregation, and the IP/MPLS and BGP/EVPN designs underneath. You'll also help operators adopt AI-assisted operations without giving up control of their network.
The role demands range. You'll go deep with a customer's principal architects on routing design, then take the same conversation to the C-suite as a commercial and roadmap discussion, often in the same week.

What You'll Do

•
Customer-Facing Technical Authority. Serve as the lead architectural voice for US accounts. Lead technical workshops, design reviews (HLD/LLD), and complex POCs and make sure our solution meets each customer's network requirements.
•
Strategic Pre-Sales and Solution Design. Translate customer use cases (massive-scale access, DC interconnect, peering) into technical requirements for our engineering team. Own the technical win.
•
AI-Assisted Operations. Guide operators in adopting RBFS's built-in MCP server and agent-driven operations, from read-only diagnosis to human-approved and templated changes.
•
Product Evolution. Act as the Voice of the Customer. Work closely with the CEO, CTO, and Product Managers to prioritize features that solve real operator pain points, weighing long-term product vision against immediate market demands.
•
Team Leadership and Mentorship. Grow into building and managing a team of high-caliber Systems Engineers and Solutions Architects. Build an engineering-first culture that values deep hands-on skills alongside commercial acumen.
What Success Looks Like in Your First 12 Months
•
First US POCs designed, run, and converted into technical wins.
•
A US reference architecture for migrating from incumbent edge platforms to RBFS.
•
Field feedback reflected in the product roadmap through the Field and Product Management team.
•
The first Systems Engineering hires as US accounts land.
What You Bring: Required
•
Experience. 15+ years in service provider networking, with at least 5 years at Principal or leadership level.
•
IP/MPLS Edge Routing. Hands-on experience in IP/MPLS edge routing with fluency in Layer 2/3 protocols (BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, Segment Routing).
•
Service Provider Architecture. Expert understanding of large-scale service provider architectures (BGP/MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN). Experience managing complex multi-vendor integrations and carrier-grade reliability requirements.
•
Cloud-Native Networking. Solid understanding of cloud-native networking (Kubernetes, microservices, APIs, NETCONF/YANG). Expertise in cloud-native or containerized NOS environments.
•
Hands-On Technical Credibility. While this is a director-level role, you must be comfortable diving into packet-level details, reviewing configurations, and navigating a Linux-based NOS.
•
Disruptor Mindset. Experience articulating the TCO and CapEx benefits of white-box, disaggregated models versus traditional chassis-based systems.
•
Communication. Proven ability to present complex technical roadmaps to CTOs and VPs, and to keep composure during high-stakes commercial or technical negotiations.
•
Drive. A can-do attitude. You thrive in a high-performance environment where autonomy is expected and pay for performance is the norm.
What You Bring: Preferred
•
Experience with CGNAT or Broadband Network Gateway (PPPoE/IPoE).
•
Familiarity with Broadcom-based merchant silicon and white-box hardware.
•
Experience at a disaggregated or challenger networking vendor, or inside an ISP or MSO.
Why RtBrick
•
Real impact. You'll build on software that already works at carrier scale, replacing legacy edge platforms in production networks today, not pitching a roadmap.
•
Hard problems. Subscriber management at millions of sessions, cloud-native operations on merchant silicon, and intent-based networking that actually ships. Engineering is hard, and it's why people stay.
•
Direct access. Flat structure, no layers between you and the decision. You'll work daily with founders and industry veterans who are still deep in the technical details and still write code.
•
Build it from the ground up. You'll define how the US practice runs, set the architecture standard for a new market, and build the team behind it.

jobs.title: Director, Product Cost Excellence and Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Scout Motors | Senior Leadership Role | Driving product cost excellence, value engineering, and cross-functional transformation for the next generation of all-electric trucks and rugged SUVs

Scout Motors is building a modern, purpose-driven automotive company rooted in iconic American heritage and focused on the future of electrified mobility. We are looking for a Head of Product Cost Excellence and Value Engineering to establish and lead a cross-functional program that improves product cost competitiveness while protecting customer value, quality, performance, and brand integrity.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Lead Product Cost Excellence and Value Engineering initiatives within product development, partnering closely with Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and Supplier Development.
Drive execution of product cost excellence strategy and contribute to its continuous evolution across programs and platforms.
Drive adoption and improvement of governance, operating cadence, KPI tracking, and roadmaps to monitor cost optimization ideas through approval, execution, and financial realization.
Lead cross-functional cost optimization workshops with internal teams and suppliers to generate practical, high-impact ideas balancing cost, customer value, quality, timing, and technical feasibility.
Apply value engineering, design-to-value, competitive benchmarking, teardown insights, should-cost analysis, supplier cost breakdowns, and total cost of ownership methods to improve cost competitiveness.
Develop business cases for cost optimization initiatives, including savings potential, investment needs, tooling impacts, engineering effort, timing, risks, payback, and overall financial impact.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to identify productivity improvements, localization opportunities, logistics efficiencies, material cost improvements, and process optimizations.
Leverage data-driven cost analytics, digital workflows, and emerging technologies to improve visibility, decision quality, and execution speed.
Lead and develop a team of product cost optimization and value engineering specialists.

Location & Travel Expectations
:

This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC / Novi, Michigan.
This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

12+ years of experience in automotive engineering, procurement, product cost management, cost engineering, value engineering, manufacturing, or a related field.
Proven success leading cost optimization and value engineering initiatives in complex product development environments.
Strong understanding of vehicle systems, product development processes, supplier cost structures, industrialization, and lifecycle cost drivers.
Experience using value analysis/value engineering, design-to-value, should-cost modeling, competitive benchmarking, teardown analysis, supplier cost breakdowns, and total cost of ownership approaches.
Ability to translate technical and commercial opportunities into clear business cases, implementation plans, stakeholder decisions, and measurable financial outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across engineering, procurement, finance, manufacturing, quality, logistics, product, and supplier partners.
Strong financial acumen, analytical capability, and comfort working with cost databases, KPI dashboards, business cases, and executive-level reporting.
Experience with digital tools, advanced analytics, AI-enabled workflows, or data-driven decision-making in product development or cost optimization is a plus.
Entrepreneurial mindset, high ownership, strong communication skills, and the ability to drive structure and alignment in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

Competitive insurance including:
Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

401(k) program with:
An employer match and immediate vesting

Generous Paid Time Off including:
20 days planned PTO, as accrued
40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Corporate Vehicle Program with:
Eligibility for 1 assigned vehicle
A mobility stipend

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial Base Salary Range: $160,000.00 - $192,500.00

Internal Leveling Code: M6

leads and advances Vertex's enterprise Product Security program across software engineering, application security, and secure software development practices.
