Monitor industry trends, emerging threats, and evolving Application Security and Product Security practices to continuously strengthen organizational security posture.

Significant experience leading Product Security, Application Security, andSCor Secure SDLC programs within a technology company, with deep expertise in secure software development practices and modern engineering environments.
Demonstrated success partnering with software engineering organizations and influencing security adoption across complex, multi-team development environments.
Experience developing, measuring, and communicating security program effectiveness through metrics, reporting, and executive-level presentations; proven ability to collaborate across Product, Engineering, and Cybersecurity organizations.
Knowledge of AI security considerations, including the secure adoption of AI within engineering practices and the security implications of AI-enabled products.
Demonstrated executive presence with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to drive security outcomes through influence and partnership rather than direct authority.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering, Product Eng
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world every day. We are deeply committed to the well being of everyone in our global community, and our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

At Snap, our products empower people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. We believe that diverse backgrounds and voices help us create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate.

We are looking for a Director, Software Engineering to lead a Product Engineering team at Snap. In this role, you will combine strong people leadership, product judgment, and technical depth to build experiences that delight Snapchatters and deliver meaningful business impact.

You will shape the team’s vision and strategy, develop a high performing and inclusive organization, and partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Operations, and Engineering leaders. You will guide the delivery of reliable, scalable, and privacy conscious products in a fast moving, highly collaborative environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead, manage, and mentor a team of software engineers. Create an environment where people can do their best work, grow their careers, and feel included and supported.
Set the technical vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable goals for a product engineering area aligned to company priorities.
Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Operations, and other Engineering teams to understand customer needs, define product requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver high quality experiences.
Design, implement, and scale critical product components and services across the stack, including backend services, distributed systems, client applications, and data platforms as appropriate for the team.
Drive technical execution across a portfolio of initiatives, from near term product launches to longer term investments in architecture, platform capabilities, and engineering excellence.
Establish a high bar for availability, scalability, performance, privacy, security, operational excellence, and cost management.
Use product and engineering insights to identify opportunities, make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, and improve customer and business outcomes.
Provide technical direction that influences work beyond your immediate team and helps engineering organizations operate more effectively.
Hire, retain, and develop high caliber engineers and leaders while building a diverse and inclusive team.
Communicate clearly with senior leaders and cross functional partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks, decisions, and outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent programming and software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, testing, and technical decision making.
Proven experience building and operating highly available products or services at significant scale.
Experience architecting, designing, and developing distributed systems and modern product experiences.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect technical choices to customer value and business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems, set direction, and lead complex initiatives from strategy through delivery and operation.
Strong collaboration, communication, mentorship, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience developing engineering talent, building effective teams, and fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly and apply them effectively.
Experience with one or more modern programming languages, such as Java, C++, Go, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or JavaScript.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
10+ years of post Bachelor’s software development experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical field plus 9+ years of post graduate software development experience; or a PhD in a related technical field plus 6+ years of post graduate software development experience.
5+ years of experience as an engineering manager or technical leader, including experience setting technical direction for engineering projects or organizations.
Experience architecting, designing, and developing distributed systems and business critical products.
Experience leading, mentoring, and scaling engineering teams to consistently deliver complex, high impact work.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a technical field such as computer science.
Experience building consumer products used at global scale.
Experience partnering with senior executives and management across a globally distributed organization, and exercising sound judgment in a fast changing environment.
Experience leading product engineering teams across multiple platforms, such as web, mobile, and backend systems.
Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning to product development, personalization, recommendations, search, or engineering productivity.
A track record of delivering in rapidly changing, highly collaborative, multi site, and multi stakeholder environments.
Ability to create a compelling vision for the future, communicate with clarity, and lead with a collaborative approach.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The base salary range for this position is $334,000-$500,000 annually.

jobs.description:
Title: Director Engineering Execution Projects

Requisition ID: 147134

Location:

Phoenix, AZ, US, 85040

Category: Engineering Services

Share this Job

Why You Should Apply For This Job

Why You Should Apply for This Job

At Freeport-McMoRan, we are committed to providing an employment package that recognizes excellence, encourages safe production and a culture supported by our core values. Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their career. Apply Today!

Where You Will Work   

Our global headquarters is in Phoenix, Arizona. Several hundred employees support global operations in finance, human resources, information technology, planning and more from the main office, satellite offices or online. As a Hybrid employee, you’ll engage in virtual collaboration as well as attend in-person meetings at our Collaboration Hub in Phoenix or at one of our site locations. The Collaboration Hub provides an open, flexible workspace for individuals and teams to come together for various business needs. Amenities at the Hub include a working café, phone booths and meeting rooms with technology tools for virtual and in-person collaboration. In-person attendance may vary based on the position and department requirements.

Phoenix is the capital of the Grand Canyon State and enjoys mostly bright skies throughout the year. It is the perfect place if you enjoy the outdoors, love sports, concerts and other big city amenities or technology. There are great neighborhoods around Phoenix, with easy access to a major city, nature, the arts and many more amenities. 

What You Will Do

Accountable for the successful delivery of engineering services across the capital project portfolio, ensuring engineering scope, schedule, cost, quality, and resource requirements are fully integrated into project execution plans and budgets. Provides leadership, governance, and oversight to drive alignment between engineering activities and overall project objectives.

Establishes engineering execution strategies, performance metrics, reporting frameworks, and change management processes that support predictable and successful project outcomes. Partners closely with Project Directors, Project Managers, Engineering Managers, EPCM partners, and technical teams to ensure engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements. Also oversees field engineering and commissioning support through project startup and final handover.

Provide strategic direction, leadership, and governance for engineering execution across assigned capital projects and portfolios, ensuring alignment with project objectives, stage-gate requirements, corporate standards, and business priorities.
Oversee the development and integration of engineering execution plans, staffing forecasts, budgets, schedules, deliverable registers, and key milestones to ensure alignment with overall project plans and performance forecasts.
Establish and maintain engineering performance management frameworks, including reporting systems, key performance indicators, productivity measures, progress tracking methodologies, and forecasting processes that provide clear visibility into engineering performance and project status.
Lead the implementation and governance of engineering change management processes, ensuring design changes, technical deviations, scope modifications, and engineering-driven impacts are properly assessed, documented, approved, and incorporated into project cost and schedule projections.
Partner with Engineering Managers to proactively identify project risks, constraints, and performance challenges, developing and executing mitigation and recovery strategies to safeguard engineering deliverables and critical project milestones.
Provide leadership and accountability for field engineering activities, technical issue resolution, design clarification processes, commissioning engineering support, startup readiness, operational handover, and the promotion of a strong safety culture.
Champion engineering standardization, the application of lessons learned, best practice adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project execution and performance across the capital project portfolio.
Foster effective collaboration and communication among project teams, operating sites, functional departments, EPCM partners, and external service providers to support timely decision-making, issue resolution, and project success.
Perform other duties as required.

What You Bring To Freeport

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, and fifteen (15) years of progressively responsible engineering, project engineering, or project execution experience in mining, minerals processing, industrial facilities, infrastructure, energy, or a related capital-intensive industry.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, Engineering Managers, and external engineering service providers.
Demonstrated experience delivering engineering scope on large, complex capital projects through feasibility, detailed design, construction, commissioning, and startup.
Experience working with EPC, EPCM, Owner’s Engineer, or hybrid project delivery models.
Strong knowledge of engineering management, integrated project planning, project controls, risk management, cost and schedule management, quality management, and change management.
Demonstrated ability to establish engineering execution strategies, performance metrics, progress measurement, forecasting, and executive reporting.
Strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, negotiation, communication, and decision-making skills.
Advanced knowledge of engineering management and capital project delivery processes.
Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering design, interfaces, constructability, and systems integration.
Expertise in engineering execution planning, progress measurement, productivity analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Comprehensive understanding of engineering change management, configuration control, and technical assurance principles.
Ability to lead large technical organizations and influence outcomes in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong business acumen and ability to balance safety, technical quality, schedule, cost, operability, maintainability, and long-term asset performance.
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, including the ability to convey complex technical and project information clearly.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making capability in dynamic project environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional Engineer registration or equivalent professional accreditation.
Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related discipline.
Experience in copper mining, mineral processing, hydrometallurgical, pyrometallurgical, or other large-scale industrial processing facilities.
Experience leading engineering execution across multiple concurrent projects or a major capital project portfolio.
Working knowledge of field engineering, commissioning, startup, operational readiness, and asset handover processes.
Familiarity with digital engineering tools, engineering data management systems, model-based design, and project delivery technologies.

What We Offer You

Actual base pay is determined by experience, qualifications, skills and other job-related factors. This role is eligible for additional incentive compensation considerations based on company and individual performance.  Additionally, this position is currently eligible for annual long-term incentive consideration.  Long-term incentives are contingent upon authorized approval under the terms and conditions of the Company's plan and award agreements.  More details will be shared during the hiring process. 

Affordable medical, dental and vision benefits 
Company-paid life and disability insurance 
401(k) plan with employer contribution/match 
Paid time off, paid sick time, holiday pay, parental leave 
Tuition Assistance 
Employee Assistance Program 
Discounted insurance plans for auto, home and pet 
Internal progression opportunities 
Learn more about our competitive and comprehensive benefits package! 

What We Require

Freeport-McMoRan promotes a drug/alcohol-free work environment using mandatory pre-employment drug testing as allowed by applicable laws. 

Ability to travel up to 25% domestically and up to 35% internationally to support business and operational needs.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Enterprise Infrastructure Engineering & Operations based in the United States.

This senior technology leadership role oversees the strategy, architecture, engineering, and reliable operation of enterprise infrastructure and modern workplace platforms. You will shape the roadmap across Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoints, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, backup, and monitoring. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution, particularly during the initial development of the function. You will lead engineers and managed service partners while remaining deeply involved in architecture, automation, implementation, and complex troubleshooting. Success will depend on building secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective technology foundations. You will collaborate closely with security, data, applications, quality, AI, and business teams in a regulated environment. This is an opportunity to influence enterprise technology strategy while directly improving operational reliability and business continuity.

Accountabilities

Define and execute enterprise infrastructure and modern workplace roadmaps, architecture standards, technology lifecycle plans, and modernization strategies spanning AWS, Microsoft 365, identity, endpoints, networking, compute, storage, backup, recovery, and monitoring.
Act as a hands-on technical leader by designing, configuring, automating, implementing, and troubleshooting complex infrastructure solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Infrastructure as Code, and other relevant technologies.
Lead high-risk technical decisions, major infrastructure changes, escalations, and initiatives while improving platform reliability, security, scalability, performance, automation, cost efficiency, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
Establish engineering, configuration, documentation, testing, monitoring, identity, endpoint, Zero Trust, information protection, and lifecycle standards in collaboration with cybersecurity, risk, and quality stakeholders.
Lead, coach, and develop infrastructure engineers while overseeing service desk operations, managed service providers, and vendors through clear ownership models, service levels, performance metrics, escalation processes, and accountability.
Partner with application, data, AI, security, quality, and business teams to translate organizational requirements into secure, scalable, supportable technology platforms and ensure effective implementation and operational handoff.
Manage infrastructure budgets, forecasts, cloud consumption, Microsoft licensing, contracts, vendor relationships, capacity planning, technical debt, and investment priorities.
Communicate technology roadmaps, service performance, operational risks, dependencies, and strategic trade-offs to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
15+ years of progressive experience across enterprise infrastructure, platform engineering, AWS and Microsoft cloud technologies, modern workplace platforms, and technology operations.
7+ years of experience leading technical teams and enterprise platform capabilities, with demonstrated success balancing hands-on engineering with people and operational leadership.
Proven experience managing people, vendors, budgets, technology roadmaps, and enterprise operational outcomes.
Strong expertise in AWS infrastructure and Microsoft technologies including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft Graph.
Deep knowledge of Azure and hybrid cloud architecture, enterprise networking, identity and endpoint engineering, virtualization, storage, backup and recovery, business continuity, scripting, automation, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and monitoring.
Experience with Zero Trust, conditional access, identity governance, privileged access, endpoint security, secure cloud configuration, regulated-system controls, IT service management, incident and problem management, change management, service levels, and managed service performance.
Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred; exposure to GxP environments is an advantage.
Strong communication, coaching, stakeholder management, vendor management, negotiation, prioritization, and decision-making skills, with sound judgment around internal development, managed services, automation, and external expertise.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and demonstrate values centered on courage, community, patient focus, and teamwork.
Ability to travel approximately 15–30% and work onsite or face-to-face with colleagues in San Diego as needed; this is not a fully remote position.

jobs.description:
State Street Investment Management (“State Street IM”, formerly State Street Global Advisors) is seeking a Global Head of Architecture and Engineering Governance to lead the firm’s enterprise-wide architecture and engineering governance function.

Operating within the broader Business and Technology Architecture organization—which encompasses Business Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Platform Engineering, Technology Operations & Resilience, and Architecture & Engineering Governance—this role is accountable for establishing and enforcing the enterprise guardrails that ensure architectural integrity, platform reuse, engineering consistency, and regulatory compliance across the end-to-end technology lifecycle.

Reporting to the Global Head of Business and Technology Architecture, this role serves as the enterprise design and engineering governance authority, ensuring that business strategy, architecture intent, platform capabilities, and engineering execution remain tightly aligned. The role plays a critical part in enabling State Street IM’s transformation toward a Product, Platform, and Service (PPS) operating model, powered by platform-based architectures and AI-enabled SDLC governance.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Engineering Governance

Define and own the enterprise architecture and engineering governance framework, spanning business-aligned solution design, platform usage, SDLC controls, and delivery assurance.
Establish clear decision rights, governance forums, and escalation models across Business Architecture, Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, and Technology Operations.
Act as the enterprise authority for architectural and engineering compliance, balancing delivery velocity with risk, resilience, and control expectations.

Platform-Based Architecture Governance

Govern the adoption and usage of platform-based and composable architectures, ensuring reuse, interoperability, and scalability across portfolios.
Define architecture principles, reference architectures, and guardrails that guide Solution Architecture and Platform Engineering teams.
Ensure platform designs meet enterprise requirements for security, resilience, operability, performance, and cost transparency.

AI‑Enabled SDLC & Engineering Governance

Lead governance for AI-enabled software delivery, including AI-assisted design, development, testing, deployment, and operational tooling.
Define enterprise standards and controls for responsible AI use across the SDLC, including traceability, explainability, auditability, and risk management.
Partner with Engineering, QA, Security, and Risk teams to embed AI-enabled controls into CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows.

Alignment Across Architecture & Technology Functions

Partner with Business Architecture to ensure business capabilities, outcomes, and value streams are translated into executable architecture intent.
Govern Solution Architecture consistency and quality through design reviews, standards enforcement, and lifecycle checkpoints.
Align with Technology Platform Engineering to ensure platforms adhere to enterprise standards and support long-term reuse and scalability.
Coordinate with Technology Operations & Resilience to ensure operability, resilience, and recovery considerations are embedded early in design.

Control, Risk & Regulatory Readiness

Ensure architectural and engineering governance supports regulatory expectations, audit readiness, and technology risk management.
Oversee exception management, remediation tracking, and governance-driven risk reduction initiatives.
Serve as a key partner to Risk, Security, Compliance, and Audit teams on architecture- and engineering-related matters.

Metrics, Transparency & Executive Reporting

Define and monitor governance-related KPIs and KRIs, including architectural compliance, platform adoption, technical debt, SDLC maturity, and delivery risk.
Provide executive-ready reporting and insights on architecture health, governance effectiveness, and systemic risks.
Drive continuous improvement of governance processes using data, automation, and tooling.

Required Qualifications

15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, engineering leadership, or large-scale technology governance within regulated environments.
Proven track record leading architecture and engineering governance across complex, global organizations.
Deep expertise in platform-based architecture and enterprise-wide technology standardization.
Strong understanding of modern SDLC models, engineering practices, and governance controls in cloud and distributed environments.
Demonstrated experience embedding risk, security, and resilience considerations into architecture and engineering decision-making.
Experience operating within matrixed, multi‑function architecture organizations, with clear articulation of roles and decision boundaries.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder influence skills.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience governing AI‑enabled engineering and SDLC practices in regulated environments.
Strong background in enterprise and solution architecture frameworks and design governance models.
Experience with cloud-native, microservices-based, and distributed system architectures.
Familiarity with AWS and/or Azure governance and architecture standards.
Prior experience partnering closely with Quality Engineering, Technology Risk, Security Architecture, and Resilience functions.
Demonstrated success supporting large-scale platform and operating model transformations.

$170,000 - $282,500 Annual

jobs.title: Head of Architecture and Engineering Governance, MD - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description:
State Street Investment Management (“State Street IM”, formerly State Street Global Advisors) is seeking a Global Head of Architecture and Engineering Governance to lead the firm’s enterprise-wide architecture and engineering governance function.

Operating within the broader Business and Technology Architecture organization—which encompasses Business Architecture, Solution Architecture, Technology Platform Engineering, Technology Operations & Resilience, and Architecture & Engineering Governance—this role is accountable for establishing and enforcing the enterprise guardrails that ensure architectural integrity, platform reuse, engineering consistency, and regulatory compliance across the end-to-end technology lifecycle.

Reporting to the Global Head of Business and Technology Architecture, this role serves as the enterprise design and engineering governance authority, ensuring that business strategy, architecture intent, platform capabilities, and engineering execution remain tightly aligned. The role plays a critical part in enabling State Street IM’s transformation toward a Product, Platform, and Service (PPS) operating model, powered by platform-based architectures and AI-enabled SDLC governance.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Engineering Governance

Define and own the enterprise architecture and engineering governance framework, spanning business-aligned solution design, platform usage, SDLC controls, and delivery assurance.
Establish clear decision rights, governance forums, and escalation models across Business Architecture, Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, and Technology Operations.
Act as the enterprise authority for architectural and engineering compliance, balancing delivery velocity with risk, resilience, and control expectations.

Platform-Based Architecture Governance

Govern the adoption and usage of platform-based and composable architectures, ensuring reuse, interoperability, and scalability across portfolios.
Define architecture principles, reference architectures, and guardrails that guide Solution Architecture and Platform Engineering teams.
Ensure platform designs meet enterprise requirements for security, resilience, operability, performance, and cost transparency.

AI‑Enabled SDLC & Engineering Governance

Lead governance for AI-enabled software delivery, including AI-assisted design, development, testing, deployment, and operational tooling.
Define enterprise standards and controls for responsible AI use across the SDLC, including traceability, explainability, auditability, and risk management.
Partner with Engineering, QA, Security, and Risk teams to embed AI-enabled controls into CI/CD pipelines and delivery workflows.

Alignment Across Architecture & Technology Functions

Partner with Business Architecture to ensure business capabilities, outcomes, and value streams are translated into executable architecture intent.
Govern Solution Architecture consistency and quality through design reviews, standards enforcement, and lifecycle checkpoints.
Align with Technology Platform Engineering to ensure platforms adhere to enterprise standards and support long-term reuse and scalability.
Coordinate with Technology Operations & Resilience to ensure operability, resilience, and recovery considerations are embedded early in design.

Control, Risk & Regulatory Readiness

Ensure architectural and engineering governance supports regulatory expectations, audit readiness, and technology risk management.
Oversee exception management, remediation tracking, and governance-driven risk reduction initiatives.
Serve as a key partner to Risk, Security, Compliance, and Audit teams on architecture- and engineering-related matters.

Metrics, Transparency & Executive Reporting

Define and monitor governance-related KPIs and KRIs, including architectural compliance, platform adoption, technical debt, SDLC maturity, and delivery risk.
Provide executive-ready reporting and insights on architecture health, governance effectiveness, and systemic risks.
Drive continuous improvement of governance processes using data, automation, and tooling.

Required Qualifications

15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, engineering leadership, or large-scale technology governance within regulated environments.
Proven track record leading architecture and engineering governance across complex, global organizations.
Deep expertise in platform-based architecture and enterprise-wide technology standardization.
Strong understanding of modern SDLC models, engineering practices, and governance controls in cloud and distributed environments.
Demonstrated experience embedding risk, security, and resilience considerations into architecture and engineering decision-making.
Experience operating within matrixed, multi‑function architecture organizations, with clear articulation of roles and decision boundaries.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder influence skills.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MSc, or equivalent) strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience governing AI‑enabled engineering and SDLC practices in regulated environments.
Strong background in enterprise and solution architecture frameworks and design governance models.
Experience with cloud-native, microservices-based, and distributed system architectures.
Familiarity with AWS and/or Azure governance and architecture standards.
Prior experience partnering closely with Quality Engineering, Technology Risk, Security Architecture, and Resilience functions.
Demonstrated success supporting large-scale platform and operating model transformations.

Salary Range

$170,000 - $282,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

jobs.title: Vice President, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Vice President, Infrastructure & Engineering provides executive leadership for the strategy, design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise infrastructure and technology operations. The role leads infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud operations, digital workplace services, service management and design, production and support operations, and technology operations with an end-to-end systems perspective. This leader establishes multi-year priorities, service-level objectives, operating standards, and investment roadmaps that advance reliability, security, operational resilience, automation, scalability, cost effectiveness, and the employee and developer experience while aligning infrastructure decisions to enterprise business risk and value.

This role will require you to be onsite at least 3 days per week.

Responsibilities

Establish and execute the enterprise infrastructure and engineering strategy, operating model, roadmaps, standards, capacity plans, and investment priorities in alignment with business growth, risk tolerance, and technology objectives.
Provide executive leadership across infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud operations, digital workplace services, service management and design, production and support operations, and technology operations, applying end-to-end systems thinking across infrastructure, network, security, application, and cloud dependencies.
Own operational excellence for critical services by establishing meaningful SLOs, SLAs, service-performance measures, observability, and incident and problem management practices; lead calmly through high-severity events with clear stakeholder communication, timely escalation, and accountable follow-through.
Lead the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of secure, resilient, and scalable enterprise infrastructure, infrastructure applications, next-generation platforms, and production support capabilities; embed security and applicable control requirements into architecture, engineering, and operating decisions.
Drive infrastructure modernization through cloud and container platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation and orchestration, self-service and self-healing capabilities, tooling consolidation, and reduction of manual operational toil to improve consistency, speed, and developer experience.
Oversee enterprise disaster recovery and technology continuity capabilities, including critical-service prioritization, recovery objectives, architecture, documentation, and recurring tests and exercises that identify gaps and drive measurable improvement.
Establish governance for capacity, asset and lifecycle management, service performance, change and release management, vendor risk, operational controls, runbooks, architecture documentation, change records, and knowledge management; balance the pace of change with reliability and stability.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Application Delivery, Cyber Risk Management, Data and Analytics, Product, Procurement, Finance, and business leaders to align cross-stack decisions, standards, investments, build-versus-buy choices, delivery priorities, and risk acceptance where authority is shared.
Lead financial and resource stewardship for the function, including portfolio prioritization, budget planning, cloud and infrastructure cost governance, capacity and licensing optimization, vendor strategy, contract performance, and material vendor escalations, without compromising required reliability or security.
Build a high-performing and resilient leadership organization through workforce and succession planning, talent development, sustainable on-call practices, performance accountability, psychological safety, and a blameless postmortem culture that converts failures into shared learning and durable corrective action.
Communicate infrastructure strategy, priorities, risks, service performance, incident impacts, trade-offs, and investment needs to executive stakeholders and governance forums, framing recommendations in terms of business continuity, customer and employee outcomes, risk reduction, and enterprise value while monitoring relevant market and technology trends.

Leadership Scope and Decision Authority

Executive leadership of multiple infrastructure and operations disciplines through director-level leaders, including accountability for reliable service delivery, operational resilience, leadership capability, and sustainable operating practices.
Accountability for translating enterprise technology strategy and anticipated business demand into an executable infrastructure roadmap, operating priorities, service-level commitments, capacity plans, and investment recommendations.
Authority to recommend and prioritize investments, allocate resources within approved plans, establish functional standards and controls, direct major-incident response, govern vendor performance and escalation, and escalate material operational and technology risks.
Enterprise influence across technology domains and business functions, including layers outside the role’s direct ownership, where infrastructure platforms, applications, networks, cloud services, security, continuity, cost, and delivery outcomes are interdependent.
Executive judgment in ambiguous and high-impact situations, balancing reliability, security, speed, cost, compliance considerations, customer needs, and business value through transparent, cross-functional decision-making.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Master's degree in a related field is preferred.
16+ years of progressively responsible technology experience, including 10+ years of supervisory or senior leadership experience.
Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise infrastructure, engineering, cloud, platform, or technology operations functions.
Executive-level knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and technology operations strategy, architecture, engineering, service delivery, and modernization, with the systems thinking to understand dependencies across networks, cloud, security, platforms, applications, and workplace services.
Demonstrated reliability and operational-excellence discipline, including SLOs and SLAs, observability, incident and problem management, blameless postmortems, service improvement, and calm, transparent leadership during high-severity events.
Expertise in operational resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity and scalability planning, change and release management, risk-based controls, and balancing stability with the pace of delivery.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, platform engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, container technologies, automation and orchestration, self-service capabilities, and approaches that reduce manual toil and improve consistency.
Strong financial acumen and cost discipline, including portfolio and budget planning, cloud and infrastructure cost governance, licensing and capacity optimization, vendor and contract management, material escalation, and build-versus-buy analysis.
Ability to embed security and applicable compliance considerations into infrastructure strategy, architecture, engineering, change, and operational practices in partnership with risk and control stakeholders.
Ability to communicate a compelling technology vision, frame infrastructure investment in terms of business risk and value, set enterprise priorities, influence decisions without direct authority, and align stakeholders across technology and business functions.
Ability to build leadership capability, mentor technical talent, sustain resilient on-call teams, create accountability and psychological safety, and foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of learning and continuous improvement.
Discipline in operational documentation and knowledge management, including usable runbooks, architecture diagrams, change records, service ownership information, and practices that reduce dependency on individual knowledge.
Sound judgment in ambiguous, high-impact situations and the ability to evaluate trade-offs among reliability, security, speed, cost, scalability, compliance considerations, customer needs, and business outcomes.
Relevant cloud, infrastructure, service management, security, continuity, or program leadership certifications are preferred and nice to have.

jobs.title: VP, Engineering Services
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VP, Engineering Services based in United States.

Lead a large-scale engineering organization responsible for reliable, secure, and efficient technical service delivery.

You’ll oversee 24x7 operations, escalated engineering, project engineering, and tooling while driving measurable service improvements.

The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational accountability across people, processes, technology, and financial performance.

You’ll strengthen incident, change, monitoring, automation, and service management practices to support demanding client environments.

Working closely with executive leaders, sales, account management, finance, architecture, and clients, you’ll shape long-term growth and delivery strategy.

You’ll also lead organizational transformation, tooling modernization, resource optimization, and margin improvement initiatives.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a scalable engineering model where reliability, security, client trust, and operational excellence are central.

Accountabilities

Lead and develop the engineering organization across 24x7 NOC and operational engineering, escalated engineering, project engineering, and tooling teams, establishing organizational structure, spans of control, career paths, hiring plans, and resource levels aligned with client demand and budgets.
Own the major incident management process end to end, including critical escalation command, root cause analysis quality, timely corrective actions, and sustained accountability for preventing recurrence.
Establish and continuously improve change management governance, including change advisory processes, standard changes, tiered technical and management approvals, emergency change reviews, and streamlined governance practices.
Define, monitor, and act on engineering KPIs such as SLA attainment, MTTR, utilization, backlog, and quality trends, providing executive leadership and client sponsors with clear performance insights and remediation plans.
Maintain healthy operational queues and clear ownership across service desk, NOC, escalated engineering, and subject matter expert teams while ensuring advanced technical issues are appropriately escalated and deconflicted.
Drive a structured shift-left model by moving appropriate work to lower service tiers through documentation, training, knowledge transfer, and automation of recurring health checks and manual tasks.
Establish recurring collaboration and feedback mechanisms across delivery tiers to identify recurring defects, process gaps, and knowledge needs and turn them into measurable improvements.
Own the engineering side of the service management platform, ensuring workflow configuration, data quality, reporting, and operational processes accurately reflect and enforce service management standards.
Define and execute the roadmap for monitoring, management, and automation tooling, including platform evaluations, consolidation and migration initiatives, vendor negotiations, and adoption across distributed engineering teams.
Govern the technical estate lifecycle, including vendor maintenance, end-of-life tracking, renewals, certificate and PKI management, automated renewal capabilities, and disciplined decommissioning with appropriate client communication.
Review and approve statements of work, ensuring proposed solutions are technically sound, appropriately resourced, commercially viable, aligned with margin objectives, and deliverable within committed timelines.
Represent engineering directly with client sponsors, leading technical escalations, service improvement initiatives, governance discussions, and efforts to strengthen delivery relationships.
Partner with architecture teams on client technology assessments, identifying and scoping project opportunities and feeding recommendations into account planning and budgeting cycles.
Own engineering financial performance, including expense and invoice approvals, billing reconciliation, billing-model attribution, timekeeping accuracy, vendor management, and delivery against annual cost and margin targets.
Align security operations with incident and change management processes so security-related work is governed, measured, escalated, and managed consistently with broader engineering operations.
Coordinate field and on-site service activity, including scheduling, resource allocation, and communication with client sponsors for planned site visits.
Ensure engineering practices meet the confidentiality, data-handling, audit, security, and compliance expectations of legal and professional services environments.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field is preferred, along with 12+ years of progressive IT experience and at least 5 years leading engineering or technical service delivery organizations.
Proven experience within managed services, outsourced IT, or multi-client service delivery environments, with direct responsibility for SLAs, client satisfaction, operational performance, and delivery margins.
Experience supporting legal, accounting, consulting, or other professional services organizations is strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with confidentiality requirements, client security reviews, audits, and deadline-driven operating environments.
Deep practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident, major incident, problem, change, and request management, with a demonstrated ability to design, implement, and enforce these disciplines at scale.
Strong fluency with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, including dashboards, reporting, workflow configuration, and data governance.
Broad technical expertise across enterprise infrastructure, including networking, servers and virtualization, Microsoft 365 and Azure, backup and disaster recovery, endpoint management, and security operations.
Experience selecting, migrating, consolidating, and operationalizing RMM, NMS, and monitoring platforms across distributed engineering environments.
Demonstrated organizational transformation experience, including restructuring teams, implementing offshore or 24x7 follow-the-sun models, reducing resource silos, and improving utilization without compromising service quality.
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget ownership, utilization and margin management, billing reconciliation, vendor negotiation, and business-case development.
Experience reviewing and approving statements of work and partnering with sales and account management on solution design, estimation, resourcing, and pricing.
Excellent executive communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to manage difficult escalations and translate complex technical matters into clear business impact.
Proven ability to lead geographically distributed teams across time zones and cultures, with a coaching-oriented leadership style and a strong focus on measurable continuous improvement.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4, PMP, Microsoft certifications, cloud certifications, or equivalent credentials are preferred.

Benefits

Annual base salary of $185,000–$220,000 USD, with actual compensation determined by location, skills, experience, and qualifications.
Eligibility for an annual bonus.
Comprehensive medical insurance.
Dental insurance.
Vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan.
Paid Time Off (PTO).
Remote work opportunity within the United States.

NEW HIGHER SALARY RANGE! The City of Charlotte is seeking a Deputy Director, Airport/Chief Infrastructure Officer for Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) to serve as a key executive leader responsible for the strategic planning, delivery, and long-term stewardship of the aviation infrastructure program. This role provides executive oversight of capital development, engineering, maintenance, and infrastructure modernization initiatives that support one of the nation’s largest and most complex airport systems. Leading multidisciplinary teams and collaborating across internal departments and external partners, the Deputy Director ensures that infrastructure investments align with organizational priorities, operational excellence, regulatory requirements, and the long-term needs of the region’s aviation network.

Key responsibilities include:
Lead the strategic planning and execution of airport infrastructure and capital development programs.
Oversee engineering, maintenance, asset management, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Direct the delivery of complex capital projects while ensuring scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
Develop long-range infrastructure strategies that support operational growth and system resilience.
Collaborate with internal departments, regulatory agencies, consultants, and industry partners to advance key initiatives.
Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, standards, and best practices.
Manage multidisciplinary teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Represent the organization in executive discussions involving infrastructure planning, investment, and stakeholder engagement.

Qualifications

Master’s degree plus five years of experience, or bachelor’s degree plus seven years of experience is required.
Major coursework should have included an aviation-related field, business or public administration, engineering, or related field.
Must have previous experience working in an airport or aviation environment.
Experience in the program management and/ or construction management functions of airport development; in the engineering and development functions of significant airports that have managed large capital programs.
Experience managing large-scale maintenance functions including complex mechanical systems.
Demonstrated success overseeing complex, multi-million-dollar capital projects within aviation, transportation, or similarly complex public infrastructure environments.
Strong knowledge of capital planning, asset management, regulatory compliance, and financial stewardship.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, build strategic partnerships, and communicate effectively with executive stakeholders.

Salary & Compensation

NEW SALARY RANGE! The hiring salary range for this position is $240,000– $302,000, depending on qualifications and experience. jobs.title: Director, Quantitative Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Schwab Technology Services enables the future of how clients manage their money by delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions that support investing, financial planning, and wealth management. Within Schwab Asset Management Technology, you will help advance the platforms, data, and research capabilities that power investment insights and product innovation.

As a Director, Quantitative Software Engineer - Research Lead, you will partner closely with quantitative researchers, investment professionals, and technology teams to accelerate research, model development, and product delivery. You will solve complex technical challenges, design scalable research and data platforms, and transform innovative investment concepts into production-ready solutions. Success in this role requires strong collaboration, analytical thinking, adaptability, and technical leadership as you help build reusable capabilities that improve research effectiveness, support data-driven decisions, and enable the delivery of differentiated investment products across the enterprise.

What you have

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of software engineering experience developing quantitative applications, research platforms, or data-intensive solutions using Python and/or similar languages such as R, Julia, or MATLAB
Experience partnering directly with quantitative researchers, portfolio managers, or investment professionals
Experience designing, building, and supporting scalable data pipelines and analytical platforms
Knowledge of quantitative research workflows, including data acquisition, model development, backtesting, validation, and deployment
Experience designing data models, data integration solutions, and data storage architectures
Experience developing data visualization and analytical tools that support research and decision-making
Experience implementing data governance, lineage tracking, monitoring, and data quality controls
Experience balancing research flexibility with enterprise standards for reliability, reproducibility, security, and supportability
Experience with modern software engineering practices, source control, automated testing, containerization, CI/CD, and deployment automation
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives and thrive in ambiguous environments
Strong verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, or a related field
Experience productionizing quantitative models and research methodologies supporting investment products
Experience building reusable platforms, frameworks, libraries, or shared services
Experience applying AI/ML, generative AI, distributed computing, or cloud-native technologies to research and analytics challenges
Experience influencing technology strategy through investment industry and market insights
Experience developing visualization, exploratory analytics, or decision-support solutions
Demonstrated track record of innovation and continuous improvement
Experience mentoring engineers, researchers, or other technical professionals
Ability to communicate complex quantitative and technical concepts to diverse audiences
Demonstrated integrity, sound judgment, and discretion when handling sensitive information

In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Digital Engineering - 90282581
jobs.description:
Your success is a train ride away!

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. We employ more than 20,000 diverse, energetic professionals in a variety of career fields throughout the United States. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.

Are you ready to join our team?

Our values of ‘Do the Right Thing, Excel Together and Put Customers First’ are at the heart of what matters most to us, and our Core Capabilities, ‘Building Trust, Accountability, Effective Communication, Customer Focus, and Proactive Safety & Security’ are what every employee needs to know and do to be most impactful at Amtrak. By living the Amtrak values, focusing on our capabilities, and actively embracing and fostering diverse ideas, backgrounds, and perspectives, together we will honor our past and make Amtrak a company of the future.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager of Digital Engineering provides strategic and operational leadership across multiple engineering teams or a major engineering function responsible for designing, building, integrating, and maintaining complex digital platforms and capabilities. This role serves as a senior leader within the engineering organization, ensuring that multi-team engineering activities align with enterprise architecture, product strategy, security requirements, and long-term modernization objectives.

The Senior Manager owns engineering execution across a broader scope than the PL1 level, guiding teams through architectural interpretation, technical decision-making, capacity planning, and complex dependency management. The role is responsible for scaling engineering practices, implementing governance structures, and embedding operational excellence—ensuring the digital systems delivered are reliable, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned with evolving business needs.

As a people leader, the Senior Manager develops engineering talent pipelines, supports succession planning, and establishes holistic competency-driven development programs. They lead technical managers, senior engineers, and cross-functional teams, driving a unified culture across the engineering function rooted in innovation, quality, equity, accountability, and continuous learning.

The role is a key influencer in enterprise technology direction, partnering closely with Product leaders, Enterprise Architects, Security, Data, Infrastructure, and Operations teams. The Senior Manager helps shape digital transformation initiatives, supports investment planning and budget cycles, and ensures transparency in execution across programs and platforms. They serve as a critical escalation point for complex technical challenges, production incidents, and organizational impediments. Through strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic alignment, the Senior Manager ensures engineering outcomes deliver measurable business value while enabling the organization's long-term digital roadmap.

Essential Functions

Provide leadership, vision, and direction across multiple engineering teams delivering enterprise digital capabilities.
Establish and enforce engineering best practices, ensuring team adherence to coding standards, architectural principles, security requirements, and operational quality.
Lead architectural and technical reviews to ensure technical integrity and future scalability.
Track multi-team engineering performance through KPIs such as predictability, cycle time, defect rates, and reliability metrics and identify systemic delivery challenges and implement corrective actions.
Oversee SLO/SLA adherence, incident response, root-cause analysis, and production support processes.
Lead hiring, performance management, and succession planning for engineers and engineering leads.
Serve as a key liaison between engineering, architecture, product, and business leaders.
Drive efficiency and modernization through process and tooling improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
9 years of engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or people-management role.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex engineering solutions across multiple teams.
Experience with modern engineering practices (e.g., DevSecOps, CI/CD, test automation).

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in technical/business or equivalent
11+ years relevant work experience preferred
Experience delivering multiple initiatives using Scaled Agile framework methodology .
Have utilized Atlassian tools such as JIRA and Confluence

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

E xperience with AI -powered software e ngineering practices.
Knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform, web analytics, and experimentation frameworks.
Hands on e xperience with implementing solutions in AWS
Strong leadership, planning, and people management skills.
Expertise in operational excellence practices, including monitoring, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.

Environmental Conditions/Physical Demands

jobs.description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

“I can influence my income.”

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options
Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love
Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as a Senior Manager, Portfolio Construction (Software Development Manager - Senior) at Capital Group.”

As the Senior Manager for Portfolio Construction, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for the Tools and Insights capabilities within Risk-Aware Portfolio Construction (RAPC). Your teams will build the experiences that help investment professionals understand portfolio positioning, evaluate risks and opportunities, and model potential actions with confidence.

You will serve as both a strategic leader and a hands-on engineering coach, responsible for shaping the roadmap, developing talent, improving execution, and ensuring the organization delivers reliable, scalable solutions that create meaningful value for investors. You will partner closely with Product, investment professionals, and engineering leaders across IG Tech to align priorities, translate strategy into execution, and continuously evolve the capability.

A core responsibility of this role is building a high-performing engineering organization that can scale. You will strengthen operational excellence, modernize engineering practices, improve delivery predictability, and create the architectural foundations needed to support future growth. Your leadership will help RAPC evolve from a collection of capabilities into a cohesive platform that enables investors to make better-informed decisions.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for”

You have strong partnership instincts and are comfortable shaping strategy, co-owning roadmaps, and aligning technology investments with business outcomes.
You possess a deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, cloud architecture, APIs, testing, observability, security, and operational excellence.
You have experience building products that combine investor-facing experiences with underlying platforms, services, and data capabilities.
You have experience with investment workflows, portfolio construction, risk analytics, performance measurement, financial data, or other high-stakes decision-support environments.
You are able to navigate ambiguity, connect detailed execution issues to broader strategy, and synthesize complex information into clear direction.
You establish discipline and accountability while empowering teams to innovate and operate effectively.
You use agile and metrics-driven engineering practices to create transparency, improve delivery predictability, and drive accountability for outcomes.
You have strong communication skills and can engage effectively with engineers, Product, investment professionals, and senior leaders.
You develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and senior individual contributors, creating an environment where people can grow and thrive.
You take a pragmatic approach to problem solving, balancing long-term architecture with near-term business needs.

What You Will Lead

Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

Define and evolve the long-term strategy for RAPC's Tools and Insights capabilities in partnership with Product and business stakeholders.
Build and maintain a clear roadmap that balances investor value, technical sustainability, and organizational capacity.
Drive alignment across teams and capabilities to ensure delivery efforts contribute to a coherent long-term vision.

Execution & Operational Excellence

Lead engineering execution across a diverse portfolio of investor-facing tools and insight-delivery capabilities.
Use agile and metrics-driven engineering practices to improve delivery predictability, organizational effectiveness, and accountability for results.
Establish operating mechanisms that provide visibility into roadmap progress, organizational capacity, delivery health, execution risks, and outcomes.
Establish a culture of operational excellence focused on reliability, quality, performance, supportability, and continuous improvement.
Ensure teams consistently deliver solutions that are secure, maintainable, and production ready.

Engineering Excellence & Architecture

Establish scalable engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, and delivery speed, including automated testing, observability, automation, and effective production support.
Guide architectural direction across RAPC's Tools and Insights capabilities, promoting reusable components, shared platforms, and solutions that can evolve with investor and business needs.
Champion AI and agentic engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to increase productivity, strengthen quality, and enable teams to focus on higher-value work.
Ensure technical investments support both current business priorities and the long-term evolution of the platform.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner closely with Product and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and prioritize investments.
Engage directly with investment professionals to understand workflows, gather feedback, and ensure the organization remains focused on delivering meaningful outcomes.
Collaborate across IG Tech and partner organizations to deliver integrated, end-to-end capabilities that serve investors effectively.
Communicate strategy, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Culture, Talent & Leadership

Build and develop a high-performing organization grounded in trust, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Coach engineering managers and technical leaders to operate effectively across organizational boundaries and increasing levels of responsibility.
Foster a culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, constructive debate, and shared ownership of outcomes.
Create an environment where teams can do their best work while embracing modern engineering practices and continuous improvement.

Innovation & Capability Evolution

Advance RAPC's portfolio construction capabilities by delivering tools and insights that help investors evaluate opportunities and make more informed decisions.
Leverage AI and emerging technologies where they create meaningful value for investors and the firm.
Encourage experimentation while maintaining the rigor, reliability, and governance expected of investment-critical systems.

“I can apply in less than 4 minutes.”

At Capital Group, the success of the people who invest with us depends on the people in whom we invest. That’s why we offer a culture, compensation and opportunities that empower our associates to build successful and prosperous careers. Through nine decades, our goal has been to improve people’s lives through successful investing. We know that our history is a testament to the strength of the people we hire. More than 9,000 associates in 30+ offices around the world help our clients and each other grow and thrive every day. Find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Glassdoor.‎

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Robotics Manipulation
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of modern AI, and robotics is where AI meets the physical world. The Isaac robotics platform — spanning Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Isaac ROS, the foundation models behind Isaac GR00T, and the accelerated libraries that run on Jetson and in the data center — is how the world’s developers and industrial leaders build intelligent robots.

We are looking for an exceptional engineering leader and manager to head up Isaac for Manipulation: giving robotic arms and dexterous systems the perception, grasping, motion, and learned skills they need to do real, impactful work. You will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Manipulation — turning hard, contact-rich problems in manufacturing, logistics, and industrial automation into shipping capabilities that our partners and developers can build on. This is a high-visibility role with direct line of sight to the most consequential problems in robotics today. You will grow and mentor a team of world-class robotics and machine-learning engineers, set a bold technical direction, and partner deeply with the robot-arm and industrial-automation ecosystem to make NVIDIA the default platform for robotic manipulation.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead the Isaac Manipulation team. Recruit, grow, and mentor a high-performing team of robotics software engineers; set direction, raise the technical bar, and manage the team’s health, velocity, and delivery.
Shape the roadmap. Collaborate with Product Management to define and drive the strategy and roadmap for grasping, motion planning and control, perception-for-manipulation, and learned manipulation policies — from research to productized, supported platform capabilities.
Apply creative solutions to real industrial problems. Translate the hardest contact-rich manipulation tasks in manufacturing, logistics, assembly, and machine tending into robust capabilities that work in the real world, not just the lab.
Bridge research and product. Partner with NVIDIA Research, the Isaac Sim/Lab teams, and foundation-model teams (e.g., Isaac GR00T, Cosmos) to bring sim-to-real, imitation, and reinforcement learning approaches into the platform and onto physical arms.
Engage partners and developers. Serve as a technical face of Isaac Manipulation to robot-arm OEMs, system integrators, and the developer community — gathering requirements, running joint engineering, and ensuring our APIs and tools meet real workflows. Support our ecosystem of developers through responsible migration handling of their solutions built on our durable platform.
Leverage accelerated compute. Drive architecture and execution that fully uses NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and the accelerated-computing stack across simulation, training, and on-robot inference on Jetson and edge platforms.
Deliver. Drive planning and execution of complex, multi-functional programs; own quality, performance, and the real-world deployment of learned policies and manipulation stacks on physical robots.
Influence the strategy. Represent manipulation in platform-level technical and business decisions, and help shape where NVIDIA invests across the robotics stack.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ total years of relevant industry experience building robotics or robotics-adjacent systems, including 3+ years leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams.
Robotic arm depth. Hands-on expertise with robotic arms, manipulation, and physics from grasping, motion planning (across both numerical optimization and sampling-based approaches), and control (including force/impedance and contact-rich control) to perception-guided manipulation.
Accelerated compute. Working understanding of GPU-accelerated computing and modern ML infrastructure, and how to architect robotics software to take advantage of it (CUDA, PyTorch, GPU-accelerated simulation, edge inference).
Partner and developer interface. Demonstrated ability to work directly with external partners, customers, and developer communities and to translate their needs into roadmap and shipping product.
Technical credibility. Strong software engineering fundamentals (modern C++ and Python) and the ability to engage substantively in technical and architectural decisions with your team.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Industry leadership and fluency. Experience building manipulation or industrial automation products at an established robot-arm company or manipulation startup, and a strong understanding of the product landscape including use cases, the integrators, and the platforms from leading vendors.
Hardware-agnostic platforms. A track record building developer-facing or low-code platforms and tooling that abstract across multiple robot-arm brands and make manipulation accessible to non-experts.
Learned manipulation. Deep experience with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, sim-to-real transfer, or manipulation foundation models, and shipping learned policies onto real hardware.
Ecosystem & OSS. Contributions to ROS 2, ros2_control, MoveIt, or the broader robotics open-source and standards community.
Founder / 0-to-1 instincts. Experience starting or scaling a product or team from the ground up and operating with speed in ambiguous, fast-pace problem spaces.

Manipulation is one of the defining unsolved problems in robotics, and NVIDIA is uniquely positioned — across simulation, foundation models, and accelerated compute — to solve it at platform scale. You’ll lead a team that the entire robotics industry builds on, and your work will show up on factory floors and in warehouses around the world!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.
