jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

We are seeking a VP, Head of Infrastructure, Sell Side Capital Markets to lead the platforms, networks, and teams that support principal and agency trading. This leader will set infrastructure strategy, deliver secure and resilient services, and ensure that latency-sensitive trading systems perform predictably under demanding market conditions. The role requires deep technical judgment, strong governance, enterprise-wide collaboration, and the executive presence to connect technology decisions to trading outcomes, client confidence, and risk.

Key Responsibilities

Set infrastructure strategy: Own the architecture, operating model, investment roadmap, and service levels for trading infrastructure across data centers, colocation facilities, networks, compute, storage, and cloud services where appropriate.
Deliver low-latency performance: Measure and improve the path from market-data receipt through order submission and venue acknowledgment. Address tail latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, and performance under peak load—not just average response times.
Lead high-performance networking: Oversee exchange and venue connectivity, cross-connects, routing, multicast market data, bandwidth and burst capacity, time synchronization, and diagnosis of congestion or microbursts.
Support distinct trading workflows: Ensure infrastructure meets principal trading needs for pricing, quoting, hedging, position visibility, and risk limits, as well as agency trading needs for client order intake, algorithmic execution, routing, timestamps, and complete order and execution records.
Build resilience: Define recovery objectives, engineer failover, test disaster recovery under realistic conditions, and maintain readiness for market-open incidents, volume spikes, and venue disruptions.
Lead operations and incidents: Establish observability, capacity planning, on-call practices, and disciplined incident response. Communicate business impact promptly and drive corrective actions that address root causes.
Establish governance: Set standards and decision rights for architecture, service ownership, change management, access, security, vendor risk, and operational controls. Maintain transparent reporting on service health, exceptions, and risk.
Work across the organization: Partner with trading desks, product and application engineering, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, operations, finance, procurement, and client-facing teams to align priorities and resolve trade-offs.
Develop people and leaders: Build, coach, and retain multidisciplinary teams; establish clear accountability, succession plans, and a culture of collaboration and sound decision-making under pressure.
Drive continuous improvement: Use performance data, incident reviews, automation, and engineering feedback to remove recurring problems and demonstrate sustained gains in reliability, recovery, efficiency, and cost.
Guide modernization: Lead large-scale platform change and adopt DevOps, data, and AI-enabled engineering practices where they provide measurable value, with appropriate security, governance, and responsible-AI controls.
Represent infrastructure at the executive level: Present a compelling platform vision, make evidence-based investment recommendations, and provide calm, credible updates during incidents and periods of change.

Qualifications And Experience

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Professional Experience

15+ years of software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering experience, preferably in fintech, sell-side trading, electronic markets, or regulated financial services.
10+ years managing engineering teams and leaders, including responsibility for leadership pipelines, organizational development, budgets, vendor relationships, and enterprise delivery commitments.
Proven record leading large-scale, business-critical platforms and modernization programs, including AI-enabled engineering practices that deliver measurable business impact.
Experience improving availability, recovery, performance, and operational readiness for high-volume services, with specific examples of decisions made during major production incidents.
Demonstrated ability to establish effective governance and sustain improvements through clear ownership, meaningful metrics, and disciplined execution.

Trading and technical expertise

Working knowledge of principal and agency trading workflows and the different market-risk, operational, and client consequences of infrastructure failure.
Strong understanding of market data, FIX, order and execution management systems, exchange and venue connectivity, and pre- and post-trade dependencies.
Deep expertise in high-performance networks, colocation, low-latency systems, and end-to-end performance measurement, including tail latency, jitter, packet loss, and peak-load capacity.
Ability to diagnose problems across network, operating-system, application, and venue boundaries while preserving essential security, risk, and audit controls.
Broad understanding of modern platform architecture, full-stack development, APIs, integration, DevOps, data, and AI-enabled engineering, with sound judgment about their application to trading infrastructure.

Leadership and competencies

Enterprise leadership: Builds strong teams and future leaders, mobilizes people across organizational boundaries, and creates a healthy engineering and on-call culture.
Strategic judgment: Leads through complexity and converts enterprise-scale transformation into measurable outcomes while balancing speed, resilience, security, and cost.
Stakeholder Management: Aligns senior stakeholders around a clear platform vision, communicates technical and business trade-offs plainly, and remains credible under pressure.
Communication Skills: Deep technical knowledge to drive a refurbishment agenda, and communicate with that with clarity and technical depth.
Commercial and client orientation: Connects infrastructure investment, modernization, and responsible innovation to execution capability, client confidence, and business value.
Governance mindset: Drives accountability, transparency, risk management, responsible AI, and disciplined delivery across technology and operations.

What Success Looks Like

Trading teams have predictable, observable, and resilient infrastructure. Principal and agency workflows receive the performance and controls they require. Incidents are detected and contained quickly, recovery plans work when tested, and recurring issues are eliminated. Leaders across the organization understand service risks and investment priorities, while infrastructure improvements produce measurable benefits for trading, clients, and the business.

jobs.description:
At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us.

Job Title:
Director, Platform Architecture

Reports to:
Chief Digital & Data Officer

Location:
United States (Remote)

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

As the Director, Platform Architecture, you will define and scale Deckers’ modern data and analytics platform architecture, ensuring it is secure, scalable, governed, and optimized for performance and cost. You’ll establish foundational architectural frameworks, technology standards, and best practices for our cloud-native platform, with AWS as the core environment. Collaborating with data architects, platform and DevOps engineering teams, product leaders, and governance specialists, you’ll enable analytics, AI, and domain-driven data products across the enterprise through reusable platform services, robust security and access controls, and clear operational standards.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

Support the development of the enterprise data platform strategy aligned with business objectives and digital transformation initiatives
Define and maintain the architectural blueprint and reference architecture for the cloud-native data platform using AWS as the core environment
Establish principles and patterns for platform scalability, reliability, security, observability, and cost optimization across platform services and shared capabilities
Design and maintain standards for platform architecture layers including infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, audit logging, metadata management, access control, and observability
Partner with domain architects and engineering teams to ensure shared platform services are reusable, modular, and governed, and that domain teams can self-serve effectively
Guide the adoption of platform services and tools that enable data mesh, pub-sub models, event-driven architectures, and self-serve data product delivery
Lead evaluation and selection of core platform technologies and services, ensuring they meet business needs for analytics, real-time streaming, governance, and machine learning enablement
Promote architectural patterns that enable resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, and rapid delivery, including standards for automation, environment management, and operational readiness
Partner with Data Governance, Security, and Compliance teams to embed privacy, security, and audit-readiness into platform architecture and delivery practices
Define standards for metadata capture, lineage tracking, data quality measurement, and access management across platform services and tooling
Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to platform engineers, DevOps teams, and data engineering teams, including design reviews and technical guidance
Collaborate with Program Delivery, Product Management, and architecture peers to align roadmaps, sequencing, and execution plans across multiple teams
Influence platform design decisions across the organization and drive alignment to enterprise goals through standards, reference implementations, and review processes
Support vendor evaluations, licensing decisions, and long-term technology investments for the platform ecosystem, including total cost of ownership considerations

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; Master’s degree preferred
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or equivalent certifications are highly preferred
10 to 15 years of experience in platform architecture, data architecture, or enterprise systems design
5 or more years of leadership experience building or scaling cloud-native data platforms, ideally on AWS
Experience supporting modern data architectures including lakehouse models, real-time streaming, and domain-oriented data products
Experience in the retail, consumer products, or e-commerce industry is preferred but not required
Deep expertise in AWS cloud services related to data storage, compute, networking, security, and auditability, including services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lake Formation, EMR, Kinesis, IAM, VPC, and CloudTrail
Knowledge of distributed computing frameworks, modern file formats and open table standards including Parquet and Iceberg
Familiarity with governance, cataloging, lineage, and privacy frameworks and regulations including GDPR and CCPA
Deep understanding of modern cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, and data platform technologies
Strong leadership skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities in complex, fast-paced environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Ability to foster innovation, drive continuous improvement, and create scalable technical frameworks
Comfortable working in a global, matrixed organization with a proactive, results-driven approach

What We'll Give You –

Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

$154,700.00 - $208,800.00

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Robotics Manipulation
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the engine of modern AI, and robotics is where AI meets the physical world. The Isaac robotics platform — spanning Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Isaac ROS, the foundation models behind Isaac GR00T, and the accelerated libraries that run on Jetson and in the data center — is how the world’s developers and industrial leaders build intelligent robots.

We are looking for an exceptional engineering leader and manager to head up Isaac for Manipulation: giving robotic arms and dexterous systems the perception, grasping, motion, and learned skills they need to do real, impactful work. You will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Manipulation — turning hard, contact-rich problems in manufacturing, logistics, and industrial automation into shipping capabilities that our partners and developers can build on. This is a high-visibility role with direct line of sight to the most consequential problems in robotics today. You will grow and mentor a team of world-class robotics and machine-learning engineers, set a bold technical direction, and partner deeply with the robot-arm and industrial-automation ecosystem to make NVIDIA the default platform for robotic manipulation.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead the Isaac Manipulation team. Recruit, grow, and mentor a high-performing team of robotics software engineers; set direction, raise the technical bar, and manage the team’s health, velocity, and delivery.
Shape the roadmap. Collaborate with Product Management to define and drive the strategy and roadmap for grasping, motion planning and control, perception-for-manipulation, and learned manipulation policies — from research to productized, supported platform capabilities.
Apply creative solutions to real industrial problems. Translate the hardest contact-rich manipulation tasks in manufacturing, logistics, assembly, and machine tending into robust capabilities that work in the real world, not just the lab.
Bridge research and product. Partner with NVIDIA Research, the Isaac Sim/Lab teams, and foundation-model teams (e.g., Isaac GR00T, Cosmos) to bring sim-to-real, imitation, and reinforcement learning approaches into the platform and onto physical arms.
Engage partners and developers. Serve as a technical face of Isaac Manipulation to robot-arm OEMs, system integrators, and the developer community — gathering requirements, running joint engineering, and ensuring our APIs and tools meet real workflows. Support our ecosystem of developers through responsible migration handling of their solutions built on our durable platform.
Leverage accelerated compute. Drive architecture and execution that fully uses NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, and the accelerated-computing stack across simulation, training, and on-robot inference on Jetson and edge platforms.
Deliver. Drive planning and execution of complex, multi-functional programs; own quality, performance, and the real-world deployment of learned policies and manipulation stacks on physical robots.
Influence the strategy. Represent manipulation in platform-level technical and business decisions, and help shape where NVIDIA invests across the robotics stack.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
12+ total years of relevant industry experience building robotics or robotics-adjacent systems, including 3+ years leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams.
Robotic arm depth. Hands-on expertise with robotic arms, manipulation, and physics from grasping, motion planning (across both numerical optimization and sampling-based approaches), and control (including force/impedance and contact-rich control) to perception-guided manipulation.
Accelerated compute. Working understanding of GPU-accelerated computing and modern ML infrastructure, and how to architect robotics software to take advantage of it (CUDA, PyTorch, GPU-accelerated simulation, edge inference).
Partner and developer interface. Demonstrated ability to work directly with external partners, customers, and developer communities and to translate their needs into roadmap and shipping product.
Technical credibility. Strong software engineering fundamentals (modern C++ and Python) and the ability to engage substantively in technical and architectural decisions with your team.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Industry leadership and fluency. Experience building manipulation or industrial automation products at an established robot-arm company or manipulation startup, and a strong understanding of the product landscape including use cases, the integrators, and the platforms from leading vendors.
Hardware-agnostic platforms. A track record building developer-facing or low-code platforms and tooling that abstract across multiple robot-arm brands and make manipulation accessible to non-experts.
Learned manipulation. Deep experience with imitation learning, reinforcement learning, sim-to-real transfer, or manipulation foundation models, and shipping learned policies onto real hardware.
Ecosystem & OSS. Contributions to ROS 2, ros2_control, MoveIt, or the broader robotics open-source and standards community.
Founder / 0-to-1 instincts. Experience starting or scaling a product or team from the ground up and operating with speed in ambiguous, fast-pace problem spaces.

Manipulation is one of the defining unsolved problems in robotics, and NVIDIA is uniquely positioned — across simulation, foundation models, and accelerated compute — to solve it at platform scale. You’ll lead a team that the entire robotics industry builds on, and your work will show up on factory floors and in warehouses around the world!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until July 13, 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $190,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart's Distribution Platform team is developing innovative solutions and strategies that drive efficient and scalable marketing outreach, empowering us to effectively engage with our users while having a direct impact on Upstart's mission and growth. The team is responsible for some of our highest value distribution channels including digital ads, direct mail, and partner integrations. Our goal is to build an intelligent, unified system that learns, automates, and scales how Upstart engages with our customers on these channels.

As a Senior Engineering Manager at Upstart, you will play a crucial role in shaping how we drive user growth and outreach through intelligent targeting, 3P integrations, and data-heavy scalable infrastructure. You’ll be responsible for the tech behind some of our largest marketing channels and have a direct impact on the company’s performance. You will work closely with cross-functional counterparts in Analytics, Marketing, Machine Learning, and Product to create a scalable marketing platform that mobilizes Upstart’s owned channels to drive users to our products efficiently.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Define and implement an engineering roadmap that supports intelligent and scalable outreach to customers via our direct mail, digital, and partnerships platform

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing engineering team directly, focused on providing high quality solutions and incrementally enhance systems with each pull request
Leverage experimentation and data-driven insights to refine growth strategies, optimizing user outreach and conversion through continuous testing, iteration, and personalization

Experience leading product oriented teams with quantifiable user impact

Experience working on systems that integrate with 3rd parties and/or ingest, store, expose large amounts of data

Proven track record of leading and growing engineering teams

Skilled in scaling systems in both a technical and organizational capacity

The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

Position Description

About Harris County and Universal Services:

Harris County Universal Services is transforming the way the County does business and seeking a Director, Integrated Justice to join our team.

Universal Services is the enterprise IT solutions center for the departments and offices of Harris County, providing Information Technology, Public Safety and Justice Technologies, 311 Constituent Engagement Services, Fleet Services, and Records and Information Governance Services.

Harris County is the third largest and most diverse county in the nation, with a population of more than 4.7 million. Harris County Commissioners Court, the County’s governing body, directs a budget of more than $4 billion providing essential services including flood control, infrastructure, healthcare, housing, and justice administration.

This is a great time to join Universal Services as we enhance critical services to Harris County residents and internal customers.

The Director will be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the Integrated Justice (JWEB) application and for hiring and supervising the dedicated staff of the Integrated Justice Technology Division (IJTD) within the Universal Services Department (US). The IJTD Director will provide transparency into operations and project delivery of IJIS through regular reporting to the Integrated Justice Technology Committee Board of Directors. The position will be managed by IJTC Board and overseen administratively by the Chief Information Officer.

The IJTD Director brings a current knowledge and future vision of leveraging information and technology within a multifaceted program of information technology services for Harris County's justice, public safety, and court systems.

Leads the full systems life cycle and is responsible for the project management, development, testing, and maintenance of IJIS.
Collaborates with Universal Services - Information Technology teams and justice stakeholders - to identify system requirements and priorities to ensure the timely delivery of solutions and that applications meet business needs.
Works to develop a strategy for modernizing IJIS by consulting functional leaders across the US organization and IJTC Board to identify business and technology needs and optimize the use of information technology.
Ensures data integrity and system availability through proper approvals, maintenance, planning, and support.
Identifies system risks and issues by performing root cause analysis and develops post-analysis recommendations for Harris County Commissioner's Court and IJTC Board.
Develops, manages, and tracks the IJIS annual budget.
Serves as the primary point of contact to the IJTC Board and key stakeholders while adhering to the existing US processes and standards for implementing and supporting applications.
Manages a team of IT professionals, including recruitment, training, and performance evaluation.
Maintains the highest ethical standards by consistently demonstrating honesty, integrity, respect, and confidentiality, while also adhering to Harris County and departmental policies and procedures.

Responsible for developing departmental budget inputs to include process and capability improvements and managing the final approved budget throughout the fiscal year.
Conduct personnel evaluations and one-on-ones with team members at regular intervals to:
Develop personalized growth & development plans, as well as appropriate annual goals
Track performance to aforementioned plans and goals
Ensure team member concerns are being appropriately addressed

Partner with Human Resources to promote a “people first” culture and resolve all personnel-related matters in a timely fashion.
Foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity, sharing, out-of-the-box thinking and seeing the big-picture.
Human Resource-based responsibilities as needed include but are not limited to:
Review and approval of individual timecards, time-off requests, and expense reports
Creation and enaction of Performance Improvement Plans
Manage team members required company-level training plans
Facilitating knowledge transfer on policies & procedures between HR / Stress teams

Execute other duties as required by Virgin Galactic senior leadership to support company and program objectives.
Work collaboratively to achieve goals and/or complete assigned tasks

Required Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s Degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) discipline 8+ years of experience of relevant experience related to Stress or Stress-adjacent relevant disciplines.
5+ years of demonstrated leadership experience.
Excellent knowledge of aerospace stress practices including component acceptance and qualification, structural validation, environmental stressing, instrumentation, and data acquisition
Experience in Fatigue and Damage Tolerance substantiation
Experience in composite fabrication, design, and analysis processes.
Experience with Full Scale testing of primary structure in a FAR 23/25 or DoD environment
Proven analytical skills in stress relevant engineering areas
Demonstrated proficiency using FEMAP and NASTRAN
Strong schedule management skills and understanding of schedule relationship to scope and cost
Team player with straight up effective communication and good interpersonal skills with the proven ability to lead, motivate and build teams
Effective organizational skills, capable of effectively juggling and completing multiple tasks across different disciplines and programs
Highly autonomous with effective delegation skills
Experience moderating difficult situations and conflict resolution
Experience coaching, mentoring and developing the critical skills of others
Experience leading geographically dispersed / virtual teams
Experience leading a team through change
Ability to build effective relationships
Must be self-motivated and capable of working with minimal supervision, adaptable to changing environments and handle multiple tasks and/or projects simultaneously
Encourages other employees to do the same and leads by exemplary service.
Demonstrate willingness to adjust thinking and behavior.
Ability to communicate in a manner that is timely, respectful, and open to other ideas

Preferred Skills And Experience

Familiarity with space flight vehicles, rocket propulsion systems, and components.
Knowledge of FAA Part 23 and 25 FARs.
Spacecraft and launch vehicle structural analysis, design, build, and test experience
Experience with dynamic (modal) testing and correlation of structures
Experience with instrumentation for ground and flight tests
Experience with mathematical modeling, simulation, and control algorithms.
Experience developing structural integrity procedures or manuals.

jobs.description:
Come lead one of our product engineering teams! The team is responsible for our core user workflow and data orchestration platform. You'll own engineering execution end to end: roadmap sequencing with Product, project scoping, timeline accountability, and cross-functional progress communication. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Product and Engineering, ensuring the team builds the right things in the right order, at the pace the business demands. You'll drive engineering hiring end-to-end: headcount planning, JDs, interview loops, and closing. 
What you'll own:

-Team Building & Development: Hire, onboard, and develop a growing team of engineers. 
-Create a culture of high standards, ownership, and craft  
-Own the delivery system: project scoping, milestone planning, timeline accountability, and stakeholder communication. 
-Ensure the team ships on time, with consistency and quality, across the core product, integrations, and platform. 
-Partner with staff engineers and tech leads who own technical decisions and architecture. 
-Work closely with Product and Design to triage, prioritize, and sequence work. 
-Serve as the escalation point for customer-impacting engineering issues and coordinate resolution with CS and Product. 
-Incident & Production Management 
-Own the team's on-call posture, incident response process, and post-mortems. 
-Drive improvements that reduce recurrence and increase system reliability. 
What you need:

-10+ yrs in software engineering, including meaningful time as an IC and as an Engineering Manager. 
-5+ yrs as an individual contributor engineer, with a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems 
-5+ yrs managing engineering teams that have a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems
-Proven track record of growing and scaling an engineering organization, ideally from a small team to 20-30+ engineers. 
-Experience at an early-stage startup   
-You coach actively, give direct feedback, and create an environment where people grow fast and do their best work.  
-Building and shipping software for enterprise customers 
-Building with leading fintech APIs (Plaid, Stripe, etc). 
-Building APIs-as-a-product and/or B2B products. 
-Building data-intensive B2B platforms particularly systems that orchestrate, sync, or transform data across third-party integrations. 
-Experience founding or building something from scratch at a company, a product, or a meaningful side project. 
-Experience with AI prompting, models, and tools 
-Experience with our tech stack: Backend: Golang, Postgres, AWS, Messaging, Protobuf, gRPC, Redis, GitHub Actions, Containerization, Terraform Frontend: React, Node, Fastify, MUI, React Query, Vite, Storybook, Playwright
Benefits

Competitive salary and equity options
High-quality benefits package including 100% company-paid insurance premiums for family coverage (medical, vision, dental).
401K, HSA & FSA plans
OneMedical, HealthAdvocate, TalkSpace, Teladoc memberships
Technology stipend
Unlimited PTO
Paid parental leave
Office space in San Francisco and New York for in-person working

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.
Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.
But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.
We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.
We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.
Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive.
If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection
. We offer hybrid and remote work models
based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role.
We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported. Please note that the interview process does require an onsite round in person.

What You’ll Do

As an Engineering Manager, you'll be responsible for leading a team of engineers in the design, development, and implementation of our products. You'll play a key role in guiding the technical direction of our projects, ensuring the highest quality of engineering work, and supporting the professional growth of your team members.
Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development support
Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment
Own your team’s delivery, quality and timely execution
Guide key technical decisions around new product initiatives
Work closely with other departments, including product, design, and QA, to align engineering activities with company objectives
Continuously evaluate and improve engineering processes and practices to enhance team efficiency and product quality
Assist in recruiting, onboarding, and training new engineering team members

What You’ll Bring

7+ years in software development with at least 3 years of engineering leadership experience
You have built and developed an impactful team of passionate engineers
You are able to tackle sophisticated engineering problems that deliver results which help the team to achieve its objectives
You’re passionate about being in a product-focused environment where everyone cares deeply about customer impact

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered

Enjoy the flexibility of remote work
Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.
Flexible PTO
Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.
Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.
Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing In Your Future (and Present)

401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.
Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.
Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.
After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.
Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.

Most importantly, we have a stellar team of coworkers, a really cool office, and lots of fun activities!

We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking an Associate Managing Director, Federal Services - GovCloud Technology Lead to join our Advisory Federal Services organization.

Responsibilities:

Lead day-to-day engineering, operations, reliability, and performance of the organizations cloud IT infrastructure current deployment on Azure Government/Government Community Cloud (GCC) High
Direct cloud engineering and operations teams to implement standardized, automated, and secure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices
Oversee security operations integration, including vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, incident response, and protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and other regulated data
Define and report operational KPIs, SLAs, and cloud cost optimization metrics to executive leadership and enterprise stakeholders
Partner with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, contracts, and program teams to align cloud operations with federal customer mission requirements and the enterprise strategy
Maintain continuous compliance with NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, and DFARS requirements, including ATO support, audit readiness, and POA&M remediation
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum fifteen years of recent experience in IT infrastructure or cloud operations, including twelve plus years in hands-on cloud engineering and leading technical teams
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required; preferred concentration in business, finance, or economics
Relevant certifications preferred, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Professional-level, CISSP, CCSP, or CMMC Certified Professional (CCP)
Proficiency with automation and IaC tools (for example, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines), containerization, and cloud-native monitoring and security tooling
Deep experience architecting and operating government cloud environments (Azure GCC High, AWS GovCloud, GCP Assured Workloads), including understanding of DoD Impact Levels (IL2–IL5)
Strong working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, 800-171, and 800-37 (RMF), FedRAMP, CMMC 2.0, FISMA, and ITAR/CUI handling requirements
Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa), with the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance (active Secret or higher preferred)

“I can succeed as a Senior Manager, Portfolio Construction (Software Development Manager - Senior) at Capital Group.”

As the Senior Manager for Portfolio Construction, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for the Tools and Insights capabilities within Risk-Aware Portfolio Construction (RAPC). Your teams will build the experiences that help investment professionals understand portfolio positioning, evaluate risks and opportunities, and model potential actions with confidence.

You will serve as both a strategic leader and a hands-on engineering coach, responsible for shaping the roadmap, developing talent, improving execution, and ensuring the organization delivers reliable, scalable solutions that create meaningful value for investors. You will partner closely with Product, investment professionals, and engineering leaders across IG Tech to align priorities, translate strategy into execution, and continuously evolve the capability.

A core responsibility of this role is building a high-performing engineering organization that can scale. You will strengthen operational excellence, modernize engineering practices, improve delivery predictability, and create the architectural foundations needed to support future growth. Your leadership will help RAPC evolve from a collection of capabilities into a cohesive platform that enables investors to make better-informed decisions.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for”

You have strong partnership instincts and are comfortable shaping strategy, co-owning roadmaps, and aligning technology investments with business outcomes.
You possess a deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, cloud architecture, APIs, testing, observability, security, and operational excellence.
You have experience building products that combine investor-facing experiences with underlying platforms, services, and data capabilities.
You have experience with investment workflows, portfolio construction, risk analytics, performance measurement, financial data, or other high-stakes decision-support environments.
You are able to navigate ambiguity, connect detailed execution issues to broader strategy, and synthesize complex information into clear direction.
You establish discipline and accountability while empowering teams to innovate and operate effectively.
You use agile and metrics-driven engineering practices to create transparency, improve delivery predictability, and drive accountability for outcomes.
You have strong communication skills and can engage effectively with engineers, Product, investment professionals, and senior leaders.
You develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and senior individual contributors, creating an environment where people can grow and thrive.
You take a pragmatic approach to problem solving, balancing long-term architecture with near-term business needs.

What You Will Lead

Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

Define and evolve the long-term strategy for RAPC's Tools and Insights capabilities in partnership with Product and business stakeholders.
Build and maintain a clear roadmap that balances investor value, technical sustainability, and organizational capacity.
Drive alignment across teams and capabilities to ensure delivery efforts contribute to a coherent long-term vision.

Execution & Operational Excellence

Lead engineering execution across a diverse portfolio of investor-facing tools and insight-delivery capabilities.
Use agile and metrics-driven engineering practices to improve delivery predictability, organizational effectiveness, and accountability for results.
Establish operating mechanisms that provide visibility into roadmap progress, organizational capacity, delivery health, execution risks, and outcomes.
Establish a culture of operational excellence focused on reliability, quality, performance, supportability, and continuous improvement.
Ensure teams consistently deliver solutions that are secure, maintainable, and production ready.

Engineering Excellence & Architecture

Establish scalable engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, and delivery speed, including automated testing, observability, automation, and effective production support.
Guide architectural direction across RAPC's Tools and Insights capabilities, promoting reusable components, shared platforms, and solutions that can evolve with investor and business needs.
Champion AI and agentic engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to increase productivity, strengthen quality, and enable teams to focus on higher-value work.
Ensure technical investments support both current business priorities and the long-term evolution of the platform.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner closely with Product and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and prioritize investments.
Engage directly with investment professionals to understand workflows, gather feedback, and ensure the organization remains focused on delivering meaningful outcomes.
Collaborate across IG Tech and partner organizations to deliver integrated, end-to-end capabilities that serve investors effectively.
Communicate strategy, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Culture, Talent & Leadership

Build and develop a high-performing organization grounded in trust, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Coach engineering managers and technical leaders to operate effectively across organizational boundaries and increasing levels of responsibility.
Foster a culture that encourages curiosity, innovation, constructive debate, and shared ownership of outcomes.
Create an environment where teams can do their best work while embracing modern engineering practices and continuous improvement.

Innovation & Capability Evolution

Advance RAPC's portfolio construction capabilities by delivering tools and insights that help investors evaluate opportunities and make more informed decisions.
Leverage AI and emerging technologies where they create meaningful value for investors and the firm.
Encourage experimentation while maintaining the rigor, reliability, and governance expected of investment-critical systems.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering Lead (PL)
jobs.description:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Schwab is looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development & Engineering (PL) to lead multiple Agile and Lean engineering teams supporting large-scale, business-critical technology platforms. In this role, you will translate business priorities into clear engineering objectives, guide delivery execution, improve platform reliability, and strengthen operational excellence across teams.

You will partner closely with product, architecture, SRE, QA, program management, finance, talent acquisition, business stakeholders, and adjacent engineering groups to deliver cohesive outcomes. This role is ideal for a people leader and technical leader who can operate across strategy and execution, build trusted partnerships, develop engineering talent, and lead teams through platform modernization and responsible GenAI adoption.

Your leadership will help teams improve quality, reduce operational toil, modernize legacy platforms, and deliver reliable technology outcomes that support Schwab’s clients, business partners, and long-term technology strategy.

What you have

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated Engineering Management experience leading multiple software engineering teams responsible for platform delivery, modernization, operational support, and production ownership
Ability to provide Technical Leadership by guiding technical direction, influencing architecture decisions, improving engineering standards, and helping teams navigate complex tradeoffs
Strong Systems Engineering capability, including understanding scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable platforms across applications, services, dependencies, and data flows
Experience leading disciplined Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices across planning, delivery, testing, validation, documentation, deployment, and operational readiness
Ability to use Generative AI or AI-assisted engineering practices responsibly to improve planning, delivery, quality, documentation, automation, modernization, and operational efficiency
Strong Stakeholder Management skills, including the ability to align product, architecture, SRE, QA, program management, finance, business partners, and engineering teams around shared outcomes
Demonstrated ability to develop managers, technical leads, and engineers through coaching, mentorship, feedback, career development, and talent planning
Strong technical judgment, business acumen, communication skills, and ability to make data-informed decisions in complex or ambiguous environments

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with large-scale software systems using modern engineering technologies such as Java, .NET, cloud platforms, containers, microservices, relational databases, NoSQL, and messaging platforms
Experience leading teams in a large, complex organization, including onshore and offshore delivery models
Experience improving operational health through KPIs, SLAs, production readiness, monitoring, documentation, and continuous improvement
Experience leading platform modernization, including legacy system analysis, modernization assessment, migration planning, validation, deployment, and adoption of modern engineering practices
Familiarity with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools
Experience building mechanisms that scale adoption and knowledge sharing, such as champion forums, reusable practices, playbooks, or team learning communities

Learning Opportunities

In this role, you will continue strengthening your leadership across enterprise-scale platform delivery, modernization strategy, operational excellence, and responsible GenAI adoption. You will have the opportunity to deepen your experience leading multiple engineering teams, improving platform health, and shaping engineering practices that influence how technology teams deliver at scale.

You will also expand your ability to apply GenAI across the full SDLC, including planning, quality, documentation, automation, operational toil reduction, and modernization. Through cross-functional partnerships, you will gain broader exposure to business-critical technology platforms, enterprise architecture direction, SRE practices, QA strategy, and business stakeholder alignment.

Skill Development Values

At Schwab, skills are developed through meaningful work, mentorship, training, collaboration, and continuous learning. This role offers the opportunity to grow as a leader who develops others, builds trust across teams, and helps engineers apply technology in ways that create measurable business impact.

"In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities."

What’s in it for you

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
Paid parental leave and family building benefits
Tuition reimbursement
Health, dental, and vision insurance

jobs.title: Vice President, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Vice President, Infrastructure & Engineering provides executive leadership for the strategy, design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise infrastructure and technology operations. The role leads infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud operations, digital workplace services, service management and design, production and support operations, and technology operations with an end-to-end systems perspective. This leader establishes multi-year priorities, service-level objectives, operating standards, and investment roadmaps that advance reliability, security, operational resilience, automation, scalability, cost effectiveness, and the employee and developer experience while aligning infrastructure decisions to enterprise business risk and value.

This role will require you to be onsite at least 3 days per week.

Responsibilities

Establish and execute the enterprise infrastructure and engineering strategy, operating model, roadmaps, standards, capacity plans, and investment priorities in alignment with business growth, risk tolerance, and technology objectives.
Provide executive leadership across infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud operations, digital workplace services, service management and design, production and support operations, and technology operations, applying end-to-end systems thinking across infrastructure, network, security, application, and cloud dependencies.
Own operational excellence for critical services by establishing meaningful SLOs, SLAs, service-performance measures, observability, and incident and problem management practices; lead calmly through high-severity events with clear stakeholder communication, timely escalation, and accountable follow-through.
Lead the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of secure, resilient, and scalable enterprise infrastructure, infrastructure applications, next-generation platforms, and production support capabilities; embed security and applicable control requirements into architecture, engineering, and operating decisions.
Drive infrastructure modernization through cloud and container platforms, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation and orchestration, self-service and self-healing capabilities, tooling consolidation, and reduction of manual operational toil to improve consistency, speed, and developer experience.
Oversee enterprise disaster recovery and technology continuity capabilities, including critical-service prioritization, recovery objectives, architecture, documentation, and recurring tests and exercises that identify gaps and drive measurable improvement.
Establish governance for capacity, asset and lifecycle management, service performance, change and release management, vendor risk, operational controls, runbooks, architecture documentation, change records, and knowledge management; balance the pace of change with reliability and stability.

Communicate infrastructure strategy, priorities, risks, service performance, incident impacts, trade-offs, and investment needs to executive stakeholders and governance forums, framing recommendations in terms of business continuity, customer and employee outcomes, risk reduction, and enterprise value while monitoring relevant market and technology trends.

Executive leadership of multiple infrastructure and operations disciplines through director-level leaders, including accountability for reliable service delivery, operational resilience, leadership capability, and sustainable operating practices.
Accountability for translating enterprise technology strategy and anticipated business demand into an executable infrastructure roadmap, operating priorities, service-level commitments, capacity plans, and investment recommendations.
Authority to recommend and prioritize investments, allocate resources within approved plans, establish functional standards and controls, direct major-incident response, govern vendor performance and escalation, and escalate material operational and technology risks.
Enterprise influence across technology domains and business functions, including layers outside the role’s direct ownership, where infrastructure platforms, applications, networks, cloud services, security, continuity, cost, and delivery outcomes are interdependent.
