jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $190,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. jobs.description:
At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Together, Every Step is how we continue to deliver exceptional business results, experience an amazing place to work, and have a positive impact on the communities and world around us.

Job Title:
Director, Platform Architecture

Reports to:
Chief Digital & Data Officer

Location:
United States (Remote)

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

As the Director, Platform Architecture, you will define and scale Deckers’ modern data and analytics platform architecture, ensuring it is secure, scalable, governed, and optimized for performance and cost. You’ll establish foundational architectural frameworks, technology standards, and best practices for our cloud-native platform, with AWS as the core environment. Collaborating with data architects, platform and DevOps engineering teams, product leaders, and governance specialists, you’ll enable analytics, AI, and domain-driven data products across the enterprise through reusable platform services, robust security and access controls, and clear operational standards.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

Support the development of the enterprise data platform strategy aligned with business objectives and digital transformation initiatives
Define and maintain the architectural blueprint and reference architecture for the cloud-native data platform using AWS as the core environment
Establish principles and patterns for platform scalability, reliability, security, observability, and cost optimization across platform services and shared capabilities
Design and maintain standards for platform architecture layers including infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, audit logging, metadata management, access control, and observability
Partner with domain architects and engineering teams to ensure shared platform services are reusable, modular, and governed, and that domain teams can self-serve effectively
Guide the adoption of platform services and tools that enable data mesh, pub-sub models, event-driven architectures, and self-serve data product delivery
Lead evaluation and selection of core platform technologies and services, ensuring they meet business needs for analytics, real-time streaming, governance, and machine learning enablement
Promote architectural patterns that enable resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, and rapid delivery, including standards for automation, environment management, and operational readiness
Partner with Data Governance, Security, and Compliance teams to embed privacy, security, and audit-readiness into platform architecture and delivery practices
Define standards for metadata capture, lineage tracking, data quality measurement, and access management across platform services and tooling
Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to platform engineers, DevOps teams, and data engineering teams, including design reviews and technical guidance
Collaborate with Program Delivery, Product Management, and architecture peers to align roadmaps, sequencing, and execution plans across multiple teams
Influence platform design decisions across the organization and drive alignment to enterprise goals through standards, reference implementations, and review processes
Support vendor evaluations, licensing decisions, and long-term technology investments for the platform ecosystem, including total cost of ownership considerations

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; Master’s degree preferred
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or equivalent certifications are highly preferred
10 to 15 years of experience in platform architecture, data architecture, or enterprise systems design
5 or more years of leadership experience building or scaling cloud-native data platforms, ideally on AWS
Experience supporting modern data architectures including lakehouse models, real-time streaming, and domain-oriented data products
Experience in the retail, consumer products, or e-commerce industry is preferred but not required
Deep expertise in AWS cloud services related to data storage, compute, networking, security, and auditability, including services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Lake Formation, EMR, Kinesis, IAM, VPC, and CloudTrail
Knowledge of distributed computing frameworks, modern file formats and open table standards including Parquet and Iceberg
Familiarity with governance, cataloging, lineage, and privacy frameworks and regulations including GDPR and CCPA
Deep understanding of modern cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, and data platform technologies
Strong leadership skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities in complex, fast-paced environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Ability to foster innovation, drive continuous improvement, and create scalable technical frameworks
Comfortable working in a global, matrixed organization with a proactive, results-driven approach

What We'll Give You –

Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

$154,700.00 - $208,800.00

Goleta, California (Remote)

Individual pay will be determined by location and additional factors, including job related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Diversity and inclusion are key to our success. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds who share a passion for our brands. We welcome qualified applicants regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, mental or physical disability, medical condition and all the other beautiful parts of your identity.

jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking an Associate Managing Director, Federal Services - GovCloud Technology Lead to join our Advisory Federal Services organization.

Responsibilities:

Lead day-to-day engineering, operations, reliability, and performance of the organizations cloud IT infrastructure current deployment on Azure Government/Government Community Cloud (GCC) High
Direct cloud engineering and operations teams to implement standardized, automated, and secure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices
Oversee security operations integration, including vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, incident response, and protection of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and other regulated data
Define and report operational KPIs, SLAs, and cloud cost optimization metrics to executive leadership and enterprise stakeholders
Partner with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, contracts, and program teams to align cloud operations with federal customer mission requirements and the enterprise strategy
Maintain continuous compliance with NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, and DFARS requirements, including ATO support, audit readiness, and POA&M remediation
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum fifteen years of recent experience in IT infrastructure or cloud operations, including twelve plus years in hands-on cloud engineering and leading technical teams
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required; preferred concentration in business, finance, or economics
Relevant certifications preferred, such as AWS/Azure/GCP Professional-level, CISSP, CCSP, or CMMC Certified Professional (CCP)
Proficiency with automation and IaC tools (for example, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines), containerization, and cloud-native monitoring and security tooling

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $190,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Job Description

When you mentor and advise multiple technical teams and move financial technologies forward, it's a big challenge with big impact. You were made for this.

As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Commercial and Investment bank Digital & Platform Services, Data Analytics, you serve in a leadership role by providing technical coaching and advisory for multiple technical teams, as well as anticipate the needs and potential dependencies of other functions within the firm. As an expert in your field, your insights influence budget and technical considerations to advance operational efficiencies and functionalities.

JPMorganChase is hiring top talent to join the growing Commercial & Investment Bank Technology organization within Digital & Platform Services / Data Analytics, building production AI agents on NEO that leverage the firm's scale, data, and full-service advantage to deliver measurable impact across the Commercial & Investment Bank and Payments. As a Senior AI Application Engineer, you'll design, productionize, and operate LLM-powered agents on NEO (the firm's agent runtime PaaS on AWS/Azure), partnering closely with business, product, and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

Job Responsibilities

Provide overall direction, oversight, and coaching for a team of entry-level to mid-level software engineers that work on basic to moderately complex tasks
Accountable for decisions that influence teams' resources, budget, tactical operations, and the execution and implementation of processes and procedures
Design and ship production agents on NEO across the federated portfolio, owning them from prototype through production.
Build retrieval that holds up in production: Graph RAG combining knowledge-graph traversal with vector search, plus chunking, ranking, and grounding strategies that keep answers accurate and auditable.
Design agent memory: episodic and semantic memory organized as memory nodes, with recall, summarization, and decay policies tuned per use case.
Own organizational context management — assembling entitlement-, lineage-, and tenant-aware context so each agent reasons over only what it's allowed to see.
Compose multi-agent workflows using A2A, and integrate tools and data through MCP servers (Bitbucket, Confluence, Databricks, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Splunk).
Build and run evals: task-level and end-to-end agent evaluations, regression suites, LLM-as-judge, and quality/safety gating before release.
Deploy and operate solutions on public cloud (AWS and, or Azure) with strong SDLC, security, resiliency, and observability practices.
Partner with product and business partners across CIB and Payments to turn use cases into shipped, supported agents.
Provides input to leadership regarding budget, approach, and technical considerations to improve operational efficiencies and functionality for the team

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience . In addition, 2 + years of experience leading technologists to manage and solve complex technical items within your domain of expertise
Experience leading teams of technologists
Ability to guide and coach teams on approach to achieve goals aligned against a set of strategic initiatives
Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability

Deep proficiency with Kubernetes and Amazon EKS, micro-VM isolation (e.g., Firecracker, Kata Containers, gVisor), and sidecar architectures, with proven experience designing defense in depth across the stack: network and mTLS, workload identity, fine-grained authorization, runtime isolation for untrusted or adversarial workloads, and application-level guardrails
Practical RAG experience — retrieval quality, embeddings, and vector stores; Expert knowledge of at least one of: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes.
Knowledge of data management and data model design; real-time processing using both SQL (e.g., Postgres) and NoSQL stores (e.g., OpenSearch, Redis).

MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience with agent frameworks or runtimes, A2A, or MCP. Agent memory design (memory nodes, episodic/semantic memory) and organizational context management.
Knowledge graphs and graph databases used for retrieval. Graph RAG a strong plus.
Understanding of LLM fine-tuning and small language model inference.
Ability to develop full-stack products using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (e.g., Next.js, Svelte) for agent UIs (AG-UI , NEO UI SDK).
Experience working in the financial or payments domain at a large institution (Investment Banking, Markets, Securities Services, or adjacent).
Knowledge of high-performance languages such as Go or Rust

Enterprise Implementation & Delivery Leadership

Own end-to-end delivery for complex customer implementations, from planning through go live and handoff.

Ensure implementation readiness across environments, integrations, testing, and operational support.
Drive high-quality UAT execution, cutover planning, and post–go-live stabilization.

Custom Engineering & Technical Oversight

Frontend: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript

Generate test cases and performance benchmarks.

Demonstrated expertise in Enterprise Architecture/System Design to design scalable services, architecture patterns, and modern platforms that support high-volume enterprise applications and business growth.
Designs enterprise-level services, systems, and architecture patterns, including working knowledge of Domain Driven Design.
Proven ability to leverage C#/.NET Core to build, modernize, and enhance enterprise applications while maintaining reliability, maintainability, and performance.

Proven expertise in RESTful Services/API Development to enable secure, scalable integrations across internal and external platforms.
Strong SQL and Relational Database Development skills used to support transaction processing, data aggregation, and backend service integration.

Experience applying Domain Driven Design principles to enterprise application architecture.
Experience with modern authentication and authorization frameworks, including OAuth 2, SAML, and JWT.
Experience implementing web accessibility standards and inclusive user experiences.
Experience utilizing test-driven and behavior-driven development approaches to improve software quality.
Experience participating in Agile and Scrum-based software delivery teams.
Passion for evaluating emerging technologies and translating innovation into measurable business value.

At Schwab, we believe skills are developed through meaningful work, mentorship, training, and continuous learning. Expand your expertise in enterprise-scale platform modernization and architecture leadership.
Gain hands-on experience evaluating and operationalizing emerging AI development tools and frameworks.
Strengthen skills in large-scale distributed application design, performance tuning, and resiliency engineering.
Develop deeper expertise in modern security, API integration, and cloud-ready engineering practices.
Learn from experienced technical leaders who support knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and professional growth.
Contribute to challenging, meaningful work that directly impacts millions of Schwab clients and participants.

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. Chief Digital & Data Officer

Company Overview

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

Role Summary

At Amperesand, the Test Engineering leader owns the manufacturing test and product validation of our Solid State Transformer (SST). You will lead a team of technical experts who design, build, validate, and deploy the test systems that ensure our high-voltage power electronics hardware and firmware work flawlessly across prototype, pre-production, and volume production stages. You own the test system uptime, timely delivery, and the operational health of the test lab. You will partner closely with the program management team and cross-functional teams across EE design, ME design, and firmware to bring rigor, speed, and reliability to everything we ship.

Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of test engineers responsible for manufacturing test and product validation of high-voltage power electronics products.
Provide technical guidance and set direction on test architecture, methodology, and execution while empowering engineers to own their domains.
Own the end-to-end strategy and execution for manufacturing test and product validation, including test coverage, accuracy, cycle time, cost, and scalability for volume production.
Oversee the design, build, validation, and deployment of test systems for high-voltage, high-current power electronics, ensuring systems are delivered on time and meet performance targets.
Ensure high test system uptime across prototype labs, pre-production, and manufacturing environments. Design a structure to drive rapid response and root-cause resolution when testers go down and establish preventive maintenance and reliability practices.
Own the test lab - its layout, equipment, calibration cadence, safety standards, capacity planning, and day-to-day operations.
Drive the definition of manufacturing test specifications for volume production, partnering with operations, design, quality, and reliability teams.
Partner with the program management team to plan resources and align on milestones, dependencies, and deliverables across the broader engineering organization.
Collaborate closely with EE design, ME design, and firmware teams to influence DFT, investigate failures, and drive product improvements from first principles.
Drive continuous improvement of test efficiency, coverage, and automation — championing investments in tooling and automated test infrastructure that scale with volume.
Establish frameworks for test requirements decomposition, acceptance criteria, and program execution that scale with the company.

Qualifications

BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
10+ years of engineering experience in test engineering, validation, or power electronics hardware development, with at least 4 years in a people-leadership role managing technical teams.
Strong hands-on background in test engineering for power electronics, including high-voltage, high-power conversion systems.
Solid understanding of PCBA schematics, hardware debug, and the use of oscilloscopes, multimeters, power analyzers, and other lab instrumentation.
Proven track record leading the design, build, and deployment of manufacturing test systems and product validation programs, ideally from prototype through volume production.
Demonstrated success running and scaling a test lab, including managing uptime, calibration, safety, and capacity.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional partners in EE design, ME design, firmware, manufacturing, and program management.
Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical talent; able to provide credible technical guidance to senior and staff engineers.
Ability to drive action grounded in first-principles thinking, with entrepreneurial ownership in a high-growth environment.
Willingness to travel up to 10%, including internationally.

Please note:
This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.

SF Pay Range

$190,000—$230,000 USD

Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection

As part of our commitment to protecting confidential and proprietary information, candidates should not disclose or provide Amperesand with any confidential, proprietary, or trade secret information belonging to a current or former employer or any other third party during the application or interview process.

Please do not submit or present employer-owned source code, schematics, designs, technical documentation, internal presentations, customer information, prototypes, or other confidential materials. Candidates should discuss their experience and accomplishments at an appropriate level and use only information and materials they are authorized to share.

You will lead, coach, and collaborate with a team of senior analysts and directors to architect solutions for agency-wide innovation across data engineering, modern machine learning models, autonomous agents, and enterprise measurement analytics.

Methods+Mastery is actively committed to increasing our team’s diversity, aggressively eliminating systemic barriers to equity, and fostering a culture where different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and celebrated. jobs.title: AWS Platform Operations Lead, Vice President
jobs.description:
State Street is seeking a visionary AWS Federated Platform Operations Lead to lead the evolution of cloud operations toward an intelligent, automated, and AI-enabled operating model.

This role is responsible for the operational strategy, reliability, resiliency, observability, security operations governance, and operational transformation of the AWS Federated platform. The successful candidate will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, AI, and Enterprise Operations teams to deliver a secure, resilient, scalable, and highly automated cloud platform supporting the firm's most critical business workloads.

This is not a traditional infrastructure operations leadership role. Instead, the AWS Federated Platform Operations Lead will drive the next generation of cloud operations by leveraging AI, agentic workflows, automation, operational intelligence, reliability engineering, and platform-based support models to improve service quality, reduce operational risk, and accelerate innovation.

The role serves as a key member of the AWS Federated leadership team and will play a pivotal role in shaping the future multi-cloud operating model across State Street.

Key Responsibilities

Define and Execute the Cloud Operations Strategy

Develop and execute the long-term operational vision and roadmap for AWS Federated.
Establish operational standards, governance frameworks, and service management practices aligned with enterprise objectives.
Drive continuous improvement in operational maturity, platform reliability, customer experience, and service quality.
Partner with engineering leaders to integrate operability, observability, resiliency, and supportability into platform design decisions.
Influence enterprise cloud operating model strategy and operational transformation initiatives.

Lead the Transformation to AI-Powered Operations

Drive adoption of Agentic AI capabilities across cloud operations and platform management.
Establish a roadmap for autonomous cloud operations utilizing AI agents, automation, and operational intelligence platforms.
Implement AI-enabled capabilities for:
Incident correlation
Root cause analysis
Capacity forecasting
Operational insights
Risk identification
Automated remediation

Develop AI-powered operational assistants that improve engineering productivity and accelerate troubleshooting.
Partner with AI platform teams to operationalize emerging capabilities including foundation models, operational copilots, workflow orchestration, and intelligent automation.
Establish governance, controls, and guardrails for the responsible adoption of AI within operational processes.

Drive Reliability Engineering and Platform Resilience

Establish and mature Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices across AWS Federated.
Define service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, reliability scorecards, and resilience metrics.
Build platform reliability programs focused on prevention rather than reaction.
Lead resiliency engineering initiatives including:
Disaster recovery
Recovery automation
Chaos engineering
Failure testing
Cyber resiliency validation

Ensure operational readiness requirements are consistently incorporated into platform architecture and service enablement initiatives.

Define Next-Generation Observability and Operational Intelligence

Establish the strategic direction for observability across cloud, infrastructure, application, data, and security domains.
Create a unified operational intelligence framework that combines telemetry, operational events, security signals, and platform insights.
Drive adoption of modern observability capabilities including:
Distributed tracing
Metrics aggregation
Log analytics
AI-driven anomaly detection
Predictive analytics

Leverage machine learning and analytics to proactively identify capacity, performance, reliability, and operational risks.
Enable data-driven operational decision making through real-time dashboards and executive reporting.

Accelerate Automation and Platform Productivity

Establish Operations-as-Code and Automation-as-a-Product principles across the platform.
Lead initiatives to eliminate repetitive operational activities through automation and self-service capabilities.
Develop reusable automation frameworks that standardize platform operations and reduce operational complexity.
Drive adoption of event-driven automation and intelligent workflows.
Measure and improve operational efficiency through AI-assisted engineering, automation, and workflow optimization.

Strengthen Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk Management

Partner with Cyber Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to continuously improve platform security posture.
Drive operational governance for vulnerability remediation, patch strategy, cloud controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Implement automated compliance and continuous assurance capabilities wherever feasible.
Support cyber resilience and cyber-immunity initiatives through automation, monitoring, and operational controls.
Ensure cloud operational practices remain aligned with evolving enterprise security standards.

Provide Strategic Leadership During Critical Operational Events

Serve as the senior operational leader for AWS Federated during significant service-impacting events.
Provide strategic decision-making and executive communication during major incidents and platform disruptions.
Drive post-event learning, systemic improvement initiatives, and reliability investments.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure long-term corrective actions are implemented and measured.

Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing organization spanning reliability engineering, observability, operational intelligence, automation, and platform operations disciplines.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Develop future leaders with expertise in cloud engineering, AI-enabled operations, resiliency engineering, and platform management.
Champion adoption of emerging technologies and modern engineering practices across the organization.

Qualifications

Required Experience

Bachelors degree
12+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering, reliability engineering, operations transformation, infrastructure engineering, or related disciplines.
5+ years of leadership experience managing large-scale technology organizations.
Deep expertise operating enterprise-scale AWS environments in regulated industries.
Proven experience establishing operational strategy for complex cloud platforms.
Strong knowledge of cloud architecture, networking, security, identity, automation, and service management disciplines.
Experience leading large-scale operational transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive cross-functional change.

Preferred Experience

Financial services or highly regulated industry experience.
Experience implementing AIOps, operational analytics, or observability platforms.
Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platforms.
Familiarity with Agentic AI architectures, AI orchestration platforms, and intelligent automation technologies.
Experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and modern CI/CD practices.
AWS Professional or Specialty Certifications.
Experience leveraging generative AI to improve engineering productivity and operational outcomes.

Leadership Attributes

The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate

Strategic thinking and enterprise leadership
Strong business and technology acumen
Customer-centric mindset
Data-driven decision making
Continuous learning mentality
Ability to lead through influence and collaboration
Passion for innovation, automation, and operational excellence

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through

Improved platform reliability and resilience
Measurable reduction in operational risk

This is an opportunity to join Ascot Group - one of the world’s preeminent specialty risk underwriting organizations.

Designed as a modern-era company operating through an ecosystem of interconnected global operating platforms, we’re bound by a common mission and purpose. Our greatest strength is a talented team who flourish in a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture, steeped in underwriting excellence, integrity, and a passion to find a better way, The Ascot Way.

The Ascot Way guides our people and our organization. Our underwriting platforms collaborate to find creative ways to deploy our capital in a true cross-product and cross-platform approach. These platforms work as one, deploying our capital creatively through our Client Centric, Risk Centric and Technology Centric strategies

Built to be resilient, Ascot offers clients leading financial security while delivering bespoke products and world class service — both pre- and post-claims. Ascot exists to solve for our clients’ brightest tomorrow, through agility, collaboration, resilience, and discipline.

Ascot is embedding artificial intelligence (AI) and automation across the organisation to enhance decision‑making, efficiency, and quality of outcomes. In this role, you will be expected to work confidently alongside AI‑enabled tools, apply sound judgment when interpreting insights, and adapt as technology continues to evolve. We value curiosity, critical thinking, and a willingness to embrace change as part of how we work.

Job Summary

The Vice President, Infrastructure Operations & Services provides guidance and leadership to the Infrastructure DevOps and DBA team and will report into the Senior Vice President, Infrastructure Operations & Service. This role will manage a team of direct reports that are responsible for DevOps and Databases across the group, as well as working alongside peers to support the US Infrastructure Operation. The role will be a mixture of strategically focused infrastructure and team organization, as well as hands-on technical work. The role must have hands-on technical knowledge, with the ability to step into all areas of infrastructure and assist the team with escalations. A working knowledge of Azure Cloud Computing is essential. Secure by Design is an underlying principle at Ascot, so a solid understanding of the importance of IT security and the constant requirement to update and evolve protection is essential. As a senior member of the IT team, excellent communication skills are required, both with internal stakeholders and the wider business. Experience of writing both technical and business facing documentation would be a clear advantage.

The ideal candidate will lead by example by providing exceptional customer service and fostering a strong working relationship with internal IT teams and external service providers. They will manage the day-to-day activities and performance of the team. That should work to maintain strong working relationships with Departments ensuring clear communication of resource plans. As well as developing the team to enable them to reach their full potential. This role will be an in-office position with a hybrid schedule.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership for internally focused services and infrastructure.
Procedure Development: Develop, maintain, and document procedures.
Efficiency Optimization: Identify opportunities to drive greater efficiencies through automation and best practices.
Problem Investigation: Investigate problems in systems, processes, and services, and contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures.
ITIL Best Practices: Apply ITIL best practices and understand product lifecycles.
Technical Concept Explanation: Explain technical concepts and understand how to fit into the wider technical landscape.
Resource Management: Overcome resource shortages through resource management techniques, reallocation, and informing senior management of any issues.
Project Support: Provide support to project managers on resource management issues and processes.
Compliance: Ensure risk, compliance, and audit requirements are met across the IT organization.
Communication: Work with internal/external communications on IT, business, and industry messaging.
People Leadership: Provide daily operational and strategic leadership, coaching and performance management to a team of direct reports.
Commitment to The Ascot Way: Embody The Ascot Way in daily interactions, fostering colleague engagement, collaboration, inclusivity, and accountability

Requirements

Experience: 10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.
Education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Global Teams: Demonstrated success managing global teams and strategic vendor partnerships.
Cloud Transformation: Experience with cloud transformation and modern Azure technologies.
Organizational Management: Demonstrated track record managing across the organization, both IT and Business.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Data-driven decision-making capabilities leveraging portfolio analytics.
Operational Efficiency: Expertise in improving IT operational efficiency and service delivery.
Communication Skills: Strong business acumen, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**This role can be filled at a different level, depending on experience.**

Compensation

Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to experience, subject matter expertise, and skills. The base pay is just one component of Ascot’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include an annual cash bonus and other forms of discretionary compensation awarded by the Company.

jobs.title: Senior Director and Head of Infrastructure & Technology Services
jobs.description:
About GNC

Since 1935, GNC has been a global leader in health and wellness innovation, inspiring people to achieve their goals with a trusted and dynamic range of products. As #TeamGNC, we prioritize our consumers, constantly collaborating and developing new ideas to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Our team is passionate about driving change and turning aspirations into actions. We believe that good health is the greatest gift, and there's nothing more rewarding than helping others achieve it. Join us in empowering others to Live Well!

What We’re Looking For:

At GNC we embrace a “Live Well” philosophy, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation meets passion. Whether someone is an athlete or just starting to focus on their health, we want to deliver the cutting-edge products they deserve. We are looking for an individual who is excited and eager to play a pivotal role in driving excellence in the health and wellness industry. This position offers the opportunity to engage in a collaborative environment where you will make a personal impact every day.

The Senior Director and Head of Infrastructure & Technology Services owns the technology backbone that every function within GNC depends on: cloud, network, data center, end user computing, and hardware, together with the service management and help desk experience through which employees interact with technology every day.

Reporting directly to the EVP, Chief Digital & Technology Officer, this role carries end-to-end accountability for infrastructure reliability, security posture, and service quality across GNC. It sits at the intersection of infrastructure reliability and fueling GNC’s growth by modernizing how the organization runs technology, balancing the discipline of always-on operations with a forward-looking roadmap for cloud maturity, AI-ready technology stack, consumption models that scale, workplace technology, and service excellence.

This is a hands-on operating leadership role. The person in this seat is accountable not just for uptime and tickets closed, but for the day-to-day experience of every employee and customer-facing system that depends on GNC's technology environment, including stores, distribution centers, corporate offices, and digital platforms alike.

This role is ideally based in Pittsburgh, PA. Remote candidates located on the East Coast will also be considered, with the expectation of regular travel to GNC's headquarters in Pittsburgh for leadership meetings, team engagement, and key business initiatives.

What You’ll Do:

This is a Full-Time Salary Position

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture.
Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for GNC's cloud, network, and data center infrastructure. Ensure infrastructure decisions scale with the business, support GNC's broader technology stack, and are built for resilience, security, and cost efficiency.
Cloud & Network Operations.
Lead the teams responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, network engineering, and data center management, ensuring high availability across GNC's corporate, retail, and distribution environments.
AI-Ready Infrastructure & Scalable Platforms.
Build and evolve the infrastructure foundation required to fuel GNC’s AI ambitions, including secure, high-performance cloud platforms, scalable consumption models, and the compute, connectivity, and operational capabilities needed to move AI use cases from experimentation into reliable enterprise solutions.
End User Computing & Hardware.
Oversee the full lifecycle of end user computing and hardware, including procurement, deployment, refresh cycles, and support, across corporate offices, stores, and distribution centers, ensuring employees have reliable, well-managed technology.
IT Service Management & Help Desk.
Own the service management function and help desk/service desk operations, including incident, problem, and change management. Drive a service culture defined by responsiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement in employee and customer experience.
Reliability, Resilience & Security.
Ensure infrastructure and end user environments meet enterprise standards for uptime, disaster recovery, business continuity, and patch/vulnerability management, in close partnership with Security and Risk teams.
Vendor & Cost Management.
Manage infrastructure, hardware, telecom, and cloud vendor relationships and spend, driving transparency and value in technology investment decisions in partnership with Finance.
Executive Partnership & Governance.
Act as a trusted advisor to the CDTO and senior technology and business leaders, translating infrastructure performance, risk, and investment needs into clear executive-ready updates and decisions.
Team Leadership & Capability Building.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure and service management organization. Establish clear roles, career paths, and a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Infrastructure is stable, secure, and scales ahead of business need rather than reacting to it
Employees and stores experience fast, reliable technology support with minimal friction
Service management practices are mature, measurable, and consistently meet SLA commitments
Infrastructure and hardware spend is transparent, well-managed, and aligned to business priorities
The infrastructure organization is viewed as a trusted, responsive partner, not a bottleneck
GNC’s infrastructure is AI-ready, scalable, secure, and cost-efficient.

Environmental Factors & Working Schedule:

This position may be based in either:
Pittsburgh, PA in a hybrid work environment, with an expectation of 3-4 days per week in the office; or
on in the East Coast, working remotely with up to 50% travel to support store engagement, field testing, business reviews, leadership meetings, and visits to the Pittsburgh headquarters.
Regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands or fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear
Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.
Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include long periods of computer screen usage, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus
The noise level in the work environment is usually low/moderate

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud operations, IT service management, or technology operations leadership roles
Demonstrated ownership of enterprise cloud (Azure preferred), network, data center, and end user computing environments
Proven experience building and running IT service management and help desk functions, including ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management practices
Experience supporting distributed environments, including retail stores, distribution centers, and corporate offices, strongly preferred
Strong track record managing infrastructure and vendor budgets, including cost optimization and contract negotiation
Exceptional executive presence, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Experience with Retail technology environments strongly preferred

Leadership Attributes

Operationally rigorous, with a strong bias for reliability and follow-through
Service-minded: treats every employee and store as a customer of the infrastructure organization
Calm under pressure; effective incident commander when things go wrong
Systems thinker who balances “keep the lights on” discipline with modernization
Trusted partner to executives and hands-on coach to their team

The VP leads senior leaders, managers, and technical teams; partners closely with business and technology leaders; and measures results through service reliability, employee experience, operational readiness, risk reduction, and financial performance. 

Essential Functions and Duties

Strategic Leadership, Roadmap & Organizational Direction:

Develop and maintain a multi-year Infrastructure Services strategy and roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational requirements, regulatory expectations, and enterprise technology priorities. 
Define and evolve the Infrastructure Services operating model, organizational structure, service ownership, and decision rights across cloud and platform engineering, network and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, site reliability engineering and operations, warehouse technology enablement, and infrastructure architecture, automation, and AI. 
Establish infrastructure investment priorities across platform modernization, lifecycle management, resiliency, technical debt, capacity, automation, and emerging capabilities; develop business cases and sequence investments based on business need, risk, service impact, and financial considerations.

Build strong relationships with senior executives and business leaders and serve as a trusted advisor regarding infrastructure capabilities, risks, investments, and emerging technology opportunities. 

Cloud & Platform Engineering:

Drive modernization of infrastructure platforms while reducing technical debt and improving lifecycle management, standardization, and operational efficiency. 
Establish governance for cloud consumption, capacity, performance, and cost optimization while ensuring infrastructure investments align with business requirements. 

Network & Communications:

Direct Network and Communications services across corporate offices, distribution centers, cloud environments, and remote operations. 
Provide executive oversight for enterprise and distribution center networks, WAN, cloud connectivity, wireless infrastructure, internet redundancy, DNS and DHCP, VPN, and voice and collaboration communication technologies. 
Establish network architecture, availability, capacity, performance, and lifecycle standards to support business continuity, operational growth, and high-availability requirements. 
Ensure clear ownership, escalation, and engineering accountability for network reliability and business-critical connectivity. 

Digital Workplace & End User Services:

Lead Digital Workplace and End User Services for remote, hybrid, office, and distribution center employees, including Windows and Mac engineering, endpoint and mobile management, Microsoft 365 and collaboration services, device lifecycle, patching, self-service, and employee productivity. 
Establish enterprise standards and governance for end-user technology platforms, administrative services, endpoint engineering, and technology asset lifecycle management. 
Provide executive oversight of Service Desk and technology service management capabilities, including tiered support, executive support, request fulfillment, asset and knowledge management, service catalog capabilities, and continuous improvement of the employee technology experience. 
Establish strategy and governance for endpoint lifecycle and technology asset management, including device standards, provisioning, refresh planning, mobile devices, asset controls, licensing, vendor and leasing strategy, and secure disposition. 
Establish clear service ownership, service levels, operating standards, and accountability to provide consistent technology experiences across all supported business environments. 

Site Reliability Engineering, Service Management & Resilience:

Establish Site Reliability Engineering and operations practices for end-to-end business services, including monitoring and observability, incident and problem management, capacity management, service levels, operational readiness, backup validation, disaster recovery, and business continuity exercises. 
Establish the Infrastructure Services IT service management operating model and governance across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service management. 
Define clear service ownership, escalation pathways, SLAs/OLAs, operating standards, and continuous improvement expectations across Infrastructure Services. 
Establish the enterprise infrastructure resilience strategy, including availability standards, recovery objectives, capacity and redundancy requirements, disaster recovery governance, and operational readiness for business-critical services. 
Ensure integrated service delivery and accountability across infrastructure engineering, Service Desk and End User Services, SRE, warehouse technology, Applications, Cybersecurity, and Operations. 
Provide executive leadership during major technology incidents and ensure effective escalation, communication, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and organizational learning. 

Warehouse Technology Enablement:

Oversee Warehouse Technology Enablement across distribution center environments, including warehouse Wi-Fi, RF handhelds, scanners, printers, shipping workstations, local infrastructure, and site technology support. 
Coordinate with Operations, application teams, technology leaders, and external vendors on conveyor and warehouse control system interfaces, PLC connectivity, facility upgrades, infrastructure dependencies, and peak-season readiness. 
Establish appropriate ownership and escalation models between frontline support, infrastructure engineering, operational technology resources, and business operations. 
Ensure distribution center technology is des
igned and supported to meet business-critical availability, resilience, performance, and recovery requirements. 

Infrastructure Architecture, Automation & AI:

Set infrastructure architecture, engineering standards, reference designs, lifecycle plans, and target-state direction across Infrastructure Services. 
Establish architecture governance that promotes standardization, interoperability, scalability, security, resiliency, and effective lifecycle management. 
Reduce technical debt and expand reusable platforms, infrastructure as code, automation, orchestration, and self-service capabilities. 
Introduce practical AI-assisted support and infrastructure operations in partnership with the AI Center of Excellence and Cybersecurity, with appropriate governance, data protection, security, and human oversight. 
Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where adoption can materially improve infrastructure performance, service reliability, employee experience, scalability, or cost effectiveness. 

Cybersecurity, Risk & Governance:

Partner with the CISO organization to incorporate security requirements into infrastructure strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations. 
Ensure alignment with enterprise requirements for identity and access controls, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, endpoint and administrative controls, technology asset governance, monitoring, change controls, and audit and regulatory requirements. 
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Procurement, application leaders, Operations, and other technology functions on shared standards, priorities, dependencies, and enterprise initiatives. 
Ensure infrastructure risks, control gaps, lifecycle exposures, and service vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, communicated, and appropriately mitigated. 

Financial, Vendor & Performance Management:

Own Infrastructure Services budgets, financial planning, vendor performance, contracts, resource planning, and delivery commitments. 
Establish meaningful KPIs, informed by the Gartner model, for availability, incident response, recovery, provisioning, device health, customer satisfaction, automation, capacity, service quality, and cost. 
Use service, operational, financial, and performance data to identify trends, evaluate organizational effectiveness, improve service outcomes, and inform investment decisions. 
Report material risks, performance trends, financial results, major initiatives, and roadmap progress to executive leadership.

Organization, Workforce & Talent Leadership:
