jobs.title: Sr Manager, QA Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer
programs spanning the full care continuum
, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades,
Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview

The Senior Manager, QA Engineering is a Quality Engineering leader responsible for developing people, advancing engineering quality practices, and driving scalable quality capabilities across the organization. This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes of the QA Tools practice, including automation frameworks, CI/CD quality enablement, and quality insights, while leading and developing Quality Engineers supporting product teams.

Through strong technical leadership, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional partnership, this role helps build shared ownership of quality and enables teams to deliver reliable, high-quality experiences for our customers.

You are a strategic, proactive leader who creates clarity from ambiguity and takes ownership of outcomes. You understand technology deeply enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and guide experienced engineers without needing to be the person writing the code.

You build strong relationships and know how to garner buy-in without requiring consensus. You communicate the “why,” listen to different perspectives, make thoughtful trade-offs, and move teams toward clear decisions.

You are pragmatic and adaptable. You favor simple, scalable, and standardized solutions over unnecessary complexity while recognizing where innovation, including AI, can meaningfully improve how teams work.

Core Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop Quality Engineers, building an empowered and accountable team through clear expectations, feedback, recognition, career development, and performance management.
Own the QA Tools strategy, roadmap, and priorities in alignment with broader Quality Engineering and Engineering goals.
Drive the technical direction of Quality Engineering capabilities, including scalable automation frameworks, CI/CD quality practices, and quality gates...
Provide technical leadership across automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled engineering by setting direction, evaluating approaches, challenging assumptions, and guiding experienced technical engineers without being the primary hands-on implementer.
Evolve quality metrics and reporting to provide actionable insights, connect quality practices to key outcomes, identify risk, and enable data-driven decisions.
Build trusted relationships across Engineering, Product, and QA leadership; engage stakeholders early, communicate the “why,” and build buy-in for quality practices and organizational change.
Partner with QA leadership to define and evolve Quality Engineering standards, driving adoption and measurable outcomes across Engineering teams.
Develop a strong working understanding of the product, customer workflows, and team ownership to effectively lead team members, identify quality risks, and reinforce shared ownership of quality.
Translate organizational direction into clear priorities and trade-offs, independently managing execution, risks, dependencies, and change while favoring pragmatic, scalable solutions and adapting as needs evolve.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven track record of leading, developing, and empowering Quality Engineering or software engineering teams, including experienced technical contributors.
Strong foundation in modern Quality Engineering, including test automation best practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, and scalable testing approaches.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-team initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable outcomes.
Strategic and data-driven problem solver who can establish priorities, navigate ambiguity, evaluate outcomes, and adapt direction when needed.
Strong communicator and influencer who builds trusted relationships, explains complex concepts clearly, and creates buy-in across teams and levels.
Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated software environment is a plus.

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.

Benefits

Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)
401K match
Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans
Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)
Employee Stock Purchase Program
Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program
Free Subscription to the Calm App
Tuition Assistance Program
Pet Insurance

Salaried, Exempt Roles

The typical base salary range for this position is $157,410 - $169,000. The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. Long-term incentive and short-term variable compensation may be offered as part of the compensation package dependent on the role. Some roles may be commission based, in which case the total compensation will be based on a commission and the above range may not be an accurate representation of total compensation.

Further, the above range is subject to change based on market demands and operational needs and does not constitute a promise of a particular wage or a guarantee of employment. Your recruiter can share more during the hiring process about the specific salary range based on the above factors listed.

Fraud Prevention Notice

As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, Amwell uses fraud detection capabilities within its hiring platform to help identify potentially suspicious, fraudulent, or unauthorized activity during the recruitment process.

These tools are designed to help protect candidates, Amwell, and the integrity of the hiring process by identifying indicators that may be associated with impersonation, account misuse, or other forms of recruiting fraud. Information generated through fraud detection is reviewed by authorized personnel and is not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.

Personal information collected or processed in connection with fraud detection will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.

Identity Verification Notice

jobs.title: Senior, Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM)
jobs.description:
TAE Power Solutions (TPS) is the electrification spin-off from TAE Technologies, a leader in nuclear fusion technology. The company is leveraging unique power management technology originally developed for nuclear fusion and applying it in adjacent industries including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and DC Fast Charging for electric vehicles.

About The Role

The main objective of this role is to identify technical gaps in engineering tasks to ensure scalable and predictable engineering execution. The Senior EDM owns the internal engineering execution architecture. This role turns high-level engineering objectives into a complete task breakdown with clear owners, dependencies, deliverables, and readiness criteria, ensuring there are no gaps or overlaps across disciplines. The role partners closely with PMO, which owns the integrated master schedule and external communications with customers and vendors, to ensure seamless execution of internal and external milestones.

Engineering Execution Architecture

Build and maintain the engineering work breakdown structure across systems, electrical, mechanical, controls, software, compliance, test, manufacturing readiness, and field readiness.
Define clear scope boundaries, handoffs, and ownership to prevent gaps and duplicated work across teams.
Create phase gate readiness criteria for key milestones such as requirements freeze, design freeze, build readiness FAT readiness, certification readiness, and release readiness.
Translate engineering changes into task level impacts and provide schedule and resourcing inputs to PMO for baseline updates.

Operating Cadence and Leadership Partnership

Work directly with the Director of Engineering on task planning and scope checks, and highlight critical path risks early.
Run a recurring engineering execution cadence including weekly progress reviews, dependency reviews, and risk issue decision tracking.
Drive cross functional alignment on deliverables, sequencing, and acceptance criteria.

Operational Processes and Continuous Improvement

Design and implement operational processes to track and quantify engineering outcomes and execution efficiency.
Establish a consistent operating system for engineering execution including WBS standards, JIRA structure, engineering RAID and decision logs, and milestone readiness reviews.
Use Six Sigma CTQ to support structured trade-off decisions (scope, schedule, cost, risk) and to reduce rework and variability in engineering outputs.
Define metrics, track trends, and lead continuous operational optimization with the Director of Engineering.

Tools and Reporting

Provide technical deliverable inputs and task breakdown at the level of detail required to manage dependencies and provide clean inputs to the PMO master schedule.
Build and maintain a JIRA structure that reflects the WBS and supports traceable execution, including EPICs, Stories, definitions of completed, and clear ownership.
Create concise technical executive readouts for progress, risks, decisions needed, and forecast to key milestones (with PMO)

Interfaces and Stakeholders

Director of Engineering
PMO team for integrated schedule governance and external milestone coordination
Engineering discipline leaders across hardware and software
Compliance and certifications
Quality and reliability
Supply chain and manufacturing engineering
Contract manufacturers and key vendors as needed for internal readiness planning

Manufacturing and Production Engineering:

Establish and enforce configuration control and ECN discipline.
Provide technical oversight of contract manufacturers to ensure build quality and process adherence.
Own unit level build, test, and quality readiness prior to release to execution teams.

Success Measures

No gaps or overlaps in scope across engineering workstreams and phase gates.
Improved predictability of execution, measured by engineering KPI and reduced critical path instability.
Higher closure rate and faster time to closure for critical risks and issues.
Improved planning quality, measured by estimate accuracy and reduced rework driven by missing tasks or unclear ownership.
Clean handoff of task level plans and change impacts to PMO with minimal rework.
Improved quality and execution consistency, measured through CTQ adoption, reduced variability, and reduced rework.

Required

Extensive interdisciplinary background in BESS development, validation, certification, and manufacturing.
7 years of direct experience with stationary BESS, power electronics, controls, and safety compliance programs.
Extensive experience leading execution planning for complex hardware and software products.
Demonstrated ability to build detailed work breakdown structures and dependency maps that stand up to robust audit and reduced execution surprises.
Advanced proficiency in MS Project and JIRA, including building structures that scale across teams and releases.
Extensive experience applying Six Sigma CTQ methods to drive engineering decisions, operational rigor, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to define CTQ, build measurable acceptance criteria, and use data to drive closure on cross-functional issues.
Strong executive communication skills, including clear status, risk framing, and decision requests.
Ability to influence without authority and drive closure across multiple functions.

Preferred

Experience with large-scale BESS system integration or EPC delivery for turnkey projects, including system engineering, multiple vendor scope coordination, and commissioning handoffs.

The compensation range for this role is between $165,000 - $195,000 + Benefits

Please Note - Preferred location:
Irvine, California. Remote candidates may be considered if they are out of the area

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Material Flow Engineering
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

Anduril’s Supply Chain team is seeking a Senior Manager of Material Flow Engineering to join us. Working with a global network of suppliers, to support a global manufacturing platform takes people who are willing to work hard and find ways to win. You will create a strategic plan to optimize warehouse and material flow operations across our Columbus, OH facilities, create a standard set of metrics to monitor team performance, set goals for improving performance, and identify areas to reduce cost while maintaining quality. The right person for this role has extensive supply chain knowledge, has implemented or improved ERP/WMS, and has a track record of managing complex, high-value inventory. If you are someone who can operate autonomously to keep a material flow engineering and warehouse team motivated and enjoys process improvement, this may be the role for you.

What You'll Do

Design, develop and implement innovative material management strategies, policies, and procedures to optimize material flow and support production requirements for efficient movement of parts & materials using lean principles across multiple sites.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including procurement, production, logistics, and quality, to aid in accurate demand forecasting, procurement planning, and timely delivery of materials
Collaborate with production planning teams to align material availability with production schedules, minimize disruptions, and meet customer demand on time
Own the metrics, KPIs, and reporting associated with monitoring production line health and efficiency, such as cycle time, throughput rate, capacity, utilization, process non-conformities, and inventory accuracy. Analyze material usage trends, identify opportunities for process improvements, and implement lean practices to optimize material handling, storage, and distribution
Support and implement inventory control measures, including cycle counting, regular audits, and reconciliation, to ensure inventory accuracy and prevent stockouts or overstocking
Utilize ERP (Oracle) & WMS software (Odoo) systems and tools to track inventory, generate reports, and provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and optimize material-related processes
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, safety standards, and quality control protocols in all material management activities
Passionately work across multiple programs from development to full rate production to scale best-in-class solutions to align with maturity of manufacturing process
Proactively identify imbalances and bottlenecks caused by inventory processes, line layouts, parts shortages, staffing shortages, and other production constraints; flag constraints with the appropriate owners across Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality and drive to resolution
Develop processes to optimize workplans for highly variable demands across multiple sites.
Translate tools and reports into actionable tasks that impact the health of warehouse operations across a plethora of processes and sites.
Produce and maintain tools to increase accuracy of work demand for new facilities and maturing processes using a data-driven approach using tools such as Value Stream Mapping/ Process Mapping/ Line Balancing techniques
Identify and solve complex problems related to the movement of materials within a manufacturing environment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering or other technical field/supply chain management
10+ years of experience with 5+ years of people management experience in material flow engineering and management, inventory control, or supply chain management roles, preferably in a manufacturing or production environment
5+ years of experience in a high-rate supply chain or manufacturing environment, where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies are built with heavy data utilization
Ability to read technical documentation such as drawings and CAD data, understanding of a variety of hardware manufacturing processes for both electronics (PCBAs, sensor hardware, etc.) and structures, mechanical components, and electromechanical systems
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Columbus, OH

Preferred Qualifications

Strong knowledge of supply chain principles, inventory management techniques, and material planning strategies
Strong problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills are crucial for collaborating with different teams.
Experience with department or factory design and set up - value stream mapping, flow lines, continuous flow, one piece flow, workstation design
Ability to completely own a value chain from start to finish, measuring each step of the process, creating actionable tasks that culminated in a significant and sustainable business improvement
Demonstrated ability of presenting project results to a cross functional team with clearly relating data to proposed next steps
Prior experience with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production operations or Warehouse Management System (WMS)
Prior knowledge of NetSuite, Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
Have direct experience scoping, buying off and commissioning warehouse automation.
Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles which drive manufacturing productivity
Experience in delivering successful project by being hands on with the process. Including gemba walks, operational analysis, poka yoke solutions among others to allow teams to be successful without massive CAPEX
Experience interacting with SQL databases - storage of information and building custom queries for tracking production and inventory-related metrics
Experience with using Siemens Plant Simulation or Process Simulation software to model a production line and run production scenarios
Experience with both commercial and federal inventory procedures, requirements, processes
Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

US Salary Range

$143,000—$191,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

to serve as a trusted operations leader and subject matter expert supporting transit and rail clients nationwide. This highly consultative role partners directly with agency leadership to guide operational strategy, readiness, and implementation for new systems, service expansions, and complex transit programs.

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on experience at a senior level within a public transit agency environment and understands the full lifecycle of operations and maintenance planning—from concept through testing, commissioning, and start-up. This individual will provide practical, real-world insight to help agencies deliver safe, reliable, and efficient service across multiple transit modes.

Responsibilities

Serve as a senior advisor to transit agency clients on operations, maintenance, and system readiness initiatives
Lead development of Operations & Maintenance (O&M) plans and operational frameworks for new system start-ups and expansions
Support testing & commissioning activities, system integration testing, and operational readiness planning

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, IT Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!

Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high-quality brands and on-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.

As Part Of Our Team, You Will Experience

Success. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
Career growth. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow Teamwork. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
Our commitment to Diversity, Equality & Inclusion, and our community. We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2023 revenues of $20.4 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

GENERAL PURPOSE

The Senior Manager, IT – Marketing Technology is a senior-level role responsible for overseeing a team of project managers, technical leads, architect, business analysts, and providing leadership and direction.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager for Marketing Technology systems to lead the delivery and management of our Marketing IT projects. This leader will be responsible for managing a cross-functional technology delivery team to plan, develop, implement and support Marketing Technology solutions.

The Senior Manager will partner with other IT partners, Marketing, and Customer Experience business teams, while managing vendor/ SI relationships to ensure solution quality and delivery of value to the business.

Essential Functions

Manage the Marketing IT delivery team (ex – Project Manager, Technical Lead, Business Analyst, and additional supporting resources).
Engage with business users and help identify and finalize functional and non-functional requirements.
Manage program budgets, forecasts, and reporting. Deliver Marketing focused projects on time, with high quality and within budget.
Drive governance meetings to provide appropriate metrics, and reporting for program execution.
Manage vendor relationships. Support RFPs, contract negotiations, and ongoing vendor performance reviews.
Lead delivery of solution design and maintain a focus on quality, compliance, and customer privacy.
Manage projects throughout the entire systems development lifecycle ensuring that requirements are accurately defined; systems are designed, coded and tested that meet the defined requirements; and that teams execute efficiently
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Support evaluation of emerging technologies such as AI/GenAI for marketing and drive pilots and adoption.
Supervise and mentor direct reports and administer goals and reviews.

COMPETENCIES

Building Effective Teams

Developing Talent

Collaboration

Leading by Example

Communicates Effectively

Ensures Accountability & Execution

Manages Conflict

Business Acumen

Plans, Aligns & Prioritizes

Organizational Agility

Financial Management

Dealing with Ambiguity

Problem Solving

Qualifications & Special Skills Required

10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, with at least 5+ years in Marketing Technology and Retail IT.
Proven track record of implementing complex, cross-functional MarTech implementations
Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance practices.
Demonstrated people leadership skills and experience. Experience of managing a team with up to 5 direct reports.
Experience working in Retail is preferred.
Demonstrated success in vendor/SI management and large-scale program delivery.
Ability to build and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships at all levels of the organization.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information in a condensed manner to various stakeholders verbally and in writing.
Ability to perform under pressure and manage multiple priorities with competing demands for resources.
Adaptability and agility to manage rapid change in business needs, processes, or technologies.
People management skills including talent development, coaching, mentoring, and team motivation.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams.

EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Master’s degree is a plus.
Certifications (preferred but not required) - PMP, SAFe/Agile Program Mgmt, Marketing platforms, Privacy, etc.

Physical Requirements

Job requires ability to work in an office environment, primarily on a computer

Requires sitting, standing, walking, hearing, talking on the telephone, attending in-person meetings, typing, and working with paper/files, etc

Consistent timeliness and regular attendance

Vision requirements: Ability to see information in print and/or electronically

This role requires regular in-office presence, including to engage in in-person team interaction, meetings and collaboration, client support, mentoring, coaching, and/or feedback

However, this role can perform duties effectively using a combination of in-office and remote work

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manager

Solution Architect

Technical Lead

Business Analyst

jobs.title: AI Platform Director - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): North Carolina or Arizona

We are seeking an experienced Director to lead the AI platform engineering and enablement functions within our expanding Cloud Data and AI Platform organization. This role is instrumental in building, operationalizing, and governing the next-generation AI and machine learning ecosystem that powers advanced analytics and responsible AI adoption across the bank. You will own the end-to-end AI lifecycle—from data and model development to MLOps, deployment, governance, and responsible AI compliance in a regulated financial environment.

As a seasoned technology leader, you will bring your expertise in enterprise AI architecture, model operations, and platform engineering to partner with key business, technology, and governance stakeholders—ensuring AI initiatives are responsibly implemented, well-controlled, and deliver measurable value.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

AWS AI/ML Platform Ownership

Architect and lead AI/ML workloads on AWS including:
Amazon SageMaker (training, deployment, model registry)
AWS Bedrock (foundation models and GenAI use cases)
AWS Lambda, ECS, EKS for model serving
S3, Glue, Snowflake for data pipelines

Define enterprise standards for MLOps, feature stores, and model lifecycle management
Build and maintain integrations with enterprise platforms for data ingestion, metadata management, tokenization, and control evidence generation.
Continuously enhance the platform’s automation, resilience, and observability, ensuring robust end-to-end telemetry for both model and data pipelines.
Collaborate with Enterprise Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Model Risk partners to embed Responsible AI principles and audit-ready control evidence directly into platform design.

Machine Learning & GenAI Execution

Oversee development of ML models across all business units including Fraud detection systems, Credit scoring and risk modeling, Customer segmentation and personalization, Liquidity related modeling etc.
Lead GenAI initiatives using LLMs for Document intelligence, AI copilots etc.

Data & Engineering Collaboration

Partner with data engineering teams to ensure high-quality, governed datasets
Define feature engineering and data product standards in Snowflake / data lake environments
Integrate real-time streaming data for low-latency decision systems

Model Governance & Risk Compliance

Define and enforce standards, patterns, and guardrails for model deployment, explainability, lineage, and monitoring in alignment with enterprise risk, compliance, and security frameworks.
Partner closely with leaders across Responsible AI Governance, AI Portfolio Management, AI Fluency & Engagement, and Applied Data Science & GenAI, in collaboration with enterprise risk partners, to implement a responsible AI framework that embeds audit-ready control evidence and governance mechanisms directly into the platform’s core design to ensure the platform supports scalable, ethical, compliant, and high-impact AI delivery.
Implement model explainability (SHAP, LIME, interpretability frameworks)
Establish responsible AI policies (bias detection, fairness, auditability)

Team Building & Leadership

Develop and mentor engineering talent, championing Agile practices, continuous learning, and adoption of emerging AI and data engineering technologies.
Mentor senior technical leaders and establish engineering best practices
Oversee technical due diligence, onboarding, and management of strategic AI and GenAI vendors and tools, ensuring compatibility with enterprise architecture and control.

Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience in Information Technology including application development, support roles, and management.

OR

High School Diploma or GED and 12 years of experience in Information Technology including application development, support roles, and management.

Qualifications

Deep hands-on experience building production ML systems on AWS
2+ years in AI/ML, data science, or data engineering leadership roles
Strong knowledge of:
Machine learning (XGBoost, deep learning, NLP, time series)
MLOps practices (CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection)
Distributed systems and cloud architecture

Strong programming background in Python + SQL (Scala/Java a plus)
Experience working in regulated environments with model governance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Generative AI / LLM platforms (Bedrock, OpenAI, Claude APIs)
Experience in financial services, banking, fintech, or insurance
Familiarity with data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks

Additional Information

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform Prioritization & Delivery
jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Senior Director to own cross-functional prioritization and delivery across Mission Lane, reporting to the SVP, Product, Platform, & Delivery

The Impact You'll Make

Every initiative Mission Lane ships – a better payment plan, a faster credit decision, a clearer way to see progress -- moves a customer forward. None of it ships in a vacuum. It depends on the right team picking it up at the right time, with the capacity to see it through, without adversely affecting another initiative.

The system that sorts through those prioritization decisions is yours to run. You’ll manage the framework and facilitate the discussions that decide what goes first when domains are moving at different speeds and carrying different risks. You'll often be bringing a room full of different perspectives to a shared answer.

This function is new at Mission Lane, and the framework for it is only partly in place. You're the one who fills in what's missing and runs it day to day, building the credibility that earns trust and adherence.

What You'll Own

A team of four Delivery Managers, each embedded in a different focus area (Collections, Data & AI/Model Process, Portfolio Management, and Acquisitions), including their coaching, growth, and workload balance
The prioritization tracker as Mission Lane's single source of truth for what's in flight, at what stage, and why, kept accurate enough that leaders trust it without double-checking
Weekly prioritization meetings, MBRs, and QBRs, run with enough rigor to hold up under executive scrutiny
Company-wide delivery standards, frameworks, and tooling that initiative teams actually adopt in their day-to-day work
Cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Credit, Marketing, Finance, and Legal/Compliance, clearing blockers and resolving trade-offs before they stall delivery
Post-initiative retrospectives that produce concrete changes to how the next initiative gets planned and delivered

You'll Thrive In This Role If

You've led delivery inside an organization with genuine cross-functional complexity, spanning multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
You've built a prioritization or delivery process yourself, and can explain the tradeoffs in it clearly enough that someone new to it can follow the logic.
Your background is in product, program, or technical delivery leadership, with the credibility to work as a peer with engineering leads and data scientists.
You build just enough process to protect capacity and speed, no more.
You have direct conversations with senior stakeholders when priorities conflict, and you know how to bring a room to a decision.

Minimum Qualifications

A proven track record of building processes and oversight to drive improved speed to impact across an organization.
A proven track record leading and developing a team focused on organizational effectiveness which could include Delivery Managers, Program Managers, or similarly scoped delivery leaders
Experience working in a highly regulated and technical environment, with demonstrated ability to shape functional strategy and operate with a high degree of autonomy
Experience owning enterprise-level portfolio intake, prioritization, and execution tracking end to end, at a company operating at meaningful scale and complexity
A demonstrated ability to align senior and executive stakeholders across functions such as Product, Engineering, Finance, Credit, and Legal around shared priorities without relying on direct authority
Deep working knowledge of modern delivery methodologies and the judgment to adapt them to an organization's actual stage of maturity as well as rapidly changing technology
Experience structuring and running core enterprise operating cadences, such as weekly prioritization meetings, MBRs, and QBRs, that senior leadership relies on for accurate decision-making
Hands-on experience with modern portfolio and workflow tooling (e.g., Jira, Jira Align, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet), including evaluating and administering these tools at an organizational level
A background that includes hiring, coaching, and developing direct reports
Ability to travel ~4+ times per year for high quality in person collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience in consumer lending, credit cards, or another regulated financial services environment, with working knowledge of compliance, credit risk, and legal considerations that shape delivery timelines
Experience scaling delivery governance and team structures inside a fast-growing, mid-sized organization moving through a similar stage of process maturity
Expertise configuring enterprise-grade portfolio tools (e.g., Jira Align, Dragonboat, Productboard) to connect strategic goals directly to team execution
Experience building portfolio dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to track delivery velocity, resource utilization, and realized business impact

Compensation

About Mission Lane

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Appfire is seeking a Vice President, Product Management, Platform & Innovation
to lead three connected areas central to the company's next phase of growth: the Appfire Platform, the Innovation portfolio, and Appfire's technical product relationship with Atlassian.

You will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Appfire Platform
, the shared services and AI capabilities that power our products, accelerate delivery, and create leverage across the portfolio. You will also lead the Innovation team
, responsible for discovering, validating, incubating, and launching the next generation of Appfire products.

As Appfire's senior product leader for the technical dimension of our Atlassian relationship, you will anticipate platform, API, Forge, and Marketplace changes; represent Appfire in technical and roadmap discussions; and translate ecosystem shifts into competitive advantage, product opportunity, and managed risk.

As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will help shape strategy across the broader portfolio, translate company priorities into focused product bets, and build a high-performing team of product leaders. You will partner closely with Engineering, Go-to-Market, Finance, Legal, Security, and executive leadership.

Success will be measured by the adoption and business impact of platform capabilities, the quality and velocity of the innovation pipeline, and the revenue and strategic value created by new products launched through your team.

What you will do

Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

Partner with executive leadership to establish a compelling vision for the Appfire Platform and new-product portfolio as part of the broader company strategy.
Translate that vision into a clear investment thesis, product roadmap, measurable objectives, and operating plan.
Make disciplined decisions about where to build, buy, partner, invest, scale, or stop.
Maintain a clear view of progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, adjusting priorities as market and business conditions change.
Communicate strategy, decisions, and outcomes clearly across executive, technical, and business audiences.

Platform Product Leadership

Treat the Appfire Platform as a product, with defined customers, value propositions, roadmaps, adoption goals, and success measures.
Define and deliver shared platform capabilities, including AI-enabled services, that increase customer value, enable revenue growth, accelerate product delivery, and reduce duplicated effort.
Drive adoption across Appfire by reducing integration friction, establishing effective rollout and migration plans, and partnering closely with product and engineering teams.
Establish metrics for platform adoption, reliability, cost efficiency, developer experience, time to market, and business impact.
Build strong feedback loops with internal product teams and other platform users to ensure the roadmap addresses their highest-value needs.
Communicate and demonstrate the value of the platform throughout the organization.

Innovation and New Growth

Lead the Innovation team in identifying, validating, incubating, and launching net-new product opportunities.
Build and actively manage a portfolio of product bets aligned with customer needs, market opportunity, and Appfire's strategic advantages.
Apply a disciplined 0-to-1 approach to customer discovery, market validation, experimentation, business-case development, and commercial launch.
Establish clear stage gates and evidence-based criteria for advancing, changing, scaling, or stopping investments.
Partner with Go-to-Market leaders on positioning, pricing, packaging, launch, and early commercial traction.
Own the path from initial concept to measurable customer adoption and revenue.
Transition validated products into the appropriate scaling organization when they are ready to move beyond incubation.

Atlassian Technical Relationship

Serve as Appfire's senior product owner for the technical dimension of the Atlassian relationship.
Represent Appfire in technical, platform, and roadmap discussions with Atlassian.
Maintain a forward-looking view of changes to Atlassian's platform, APIs, Forge architecture, Marketplace, security requirements, and developer ecosystem.
Translate ecosystem changes into product opportunities, competitive differentiation, internal readiness plans, and risk mitigation.
Influence Atlassian's technical direction where possible by clearly representing Appfire's needs, customer use cases, and strategic priorities.
Ensure relevant Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and business teams understand upcoming changes and are prepared to respond.

People and Organizational Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a team of product managers and product leaders responsible for the Appfire Platform and Innovation portfolio.
Set clear expectations for product strategy, customer insight, commercial thinking, execution quality, and accountability.
Recruit and retain strong product talent while building a durable leadership bench and succession pipeline.
Coach team members to take on broader and more complex product leadership responsibilities.
Establish an effective operating cadence for planning, decision-making, performance management, and cross-functional alignment.
Communicate progress, outcomes, risks, and decisions effectively at every level of the organization.

About you

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred.
10+ years of progressively responsible product management experience, including 5+ years leading teams of product managers or product leaders.
Demonstrated success defining and scaling cloud platforms, shared services, APIs, or developer-facing capabilities in a SaaS, XaaS, or consumption-based business.
Proven experience taking net-new, 0-to-1 products from discovery through launch, customer adoption, and commercial traction.
Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication and authorization, cloud architecture, high availability, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience translating platform investments into measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, faster time to market, increased adoption, improved productivity, lower operating cost, or greater reliability.
Commercial ownership of a significant software portfolio, including P&L, revenue, or equivalent business accountability.
Experience owning or contributing to a strategic technology-platform or partner relationship.
Strong executive judgment and communication skills, with the ability to create alignment through ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex tradeoffs.
A track record of building, coaching, and retaining high-performing product teams.

Preferred Experience

Experience building within the Atlassian ecosystem, including Forge, Marketplace, and Atlassian APIs.
Experience operating cloud services at significant scale, ideally exceeding 100 million daily service calls.
Commercial ownership of a XaaS portfolio exceeding $50 million in annual recurring revenue.
Experience building AI-enabled platform capabilities or commercial AI products.

What do we offer:

Work in a product-first SaaS B2B environment focused on building and scaling solutions for large enterprise customers
Deliver meaningful, high-impact work that directly influences product direction and customer success
Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a true sense of ownership and connection to our growth.

The portfolio automates and improves security operations, analysis, and management functions for the Security organization and for CVS Health colleagues, and its users are demanding professionals with day jobs — security operations analysts, GRC and audit teams, identity and infrastructure engineers, application teams, and in some cases colleagues across the enterprise. This leader owns continuous discovery with those users, translates workflow pain into a prioritized roadmap, defines the outcomes each product is accountable for, and holds the portfolio to those outcomes rather than to a delivery calendar.
Owns adoption as a first-class responsibility rather than a post-launch afterthought. Internal products fail in a specific and well-documented way: they are built on unverified assumptions, launched without enablement, mandated rather than adopted, and quietly abandoned. This role exists to prevent that. Accountable for internal go-to-market, enablement and documentation, onboarding of successive user groups, instrumented adoption and usage measurement, structured feedback channels, iteration against what the evidence shows, and the discipline to sunset or replace solutions that are not earning their place in the portfolio.
Leads and develops a team of product managers, with coaching and craft development as the primary work rather than personally owning products. Sets the standard for discovery, problem framing, requirements quality, and outcome measurement; hires and levels PMs; and creates the conditions for empowered product and engineering pairs to solve problems rather than execute specifications. Operates as a peer-level partner to engineering leadership, a credible voice to security function owners who did not ask to be automated, and a clear communicator to executive sponsors who need to understand what the investment is buying.
This role can work remotely from anywhere in the continental USA.

Primary Responsibilities

Owns product strategy, vision, and the multi-year roadmap for the Security Automation portfolio in partnership with the Lead Director, Security Automation; frames the problems worth solving, sequences investment against enterprise security priorities, and maintains a defensible, communicable position on why the portfolio is working on what it is working on and what it has deliberately chosen not to do
Leads, builds, and develops the product management team, treating the coaching and development of product managers as the core of the job rather than personally managing products; hires and levels PMs, sets the standard for product craft, runs a structured development approach, and leads by context rather than by control
Owns product discovery for the portfolio including direct, continuous contact with the security practitioners and CVS Health colleagues whose work the portfolio is meant to change; workflow and pain-point analysis, opportunity sizing, assumption testing before build, and validation that a proposed automation solves a problem the users actually have
Owns adoption and the full product lifecycle for everything the portfolio ships including internal launch and go-to-market, enablement, documentation and training, onboarding of new user groups, support and feedback channels, iteration based on real usage, and the decision to sunset or replace solutions that are not earning their keep
Defines and instruments the outcome measures for each product and for the portfolio as a whole including adoption and active-usage measures, manual-effort and cycle-time reduction, support deflection, and risk-reduction proxies; establishes baselines before delivery, reports honestly against them afterward, and treats shipped features as inputs rather than results
Owns requirements definition and the delivery partnership with engineering including problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria, backlog health, release planning, scope and tradeoff decisions during delivery, and clear division of decision rights between product and engineering
Partners on build-versus-buy and commercial evaluation, bringing market scanning, competitive and vendor landscape analysis, requirements definition for proofs-of-concept, and total-cost-of-ownership and licensing analysis to decisions about whether a capability should be built, bought, or assembled on an existing enterprise platform
Serves as the primary product-facing voice to stakeholders and senior leadership including security function owners, Technology and Digital partners, and executive sponsors; communicates roadmap, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes in language appropriate to each audience and secures the sponsorship the portfolio depends on
Owns the business case and financial framing for portfolio investments including benefit quantification, ROI and payback analysis, license and vendor cost modeling, and the value narrative used to defend and grow investment in the function
Establishes and matures the product management practice for the function including intake and prioritization mechanisms, discovery and requirements standards, roadmap and release communication cadence, product documentation standards, and the tooling that supports them

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in technology roles, including 8+ years in software product management
4+ years leading product managers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development — with demonstrated understanding that leading PMs is a different job from managing products personally
Product management experience gained in a commercial software or SaaS organization is strongly preferred; candidates from internal-platform or enterprise-IT-only backgrounds should be able to demonstrate equivalent product rigor
Demonstrated ownership of product strategy and multi-year roadmaps for a software product or portfolio, including the ability to articulate what was deliberately not built and why
Strong product discovery practice: direct user research and workflow analysis, opportunity sizing, assumption and risk testing before committing to build, and evidence-based decision making rather than requirements collection
Demonstrated ability to define, instrument, and report on outcome measures — adoption, active usage, effort and cycle-time reduction, support deflection, retention of usage over time — including establishing baselines before delivery
Track record of driving adoption of software products, with specific, quantified examples including at least one case where adoption stalled and what the candidate changed in response
Demonstrated prioritization judgment under real constraint, including examples of telling significant stakeholders no and managing the relationship afterward
Experience owning requirements definition and the delivery partnership with engineering: problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria, backlog health, release planning, and in-flight scope and tradeoff decisions
Technical fluency sufficient to earn the trust of engineers and to participate credibly in architecture, integration, and feasibility discussions — including comfort with APIs, data models, and software delivery practice. Coding ability is not required
Experience with build-versus-buy analysis and commercial software evaluation, including vendor and market assessment and total-cost-of-ownership reasoning
Demonstrated ability to influence peers, senior stakeholders, and executives without direct authority, and to build genuine co-ownership with partner teams rather than transactional requirements relationships
Financial acumen: business case construction, benefit quantification, ROI and payback analysis, and budget and license cost management
Strong written communication — product briefs, strategy narratives, and roadmap communication that hold up without a presenter — and strong verbal communication across engineer-to-executive audiences
Experience operating in agile delivery models and with modern product and delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, product analytics, roadmap and discovery tools)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience as a product manager or product leader for developer-facing, platform, or internal-facing software products, where users must be won rather than acquired
Experience in a security, risk, compliance, or IT operations product domain, or demonstrated ability to learn a technical operational domain quickly and credibly
Experience with workflow automation, integration, or data platform products, including products whose value is measured in effort avoided rather than revenue generated
Experience with AI-enabled or agentic product management: defining human-in-the-loop experiences, evaluating model accuracy and failure modes, and setting user expectations for probabilistic systems
Experience with product-led adoption motions — self-service onboarding, in-product guidance, documentation as a product surface, and community or champion programs
Experience partnering with a peer engineering leader in a formal dual-leadership model, with clear and healthy division of decision rights
Experience managing a portfolio that mixes custom-built software, third-party commercial products, and platform-based configuration
Experience sunsetting or consolidating products, including managing the stakeholder consequences
Experience in a highly regulated industry, ideally healthcare, with familiarity with HIPAA, PCI DSS, HITRUST CSF, SOX, or audit and evidence requirements
Experience establishing or maturing a product management practice where none previously existed
Advanced degree or MBA; recognized product management or agile credentials

Education

jobs.title: Director of Technology Solutions
jobs.description:
Apply

Description

The Director of Technology Solutions is responsible for developing, launching, managing, and growing Koltiv's service offerings throughout their lifecycle. This role transforms vendor capabilities, technology solutions, internal expertise, and market opportunities into profitable services that clients value and the business can successfully sell, deliver, support, and scale.

This is a hands-on leadership role focused on execution and outcomes. The director owns service strategy, packaging, pricing, go-to-market planning, organizational readiness, adoption, and lifecycle performance. Success is achieved through building and continuously improving scalable, repeatable, and profitable service offerings that support Koltiv's growth objectives and long-term vision.

Core Accountabilities & Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Growth

Define and maintain a service portfolio strategy that supports Koltiv's vision, growth objectives, and long-term business priorities.
Develop and manage the service roadmap, ensuring alignment between market opportunities, customer needs, organizational capabilities, and strategic direction.
Evaluate portfolio performance and make data-driven recommendations regarding service investments, expansion, enhancement, consolidation, or retirement.
Establish portfolio growth plans that increase revenue, profitability, market penetration, and client value.
Identify emerging trends, technologies, and industry developments that create opportunities for innovation and competitive differentiation.
Develop and maintain strategic vendor and partner relationships that support service innovation, portfolio growth, market differentiation, and long-term business objectives.

Service Development & Innovation

Lead the creation, enhancement, and expansion of service offerings that address evolving customer challenges and business objectives.
Leverage internal subject matter experts, engineers, architects, vendors, and operational leaders to design, validate, and commercialize service offerings, without direct responsibility for technical implementation.
Translate market intelligence, client feedback, competitive insights, and technology advancements into scalable and profitable service solutions.
Champion innovation by assessing new service concepts, validating business cases, and guiding offerings from concept through launch.
Ensure services are clearly defined, properly packaged, and positioned to deliver measurable outcomes for clients.
Drive continuous modernization of the portfolio to maintain industry relevance and competitive advantage.
Engage clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, validate service concepts, identify market opportunities, and improve portfolio performance.

Pricing, Packaging & Go-To-Market Alignment

Develop service packaging and pricing strategies that balance client value, market competitiveness, and profitability objectives.
Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to establish positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for new and existing services.
Support demand generation efforts by providing portfolio expertise, market insights, and strategic guidance.
Ensure sales teams are equipped with the tools, resources, and training necessary to effectively communicate service value and drive adoption.
Monitor market response and adjust portfolio strategies to maximize commercial success.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

Serve as the primary leader responsible for aligning stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technical teams around portfolio objectives.
Facilitate strategic decision-making by balancing client needs, operational readiness, financial performance, and growth opportunities.
Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve service adoption, delivery effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure portfolio decisions are informed, scalable, and executable.
Influence prioritization and resource allocation decisions that support portfolio success.

Service Lifecycle Management

Establish and maintain a formal framework for managing services through all stages of the lifecycle, including development, launch, maturity, optimization, and retirement.
Define and monitor key performance indicators related to adoption, utilization, profitability, client outcomes, and operational effectiveness.
Conduct ongoing service reviews to identify risks, opportunities, and improvement initiatives.
Ensure portfolio decisions are supported by accurate reporting, business insights, and performance analysis.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service value, operational efficiency, and client experience.

Operational Readiness & Enablement

Ensure organizational readiness by coordinating onboarding processes, operational workflows, training programs, documentation, sales enablement, support models, and success measures required to effectively sell, onboard, deliver, support, and scale services.
Ensure successful service launches through documented processes, operational planning, enablement materials, and readiness assessments.
Partner with operational leaders to establish scalable support models and delivery frameworks.
Develop and maintain service documentation, standards, playbooks, and governance practices.
Coordinate training and knowledge transfer activities to increase organizational adoption and execution consistency.
Ensure teams have the tools, resources, and clarity needed to effectively support service delivery.
Promote cross-functional alignment and healthy collaboration throughout the organization.
Other duties and responsibilities as assigned based on business needs.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, Product Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
7+ years of experience developing, launching, managing, or growing technology services, managed services, professional service, or solution offerings within an MSP, VAR, technology integrator, software, or professional services environment.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing organizational decision-making.
Experience developing business strategies that drive revenue growth, profitability, and customer value.
Strong financial, analytical, and business planning capabilities.
Proven ability to take technology capabilities, vendor programs, client needs, or market opportunities and develop successful service offerings.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within managed services, technology solutions, cybersecurity, cloud, or professional services environments.
Experience developing, packaging, pricing, launching, and optimizing technology service offerings.
Experience with pricing strategy, business case development, and go-to-market planning.
Familiarity with EOS® operating principles and accountability-based leadership models.
MBA or advanced business-related education.

What Success Looks Like

The service portfolio consistently aligns with Koltiv's strategic direction and growth objectives.
Service offerings are clearly defined, differentiated, and valued by clients.
New services are successfully launched with strong organizational adoption and operational readiness.
Portfolio decisions are guided by measurable business outcomes, profitability, and customer impact.
Cross-functional teams work collaboratively toward shared portfolio goals.
Services remain competitive, scalable, and responsive to evolving market needs.
Team members demonstrate growth, accountability, and strong alignment with Koltiv's culture and values.

Why Join Koltiv?

Koltiv helps businesses grow by delivering people-first IT services and custom solutions that turn complexity into clarity. We combine technical expertise with real-world understanding to build trusted partnerships in agriculture, manufacturing, and beyond. If you're passionate about making lives better through innovative technology, Koltiv is the place for you.

Our Culture

We're An Entrepreneurial, Growth-driven Team That Values

Human Experience – Serve people first
Character – Do what's right
Problem Solving – Conquer with curiosity
Ownership – Go all in

Benefits

17 days PTO, seven holidays, two floating holidays, and bereavement time off
401K Safe Harbor (after one year)
Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental
Employer-paid life insurance and long-term disability
Monthly cell phone stipend
Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework for structured success

Ready to Make an Impact?

As the Director of Technology Solutions you'll have the opportunity to shape how Koltiv brings services to market by turning client needs, technology capabilities, and business opportunities into scalable offerings that drive growth and value. You'll work across the organization to develop, launch, and optimize services that Sales can sell, Operations can deliver, and clients trust. If you're passionate about strategy, execution, and building services that create meaningful business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com
and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

Summary of Position:

Scholar Rock is seeking a Senior Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations to lead and scale the technology infrastructure and IT operations supporting our growing global organization.

Scholar Rock is looking for a leader who is equally comfortable building the roadmap and rolling up their sleeves to deliver it. This individual brings strong technical judgment, a high sense of ownership, and a service mindset and knows how to build an IT organization that is scalable as the company grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for the reliability, scalability, and day-to-day operation of Scholar Rock’s IT environment across the U.S. and international locations. The successful candidate will set direction, build and develop the team, and remain close enough to the technology and business to solve problems and drive execution.

This leader will strengthen the capabilities we need today while building the infrastructure and operating model required to support Scholar Rock’s continued growth and global commercialization.

Own Scholar Rock’s global IT infrastructure and operations, including cloud and Microsoft platforms, networks, identity, endpoints, collaboration technologies, and end-user computing
Lead IT service delivery and end-user support, ensuring responsive, reliable support and a strong employee technology experience
Build scalable infrastructure, operating processes, and standards to support continued growth and an expanding global footprint
Drive operational excellence and reliability, including incident and problem management, root-cause resolution, monitoring, technology lifecycle management, capacity planning, and continuous improvement
Ensure appropriate business continuity, disaster recovery, backup, and infrastructure resilience capabilities are established, tested, and maintained
Lead technology infrastructure and operational readiness for new offices and international expansion
Build and develop a high-performing team with strong technical capability, clear accountability, documented processes, and appropriate coverage and redundancy across critical services
Own managed service providers and key technology vendors, establishing clear performance expectations, service levels, cost and accountability
Partner across IT and the business to ensure infrastructure and operations meet security, compliance, and business requirements
Serve as a trusted technology partner to the business while remaining hands-on and engaged in execution, particularly for complex issues and critical incidents
Own the Infrastructure & IT Operations budget, including technology investments, licensing, managed services, and vendor contracts, balancing service, scalability, and cost
Ensure infrastructure and operational practices support applicable GxP, SOX, security, privacy, and audit-readiness requirements, in partnership with Quality, Security, and Compliance

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline
12+ years of progressive IT experience with leadership responsibility across infrastructure and IT operations/service delivery
Strong technical knowledge across Microsoft 365/Azure, identity and access, endpoint management, networking, cloud technologies, and enterprise IT operations
Demonstrated experience building and scaling IT capabilities, teams, and operating models in a growing organization
Experience supporting a geographically distributed or global organization
Proven ability to lead internal teams and external service providers while maintaining clear internal ownership and accountability
Strong operational judgment with a willingness to engage directly when needed

jobs.title: FinOps Platform Engineering, Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
This is a hybrid remote/in-office role, Iselin, NJ

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team:

FinOps operates like a product team: the business — Engineering, Product, Finance, Procurement, and Operations — is our customer, and cost/usage insight is the product. The FinOps Platform Engineering, Sr. Manager is the technical builder who makes that possible: this role owns the tooling, integrations, and automation that let FinOps operate as an autonomous, standalone unit rather than a group of people manually pulling numbers on request.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the Sr. Manager level. You will design, code, and ship the FinOps platform yourself — the title reflects seniority and scope of ownership, not a coordination or people-management function.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain the tooling and integrations that connect cost and usage data sources — AWS, Snowflake, and HDC (our clinical data cloud) — into a unified FinOps platform.
Build automated tagging enforcement and validation pipelines against the framework defined by the FinOps Architect, so compliance is built in at deploy time, not checked after the fact.
Build self-service tools and APIs that let Engineering, Product, and Finance pull their own cost and usage insights on demand — treating internal stakeholders as customers of a product, not requesters in a queue.
Own the data pipelines feeding executive and team-level dashboards (ThoughtSpot, Unified Portal), including reconciliation logic that ties attributed and unattributed spend back to the invoice — automating what would otherwise require manual analysis.
Automate cost allocation, showback/chargeback calculations, and unit-economics computations (e.g., cost per trial, cost per environment).
Instrument and meter AI/LLM usage and spend across providers — token-level telemetry, attribution to teams and workloads, and integration with gateway and measurement tooling — so AI cost is as visible and governable as cloud cost.
Build integrations with vendor and procurement systems to automate renewal tracking, contract data ingestion, and scorecard generation.
Build anomaly detection and automated alerting on cost and usage data, closing the gap between a monthly report and a real-time signal.
Build automation to audit and optimize Savings Plan / Reserved Instance coverage, rather than tracking it manually.
Partner with Engineering to instrument systems for cost and usage telemetry at the source, including detection of cost regressions introduced by code and configuration changes.
Own the technical roadmap for FinOps tooling, including build-vs-buy decisions on platform components.
Apply standard engineering rigor — version control, testing, CI/CD — to the FinOps tooling stack.
Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.

Qualifications:

7+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, with a Bachelor's degree; hands-on experience building FinOps or cloud cost management capabilities, products, or services is a strong plus.
Demonstrated fluency building with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as an integral part of your production engineering workflow.
Hands-on engineering skills: proficiency in Python or a comparable language, strong SQL, and experience designing APIs and data pipelines.
Hands-on expertise with AWS and Snowflake, including integrating with cloud provider billing and usage data (e.g., AWS Cost & Usage Reports, Snowflake usage views) and BI/analytics platforms (e.g., ThoughtSpot, Tableau).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, CI/CD) sufficient to enforce tagging and policy at deploy time.
Ability to design and ship self-service tooling for internal stakeholders — a product mindset applied to an internal function.
Experience building alerting or anomaly-detection systems, or automating financial/operational calculations, is a plus.
Experience metering or governing AI/LLM usage and spend (token-level cost attribution, LLM gateways, or usage telemetry) is a plus.
Ability to work independently to stand up new integrations with minimal direction, in service of a standalone, self-sufficient FinOps function.
