Job title
: Senior Director, Patient Support Services Platform Solutions

Location: Cambridge, MA

About The Job

The Senior Director, Patient Support Services (PSS) Platform Solutions will drive the transformation of Sanofi Specialty Care PSS across Therapeutic Areas through strategic and tactical leadership of platform development, projects and programs that will optimize the patient experience, improve productivity, and increase automation. Responsibility will span all applicable technology platforms including but not limited to PSS CRMs and Events Management tools. The ideal candidate will bring a strong enterprise mindset, with the ability to architect and drive scalable solutions across multiple therapy archetypes, ensuring platform strategies are both cohesive at the enterprise level and responsive to the unique needs of each therapeutic area.

The candidate must be solution-oriented, operationally savvy, creative, highly organized, flexible, resilient in a fast changing environment, and adept at working in a matrix environment where commercial and digital functions intersect, handling multiple projects with tight deadlines and multiple stakeholders. He/She must be able to lead and influence across leadership and teams. This will be a highly visible position interacting with many internal functional groups within Sanofi Specialty Care PSS, as well as external vendors. The position will report to the Head, of Patient Support Services Program Operations.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities

Leadership

Lead, structure, and develop the Platform Solutions Team, establishing clear ways of working and internal processes that enable the team to operate effectively
Manage and influence cross-functional teams and external vendor partners to drive flawless execution of complex, multi-stakeholder platform initiatives on time and within budget
Act as a confident and independent voice at the interface between PSS and Digital, able to challenge either side constructively when warranted to achieve the best possible outcome
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, resolve conflicts, and remove barriers to execution through strong influencing skills and executive presence

Business Requirements and UAT Ownership

Serve as the accountable Business Owner for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across platform releases, ensuring the team fulfils its end-to-end UAT responsibilities including test case input, execution oversight, and go/ no-go sign off in line with Sanofi policy.
Oversee the team’s ownership of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), ensuring requirements are developed collaboratively with Therapy Areas, Product Owners and other functions, and that they consistently meet the standard required for build readiness
Establish and embed team practices and quality standards for BRD development and UAT execution, ensuring the team has the structure, support, and process clarity to perform these accountabilities consistently across releases and TAs

Strategic Vision & Product Ownership

Serve as the strategic product owner for PSS platform solutions, defining vision, roadmap, and prioritization of features that deliver measurable business value and enhanced patient outcomes
Drive automation and evolution of the CRM ecosystem enabling integrated innovation
Accountable for PSS roadmap ownership to include new launches, innovation and optimization of current systems
Owner of business process documentation, alignment, grooming, release communication and training of system changes

Innovation

Collaborate with Head of Program Operations, Digital, and PSS Innovation to architect advanced analytics and real-time intelligence capabilities that transform platform data into actionable insights, predictive analytics, and strategic business intelligence that drives continuous optimization and innovation beyond traditional reporting

Enterprise Focus & Scalability

Apply enterprise-level thinking to design scalable, future-proof platform solutions that can be leveraged across multiple therapy archetypes, ensuring consistency, interoperability, and efficiency at scale
Lead end-to-end enterprise solutioning by connecting business needs across diverse therapy archetypes to unified platform strategies that reduce redundancy and accelerate time-to-value
Serve as the enterprise product owner across PSS platforms, driving a cohesive product strategy that balances therapy-specific needs with enterprise-wide standards and scalability

Stakeholder Management

Develop and execute comprehensive stakeholder communication strategies that ensure alignment, transparency, and buy-in across all levels of the organization, from operational teams to executive leadership
Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences, facilitating informed decision-making and strategic alignment

About You

A minimum of a Bachelor's Degree is required
A minimum of 10+ years of professional experience in the Biotech/Pharma industry is required
A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience leading the design, implementation, and optimization of CRM systems (Salesforce, Salesforce Health Cloud, or equivalent enterprise platforms) is required
A minimum of 5+ years of experience leading and managing teams
Demonstrated experience building CRM solutions from the ground up, including requirements gathering, system architecture, user experience design, and post-launch optimization
Proven track record of strategic thinking with the ability to envision long-term platform evolution, anticipate industry trends, and translate business strategy into actionable technology roadmaps
Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to build consensus, negotiate priorities, and drive alignment across multiple stakeholders with competing interests pared with the independence and confidence to constructively challenge stakeholders when direction is misaligned or standards are not being met
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to craft and deliver compelling presentations, facilitate productive meetings, and maintain clear, consistent communication across all organizational levels
Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and developing teams of technical and functional professionals, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Proven product ownership capabilities including backlog management, user story development, sprint planning, and delivering iterative value in agile environments
Demonstrated literacy across delivery and program tooling, including Jira or equivalent platforms, with the ability to operate within and set standards for how the team tracks, manages, and reports on work
Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with all cross-functional groups across levels
Strong presentation skills and ability to influence without direct authority
Selected candidate will possess strong and proven Project Management skills
Demonstrated ability to manage and execute multiple complex initiatives simultaneously while maintaining quality, meeting deadlines, and adapting to changing priorities
Track record of driving measurable business outcomes through platform solutions, with strong analytical skills to define success metrics and demonstrate ROI
Demonstrated enterprise thinking with the ability to architect holistic, scalable solutions that span multiple therapy archetypes, balancing standardization with the flexibility required to meet unique therapeutic area needs
Strong product ownership across diverse therapy archetypes, with a track record of managing competing priorities, aligning stakeholders across therapeutic areas, and delivering platform solutions that meet both enterprise and therapy-specific requirements

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced Degree in Information Technology, MBA or closely related field is highly preferred
Knowledge of Specialty Care market is preferred
Current or recent experience with Scaled Agile Methodology is preferred

Why Choose Us

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness program

new_jobs.title: Head of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About Overlay
Overlay is building the world's first intelligent makeup robot, reimagining beauty application through robotics, perception, and design. As a venture-backed, pre-launch startup, we're defining a new category of personal robotics at the intersection of self-expression and engineering. We're a small team inventing what doesn't yet exist and turning it into something beautiful.

About the Role
We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead the team that takes Overlay's robot from working prototype to a manufactured consumer product. You will own the engineering organization, the technical roadmap for the hardware, and the relationship with our contract manufacturer in China as we move through EVT, DVT and PVT toward first customer shipments.

This is a player-coach role, split roughly 50/50 between engineering leadership and hands-on individual-contributor work. You will lead a team of experienced mechanical, robotics, and computer-vision engineers, and you will personally carry meaningful technical work in the hardware domain you know best, whether that's mechanical, electrical or mechatronics.

You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with cross-functional partners plus external vendors and our overseas manufacturing partners. You should expect regular travel to China over the next 12 months to ensure the first production run goes smoothly.

What You'll Own
Lead, coach and grow Overlay's engineering team, setting priorities, unblocking work and holding a high bar for quality and pace.
Own the engineering roadmap and work closely with our software and mechanical leads to go from current prototypes through EVT, DVT, PVT and production ramp.
Serve as a key engineering counterpart to our contract manufacturer and suppliers in China, including on-site build support, DFM reviews, issue resolution and supplier qualification.
Carry hands-on technical ownership of a core hardware domain (mechanical, electrical or mechatronics): architecture, design reviews, test plans and failure analysis.
Establish the engineering practices a consumer hardware company needs at this stage: requirements, design reviews, BOM and revision management, test and validation, and documentation.
Drive reliability, safety and regulatory readiness for a device that operates close to the face, working with outside experts as needed.
Build the engineering culture: how we make decisions, give feedback, run reviews and support each other, with the same care for the people as for the hardware.
Recruit, interview and onboard the next wave of engineers as the team grows, and shape roles and levels as the org scales.
Partner with the CEO on technical strategy, budget, hiring plans and board-level updates on engineering progress.

What We're Looking For
12+ years of hardware engineering experience, with a degree in mechanical, electrical or mechatronics engineering or equivalent depth.
You have brought at least one consumer electronics product from concept through mass production and into customers' hands.
Deep working knowledge of manufacturing: DFM, tooling, EVT/DVT/PVT, yield and quality systems, and what it takes to ramp with a contract manufacturer.
Experience working directly with manufacturers and suppliers in China, and willingness to travel there regularly for builds and supplier visits.
3+ years leading engineers, with a track record of building teams that people want to stay on and that ship.
Still hands-on: you want to spend half your time designing, reviewing and debugging hardware, not only managing.
Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and explaining the reasoning clearly to engineers, executives and partners.
Experience with electromechanical systems that combine motors, sensors, embedded control and firmware, and enough fluency across disciplines to lead a cross-functional team.
Thrive in a small, resource-conscious startup where the job is to invent, build and ship.

What Success Looks Like
The robot enters tooling and then ships to first customers as a reliable, scalable product.
Builds run smoothly because the team and the contract manufacturer share clear specs, owners and decisions.
Engineers on the team describe the culture as demanding, supportive and clear about what matters. People know why their work matters, how it connects to what ships, and what great looks like.
The team trusts your judgment because you listen first, explain your reasoning, give credit generously and own mistakes openly, including your own.
Engineers are energized by the work: they bring ideas forward without being asked, celebrate each other's wins and stay through the hard stretches because they believe in the product and in each other.
The team grows without losing quality, speed or cohesion, and new hires ramp quickly.

Bonus Points
Experience with robotics, wearables or other products that operate close to the body.
Experience with fluid handling, dispensing or consumable cartridge systems.
Familiarity with safety and regulatory paths for consumer devices.
Experience taking a team from prototype builds to a first production ramp at a startup.
Working proficiency in Mandarin.

Why Join Overlay
Lead the engineering team that brings a category-defining consumer robot to market.
Work across robotics, beauty, manufacturing and advanced product development.
Shape how a hardware engineering organization operates from its earliest days, and grow with it.
Stay hands-on: this is a role for a leader who still wants to build.
Join a small, ambitious, experienced team with high creative and technical ownership.
Receive competitive compensation, early-stage equity and comprehensive benefits.

Compensation and Benefits
The base salary range for this role is $250K - $300K, depending on experience and level. The package also includes early-stage equity, medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) match, flexible time off and commuter benefits.

About Zencore

Zencore was founded by former Google Cloud leaders and engineers with one singular focus: to reduce risk and ensure enterprise client success on Google Cloud. We are a Premier Google Cloud Partner and a four-time Google Cloud Partner of the Year. With private equity backing and a high-growth global delivery model (spanning the US, LATAM, and EMEA), Zencore combines senior technical talent, deep AI specialization, and rapid execution to tackle mission-critical cloud, data, and agentic AI initiatives.

About The Role

Zencore is seeking a proven, dual-threat executive to serve as Head of Engineering and Delivery.

In this role, you will be the primary architect of Zencore’s technology vision and the operational leader responsible for scaling our global delivery practice. You will ensure delivery quality across a multi-geo workforce, drive technical innovation, and serve as a prominent technical executive across our enterprise client base and the Google Cloud ecosystem.

This is a pivotal executive seat requiring a balance of deep technical credibility in cloud/AI, disciplined services operations (margin, utilization, governance), and executive presence to co-sell alongside Google Cloud field leadership.

Responsibilities
2. Professional Services & Delivery Operations

3. Go-To-Market & Google Cloud Alliance

Technical Strategy & Leadership
Define Technical Vision: Set the overall technology strategy, solution architecture standards, and innovation roadmap for Zencore, keeping us at the forefront of cloud, data engineering, and agentic AI.
Productize Services & IP: Drive the evolution of Zencore’s proprietary assets and repeatable frameworks.
Market Presence & Thought Leadership: Serve as Zencore’s primary technical voice in the market—speaking at major ecosystem events, authoring whitepapers, and building relationships with Google Cloud go to market, product and engineering teams.
Global Delivery Model: Scale and govern an agile, multi-geographic delivery structure across North America, LATAM, and EMEA, ensuring seamless cross-geo resourcing and delivery consistency.
Portfolio Governance: Establish rigorous quality gates, RAID management, and project health reviews to ensure engagements land on time, on budget, and beyond SOW expectations. Personally serve as executive delivery sponsor for strategic enterprise accounts.
Executive Pre-Sales & Deal Shaping: Partner with sales leadership on complex enterprise pursuits—shaping technical architectures, scoping SOWs, leading technical pitches, and converting opportunities into revenue.
Hyperscaler Channel Alignment: Build deep, trusted relationships with Google Cloud Account Directors, Regional Directors, and PSO leadership to position Zencore as the preferred co-sell partner for complex enterprise accounts.
Account Expansion (Land & Expand): Drive organic account growth by embedding discovery mechanisms into active delivery, converting one-off modernization projects into continuous, multi-year AI and managed service relationships.

Qualifications

15+ Years of Experience: Extensive track record leading complex technology programs, with 7+ years in an engineering leadership role within a professional services firm, systems integrator, or cloud consultancy.
Deep Google Cloud & AI Experience: Hands-on technical background and deep architectural credibility in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), modern data platforms, and enterprise AI/GenAI implementations.
Proven P&L & Operations Ownership: Accountability for professional services revenues, including billable utilization, gross margin optimization, blended rate card management, and delivery risk management.
Hyperscaler Co-Sell Experience: Demonstrated expertise navigating cloud partner ecosystems, co-selling alongside field sales teams, and leveraging partner incentive programs (e.g., Google RAMP/MDF).
Multi-Geo Delivery Expertise: Direct experience building and leading remote, distributed delivery organizations across onshore, nearshore, and offshore regions (US, LATAM, EMEA).
Executive Presence: Ability to engage effortlessly with C-suite executives (CTOs, CIOs, CDOs) as a trusted advisor, translating complex technical trade-offs into clear business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior leadership experience at Google Cloud, a Premier Google Cloud Partner, or an enterprise Systems Integrator.
Active Google Cloud Certifications (Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, or AI/ML Specialist).
Experience navigating Private Equity governance, reporting, and value-creation milestones.

We Are Trusted Experts: Our teams bring deep, hands-on experience to solve the hardest cloud and AI challenges.
We Value Candor: We share unbiased opinions and aren't afraid of hard truths—our clients view us as true subject matter experts.

new_jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering – Network Automation and AI Solutions
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished Director, Software Engineering – Network Automation and AI Solutions
to lead the transformation of how we design, engineer, operate, and support our network infrastructure through automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and modern software engineering practices.

This leader will be responsible for defining and executing the technology strategy across network automation, OSS platforms, operational tooling, AI-enabled engineering workflows, network correlation, inventory management, ticketing integration, and network triage systems. The Director will provide architectural leadership and technical direction for software engineering teams developing scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, service quality, and customer experience across Zayo's network operations and engineering organizations. The ideal candidate combines deep telecommunications and network operations expertise with modern software engineering leadership, leveraging AI, automation, and orchestration technologies to accelerate delivery, reduce operational complexity, and enable a more proactive and intelligent network operating model.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategic roadmap for network automation, OSS modernization, and AI-driven operational transformation.
Lead and develop software engineering teams responsible for network automation, OSS platforms, and operational tooling.
Establish architectural standards, engineering best practices, and scalable solutions across monitoring, inventory, correlation, ticketing, and network management systems.
Drive adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve network operations, service delivery, and engineering workflows.
Identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, service quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.
Provide technical leadership for the design, development, integration, and support of automation platforms and enterprise OSS applications.
Partner with business and technology leaders to align automation investments with strategic objectives and operational priorities.
Establish engineering metrics, performance standards, and KPIs to measure delivery excellence and business impact.
Lead operational transformation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and accelerate incident detection and resolution.
Collaborate across Engineering, Network Operations, Product, Security, Architecture, and IT to drive enterprise-wide automation and technology initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities

Evaluate emerging technologies, AI platforms, LLM frameworks, and automation capabilities to support innovation and continuous improvement.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on automation, software engineering, AI strategy, and operational modernization.
Influence enterprise technology decisions through technical expertise, business acumen, and organizational leadership.
Foster a high-performance engineering culture focused on innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and customer success.
Communicate technical strategies, roadmap progress, and business outcomes effectively to technical and executive audiences.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.
Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in software engineering, network automation, OSS development, network operations, or related technical disciplines.
Minimum of five (5) years of engineering leadership experience managing software development or automation teams.
Hands-on experience with Cisco Crosswork Network Controller (CNC) and Cisco Network Services Orchestrator (NSO), including network automation, orchestration, and service lifecycle management.
Proven experience leading large-scale automation and operational transformation initiatives.
Strong expertise in software architecture, distributed systems, and enterprise application development.
Hands-on experience with Python, JavaScript, and modern development frameworks.
Experience designing and implementing AI-enabled automation solutions in production environments.
Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, SSL, HTTP(S), SSH, routing, switching, and network management principles.
Experience with network monitoring and management technologies including SNMP, Syslog, telemetry, and event management systems.
Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Telecommunications, fiber network, carrier, or large-scale infrastructure industry experience.
Experience with IBM/Tivoli Netcool, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Splunk, or similar OSS and operational platforms.
Knowledge of network inventory, service assurance, fault management, and operational support systems.
Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI orchestration frameworks, agent-based architectures, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, APIs, microservices, and modern integration platforms.
Experience building AI governance frameworks and responsible AI operating models.
Knowledge of network engineering, service delivery, and customer-facing operational processes.

Success Measures

Increased automation adoption across network engineering and operational workflows.
Reduction in manual operational effort and process cycle times.
Improved network reliability, service quality, and incident resolution performance.
Successful delivery of strategic OSS modernization and AI transformation initiatives.
Measurable operational savings and productivity improvements.

Estimated base salary range: $142,600 - $219,400 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement:
This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.

The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.

Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.

The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.

Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

As part of the application, hiring, onboarding, and/or employment process, Zayo or its affiliates, partners, and vendors may collect, store, and use biometric identifiers and biometric information (collectively, “Biometric Data”), such as fingerprints, facial geometry scans or other unique biological characteristics. Zayo uses CLEAR1, a third-party identity verification service, to verify applicant identity during the hiring process. CLEAR1 may collect Biometric Data, including facial geometry scans and/or other biometric identifiers, to authenticate your identity. Biometric Data will be retained pursuant to CLEAR1’s policies, which can be found here: https://www.clearme.com/clear1-credential-policy-crp. new_jobs.title: Head of Field Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About Runlayer

AI is transforming how every company operates, but most enterprises are stuck. They want to move fast with AI Agents, tools, and workflows, but they can't do it safely. We're fixing that.

Our team built AI Actions for OpenAI, shipped Zapier Agents to millions of users, and launched the first remote MCP server with Anthropic. We helped establish the protocol, and now we're building the platform enterprises need to actually put AI to work.

Runlayer is one platform for MCPs, Skills, and Agents
: purpose-built security, fine-grained governance, and complete observability so organizations can go all-in on AI across the entire company without the risk. We just raised a $30M Series A led by Felicis, with participation from Khosla Ventures, bringing our total raised to $42M.
Already trusted by Gusto, Instacart, Opendoor, dbt Labs, and Decagon.

About The Role

As our Head of Field Engineering, you'll build and lead the team responsible for the technical side of Runlayer's customer motion. You'll own Forward Deployed Engineering end-to-end, taking the function from three engineers today to ten by year-end and into a multi-region organization in the year that follows.

Why You'll Thrive Here

Impact: You will define how Runlayer's customers move from initial interest to enterprise-wide deployment, owning the team that converts pilots into production at the world's most demanding companies.
Excellence: You'll partner directly with the CEO, CPO, and VP of Go-to-Market to build the technical playbook that takes a customer from first touch to thousands of seats deployed.
Ownership: You'll recruit, hire, ramp, and lead the team; build the onboarding program; codify operational standards; and establish the technical best practices that scale with the business.

What You'll Do

Build and lead the Forward Deployed Engineering team. Recruit, hire, and onboard the next seven Forward Deployed Engineers, with continued hiring through the following year.
Establish the onboarding program. Define how new Forward Deployed Engineers ramp on the product, demo motion, pilot execution, and customer engagement standards.
Bring operational rigor to the existing team. Codify how the team moves a customer from initial interest to a thousand-plus seat deployment, with consistent quality and predictable outcomes.
Define the technical playbook for enterprise deployments. Develop the practices that govern how Runlayer is integrated, configured, and scaled inside large enterprise environments.
Partner across the leadership team. Work closely with Go-to-Market, Product, and Engineering leadership on team design, compensation structure, territory model, and customer health.
Scale the function programmatically. In year two, hire regional leaders, operate through them, and stand up a repeatable execution layer underneath.

What We're Looking For

Senior operating experience. Ten or more years of relevant professional experience, including significant time in senior individual contributor and leadership roles within technical, customer-facing organizations.
Strong technical foundation. A degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field from a strong undergraduate program.
Practitioner background. Direct experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or in a comparable technical customer-facing capacity. You've done the work yourself before leading others doing it.
Early-stage operating experience. Time spent at an early-stage startup, where you've built a function or team from the ground up.

new_jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager Senior
new_jobs.description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

“I can influence my income.”

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options
Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love
Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as a Technology Operations Senior Manager at Capital Group.”

We are scaling our global technology operations to deliver highly available, secure, and efficient services. As a Technology Operations Senior Manager, you will play a critical role in shaping our evolving operations organization while leading core technology operations capabilities.

This leader will initially oversee select operational domains and own the development and execution of operational strategy for those areas, partnering closely with senior technology leaders to define the future-state operating model, team structure, and investment priorities. Flexibility, systems thinking, and strong leadership judgment will be essential as teams, scope, and responsibilities evolve alongside the organization.

In addition, this role will champion availability, scalability, resilience, and reliability across cloud, network, and on-premise platforms, while influencing the broader technology organization to adopt similar standards. The leader will drive adoption of modern, AI-enabled and automation-first capabilities to enhance operational effectiveness, simplify complexity, and scale sustainably.

A key accountability includes ensuring global compliance with IT Service Management standards, tools, and processes, while continuously improving the quality, integrity, and strategic value of operational data.

Key Responsibilities

Define, articulate, and evolve operational strategy for foundational technology services, aligning near-term execution with long-term business and technology outcomes.
Translate enterprise technology and business strategy into clear operating models, including capability roadmaps, staffing approaches, and investment priorities.
Partner with senior leaders to shape the future-state technology operations organization, including scope boundaries, accountability models, and engagement patterns across teams.
Demonstrate a disciplined, relentless focus on operational rigor, reliability, and strategic execution across cloud and on-premise platforms.
Lead and evolve multiple technology operations capabilities, adapting scope and structure as the organization matures.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled and automation-first practices to reduce operating costs, decrease reliance on third-party providers, and scale repeatable processes.
Promote a data-driven operations model, using metrics, telemetry, and insights to inform decision-making and continuous improvement.
Demonstrate calm, confident leadership during high-severity incidents, including incident command and executive-level communication.
Drive operations cost optimization and efficiency across the portfolio.
Establish and reinforce resilience, recoverability, and sustainability as non-negotiable standards and influence peers to adopt similar practices.
Ensure adherence to IT Service Management (ITSM) standards and processes (Event, Incident, Problem, Change, etc.).
Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed leadership team, strengthening operational maturity and leadership depth.
Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Cultivate a proactive, forward-looking operations mindset that minimizes outage risk through anticipation rather than reaction.
Contribute meaningfully to a globally aligned technology operations strategy, influencing direction beyond immediate areas of responsibility.
Manage operational and strategic investment budgets, delivery timelines, and performance metrics.
Collaborate with Vendor Management to build and maintain strong relationships with critical third-party vendors and SaaS providers.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (master’s preferred).
10+ years of progressive IT leadership experience managing global teams and complex operational environments.
Strong strategic thinking with experience developing and executing operational strategy tied to long-term business objectives.

new_jobs.description:

About Vehlo

We started Vehlo in 2019 with a simple goal: to be the industry’s favorite provider of repair shop technology.

Across every part of the auto repair industry, Vehlo is igniting vehicle service success with software and financial solutions that unlock your potential. Our founder-led products power the entire service lane experience and keep customers coming back with streamlined tools that help you handle communication, workflow automation, touchless payments, valet pickup, and much more. We’re out to simplify the customer journey from start to finish and give power back to the people under the hood, making their jobs easier and your shop more profitable —just ask our over 30,000 customers, who generate more than 50M annual repair orders. At Vehlo, our only purpose is your success, and together, we’re reaching your goals faster than ever.

Being a Veep comes with more than a comprehensive benefits package—our biggest benefit is opportunity: Opportunity to make an impact, opportunity for growth, and opportunity for recognition and rewards. This is not a mega-corporation where you wonder what people are doing all day - every Veep is moving the ball forward day in, day out for our customers or for each other.

About This Role

Vehlo is seeking an innovative and visionary Director, Information Technology & Enterprise AI,
to lead the next evolution of our technology, security, and AI capabilities. This leader will be responsible for developing and executing a modern enterprise technology strategy that enables business growth, strengthens cybersecurity resilience, improves operational efficiency, and accelerates responsible AI adoption across the organization.

Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Director will serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating business objectives into scalable technology solutions while fostering a culture of security, innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance operational excellence with forward-looking technology leadership, ensuring Vehlo remains secure, agile, and positioned to capitalize on emerging technologies.

Scope of the AI mandate

This role owns Enterprise AI: the platforms, governance, security, spend, and adoption of AI used to run Vehlo’s business, including the enterprise AI assistants deployed across the company. It also owns the AI governance and security framework that applies company-wide. Delivery of AI capabilities inside Vehlo’s products remains with Product and Engineering; this role sets the standards those teams build against, reviews against them, and escalates gaps.

What You’ll Do:

Technology Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute a multi-year IT, cybersecurity, and AI roadmap aligned with company growth objectives.
Serve as a technology advisor to leadership on emerging technologies, industry trends, cyber risks, and AI opportunities.
Lead enterprise technology governance, architecture, standards, and best practices.
Drive digital transformation initiatives that improve employee productivity, customer outcomes, and operational scalability.
Establish a culture focused on innovation, service excellence, accountability, and business partnership.
Lead technology platform integrations for acquired businesses

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

Own enterprise cybersecurity strategy, risk management, and security operations.
Oversee implementation and continuous improvement of security frameworks including NIST CSF, CIS Controls, SOC 2, and other relevant compliance requirements.
Lead incident response planning, tabletop exercises, business continuity, and disaster recovery programs.
Manage security awareness and training initiatives to strengthen organizational cyber resilience.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risks.
Oversee endpoint security, identity and access management, network security, cloud security, threat detection, and vulnerability management.
Ensure security-by-design principles are embedded across infrastructure, applications, and AI initiatives.
Extend the security program to AI systems: model and vendor risk assessment, data-loss prevention across AI channels, threat modeling for prompt injection and agent misuse, logging and monitoring of AI activity, and incident response procedures that cover AI-specific failure modes.

Enterprise AI Strategy & Governance

Own the enterprise AI strategy, governance framework, and adoption roadmap for AI used to run Vehlo’s business.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and generative AI to increase organizational effectiveness and scalability.
Partner with business leaders to evaluate and implement AI-enabled solutions that drive measurable business value.
Develop and maintain policies and controls for responsible AI use, data protection, risk management, and regulatory compliance, aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 and to evolving AI regulation.
Lead role-based AI enablement and change management, with defined adoption targets by function rather than general awareness training.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, rationalize the tool portfolio to avoid overlapping spend, and recommend investments that create competitive advantage.
Serve as the governance and security authority for AI across Vehlo, including AI embedded in Vehlo products, without owning product AI delivery.

Enterprise AI Platform Operations

Administer Vehlo’s enterprise AI platforms (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and successors): tenant and workspace configuration, SSO and SCIM provisioning, role and permission models, data retention settings, and audit logging.
Manage AI licensing and spend: seat allocation and reclamation, plan tiering, API and consumption cost monitoring, showback to business units, and renewal negotiation.
Govern the AI integration surface — MCP servers, connectors, plugins, and agent access to enterprise systems — through a defined intake, security review, approval, and periodic recertification process.
Define and enforce data boundaries for AI: which classes of Vehlo and customer data may be used with which models, and under which contractual terms for training, retention, and sub-processors, in partnership with Legal, Security, and Product.
Manage identity and access for non-human actors: service accounts, agent credentials, least-privilege scoping, activity monitoring, and rapid revocation for AI agents operating in enterprise systems.
Detect and remediate unsanctioned AI use, and provide a sanctioned alternative that makes the approved path the easier one.
Instrument adoption and value: usage telemetry, adoption and utilization reporting by function, and measured productivity or cost impact against stated targets.
Run the enterprise AI evaluation process: structured vendor and model assessment, security and privacy review, pilot design, success criteria, and go/no-go recommendations.
Own AI-related responses to customer, auditor, and sponsor diligence, including security questionnaires, AI use disclosures, and control evidence.

IT Operations & Infrastructure

Ensure reliable, secure, and efficient delivery of enterprise technology services.
Lead end-user support, collaboration platforms, endpoint management, and workplace technology services.
Oversee Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, enterprise AI assistants, identity management, endpoint solutions, and enterprise productivity platforms.
Drive infrastructure modernization, cloud optimization, and operational automation initiatives.
Partner with cloud and managed service providers to maintain high-performing, cost-effective technology environments.
Establish service level objectives (SLOs), performance metrics, and operational KPIs.

Cloud & Platform Security

Collaborate with AWS, DevOps, and engineering teams to enhance cloud security posture and governance.
Establish cloud security architecture standards and monitoring capabilities.
Implement security controls, automation, and compliance capabilities across cloud environments.
Support secure development practices and DevSecOps initiatives.

Financial, Vendor, Facility Management

Develop and manage the IT and security budget.
Evaluate technology investments and ensure alignment with strategic priorities and ROI objectives.
Lead vendor selection, contract negotiations, performance management, and optimization efforts.
Identify opportunities to reduce risk, improve efficiency, and optimize technology spend.
Own the enterprise AI budget as a distinct line item, with unit economics — cost per active user and cost per workflow automated — and a stated payback expectation.
Manage workplace and facilities technology across Vehlo locations, including remote and hybrid offices in the United States and Mexico.

People Leadership

Build, mentor, and develop high-performing IT and security teams.
Foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and technical excellence.
Establish clear performance expectations and career development opportunities.
Lead cross-functional collaboration across technology, product, operations, finance, HR, and business teams.

Qualifications

What You’ll Need:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
7+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.
3+ years leading enterprise IT, cybersecurity, or digital transformation programs.
Experience developing and implementing cybersecurity frameworks and risk management programs.
Experience managing cloud-based environments, preferably AWS and Microsoft ecosystems.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, infrastructure, networking, endpoint management, and SaaS platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing executive stakeholders.
Exceptional communication, leadership, and strategic planning skills.
Hands-on experience deploying and administering an enterprise generative AI platform (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent) at organizational scale, including tenant administration, access control, data governance settings, and license management.
Experience establishing AI governance in an enterprise: acceptable-use policy, tool intake and review, data-use boundaries, and adoption measurement.
Experience leading IT and security integration of acquired businesses.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or related discipline.
CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, Security+, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Security certifications, or equivalent credentials.
Experience with private equity-backed, SaaS, or multi-entity organizations.
Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, privacy regulations, and modern governance frameworks.
Global experience with operations in Mexico
Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, and emerging US state AI regulation.
Experience with agentic AI and non-human identity management.

The VP, Data/AI Platform owns the enterprise data platform, the artificial intelligence and machine learning agenda, and the shared platform services every product team builds on. As Vice President, you set the strategy for how we turn our most valuable asset, data, into a competitive advantage leveraging AI.

You lead a multidisciplinary organization spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning across the United States and India. You are accountable to the Chief Technology Officer and to the executive leadership team for the reliability and economics of the data platform, for moving artificial intelligence capability from idea into production at a pace the market rewards, and for the governance that makes all of it defensible to customers, auditors, and regulators.

Recruit, develop, and retain a high performing, diverse team across distributed locations. Conduct regular one to ones and performance conversations, build succession beneath every leadership seat, and grow the technical bench rather than concentrating expertise in a few people.

Bachelor's degree required. Advanced degree in a quantitative, computer science, or business discipline preferred.
12 or more years of relevant experience across data platform, data engineering, data science, and machine learning, including 5 or more years leading leaders.

Hands on fluency, not oversight alone, with a modern cloud data stack. Direct working experience with Snowflake and with AWS data and artificial intelligence services including Bedrock, SageMaker, and Redshift.
Demonstrated record of moving data science and machine learning work from idea into production quickly, with measurable business results attached rather than models that stopped at the prototype.
Experience building and operating on protected health information or equivalently regulated data, including data use agreements, data classification, de-identification, and access governance.
Experience owning a data platform architecture decision and the migration or modernization that followed it, including the operating model that ran it afterward.
Working knowledge of agentic artificial intelligence and large language model orchestration frameworks, retrieval augmented generation, model evaluation and responsible artificial intelligence guardrails, and human in the loop workflow design.
Experience leading globally distributed teams, including engineering capability in India.
Track record of partnering with product and commercial leaders to turn platform capability into revenue rather than into internal tooling.

Prior experience in healthcare technology, electronic health record platforms, or post-acute care across skilled nursing, home health, hospice, senior living, or private duty.
Familiarity with clinical assessment instruments and the reimbursement models built on them, and with the interoperability standards that move healthcare data, including FHIR and TEFCA participation.
Experience commercializing data, including de identified data products, benchmarking offerings, and the contractual and privacy work that makes them sellable.
Experience in a private equity backed or growth-oriented software business, including exposure to a board, audit committee, or sponsor.
Familiarity with software as a medical device consideration and the decision boundary documentation clinical models require.
Experience embedding artificial intelligence assisted delivery practices inside an engineering organization, with adoption and impact measured rather than assumed.
Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platform practices at enterprise scale.

You translate data and artificial intelligence capability into customer value and commercial outcome rather than into capability slides
You make quality decisions without incomplete information, then revisit the decision as evidence arrives
You have built organizational design, workforce planning, and budget ownership at scale
You have successfully built and mentored your teams across time zones and cultures, and grow successors rather than dependencies
You govern vendors and delivery partners without ceding technical direction to them

Reports to:
CBO Team:
People-leader for a team of Sales Engineers / Solutions Architects (player-coach at hire, scaling to full leader) Location:
[Remote / Hybrid — primary hubs TBD] · Some travel to customer sites, data centers, and NVIDIA GTC / partner events

Why this role exists

Our product is the orchestration layer that turns raw, disaggregated GPU infrastructure into a multi-tenant, production-ready AI cloud — without locking companies into a single hyperscaler or hardware vendor. We sell accelerated compute: GPU clusters, bare metal, and managed AI infrastructure to Neoclouds, AI-native startups, enterprise AI teams, research labs, and sovereign/regulated buyers. These are technical, high-value, long-cycle deals where the sale is won or lost on credibility: whether we can architect the right cluster, model the real TCO, prove performance, and de-risk a customer's move onto our platform.

This person owns the technical win. They build and lead the sales engineering function that turns "interested" into signed, multi-year committed-capacity contracts, and they set the
pre-sales bar as we scale headcount and deal volume.

This is not a demo-jockey role. We need someone who has genuinely stood up training and inference workloads, argued interconnect topology with a customer's ML infra lead, and closed large deals with cycles measured in quarters, not weeks.

What you'll own

Lead and build the SE / Solutions Architect team

Hire, coach, and retain a team of sales engineers and solutions architects; define the presales operating model as the org scales.
Build the reusable machinery: discovery frameworks, reference architectures, TCO/benchmark models, POV playbooks, demo and benchmark environments, RFP response libraries.
Set and hold a technical quality bar across the team; run enablement so every SE can speak credibly to GPU architecture, networking, and orchestration.

Own the technical win in large, complex deals

Partner with Account Executives as the technical lead on strategic and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.
Run qualification with a real methodology (MEDDPICC or equivalent) — surface the economic buyer, decision criteria, and the technical champion, and build the win plan around them.
Architect solutions across compute, networking, storage, and orchestration; produce sizing, capacity plans, and TCO comparisons vs. hyperscalers and selfbuild.
Design and drive POCs/POVs: define success criteria up front, run benchmarks, and convert results into commercial momentum.

Be the technical voice of the customer internally

Feed structured product and capacity requirements back to product, platform, and supply/capacity planning.
Work alongside the NVIDIA field and partner ecosystem (Cloud Partner program, reference architectures, joint pursuits) to strengthen deals.
Influence roadmap and packaging based on what you learn in the field.

Must-have qualifications

Real, hands-on AI/ML infrastructure experience

You have actually run or stood up ML workloads — distributed training and/or production inference — not just talked about them.
Practical fluency in the training and inference lifecycle: data pipelines, distributed training (multinode/multi-GPU), fine-tuning, and serving; you understand where bottlenecks actually live (interconnect, memory bandwidth, I/O, scheduling).
Comfortable in the frameworks and tooling customers use — PyTorch and the surrounding ecosystem (e.g., NCCL, CUDAlevel concepts, containers, schedulers).

Deep knowledge of the NVIDIA platform and GPU products

Current on the NVIDIA compute stack across the Hopper and Blackwell generations (e.g., H100/H200, GB200 NVL72 / B200class systems, GraceHopper superchips) and the referencesystem families (DGX, HGX, MGX); aware of what's coming next-generation.

Networking fluency: NVLink/NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand (Quantum) vs. SpectrumX Ethernet fabrics, RDMA/RoCE, DPUs — and why fabric choice makes or breaks large training clusters.
Software and platform layer: NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM, NeMo, Triton / TensorRTLLM, Base Command, Run:ai / GPU orchestration, and the NGC ecosystem.
Understands the NVIDIA Cloud Partner motion and how to cosell with NVIDIA.

Enterprise sales engineering on long, high-value cycles

Track record supporting complex B2B deals with cycles of 6–18+ months and large ACV/TCV, ideally including multiyear committed-capacity or reserved-capacity structures.
Skilled at multistakeholder navigation — ML/infra leads, platform engineering, procurement, finance, security, and executive sponsors.
Can build and defend a TCO/ROI model against hyperscaler and onprem alternatives, and translate performance benchmarks into commercial value.

Proven team leadership

Has hired, developed, and led a sales engineering / solutions architecture team (or clearly demonstrated the readiness to), including building process and enablement from a light or greenfield starting point.
Playercoach mindset: still credible in the room on the hardest deals, while scaling others to do the same.

Strongly preferred
Experience selling GPU cloud, HPC, or specialized infrastructure — ideally at a NeoCloud / GPUcloud provider, hyperscaler AI org, or acceleratedhardware vendor.
Handson with cloud-native and cluster orchestration for AI: Kubernetes (and GPU operators / device plugins), Slurm, and multicluster management approaches; familiarity with virtualized GPU / KubeVirtstyle patterns is a plus.
Storagefor-AI literacy — highthroughput parallel/object storage and its role in training pipelines.
Experience with data center economics and constraints: power, cooling, rack density, and how capacity availability shapes deals.
Exposure to sovereign, regulated, or government AI buyers.

What good looks like

First 90 days:
deep on our platform and differentiators; embedded as technical lead on the top active opportunities; a clear read on the current team, gaps, and the pre-sales process to fix first.

6 months:
a repeatable POV and TCO framework in use across the team; measurable improvement in technical-win rate and POC-to-close conversion; a hiring plan (or hires) closing the biggest coverage gaps.

12 months:
a scaled, high-credibility SE org that AEs actively pull into strategic deals; SE involvement correlated with larger deal size, faster technical close, and higher win rate on the deals that matter most.

Compensation & logistics Structure:
competitive base + variable tied to team bookings/attainment, plus equity.
Indicative OTE:
senior people leader band.
Location / travel:
expect meaningful travel to customers, data centers, and NVIDIA/partner events.

new_jobs.title: Chief Infrastructure Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Link Solutions, Inc. delivers reliable and effective Information Technology services to government clients in support of critical mission needs. Delivering a broad range of Infrastructure Operations, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Virtualization, Cloud and Mobility services.

If you’re looking for a technology company that values innovation, with a vision toward the future of the technology landscape, look no further than Link Solutions! Link is quality and compliance-focused, under our guiding philosophy “Mission First, Customer Always".

We are certified in ISO 9001:2015, ISO 20000-1:2018, and ISO 27001:2022; CMMC Level 2 certified; and appraised at CMMI Maturity Level 3 for Services and Development.

Job Description

Link Solutions is seeking a Chief Infrastructure Engineer
to support the Army Research Laboratory (ARL) Information Technology Modernization and Support Services program in Adelphi, Maryland.

Active Secret Clearance preferred
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Non-Remote/On-site only (relocation assistance available)

As the Chief Infrastructure Engineer
, you will serve as the senior technical authority for enterprise infrastructure modernization, technology strategy, and innovation supporting the Army Research Laboratory. You will partner with Government leadership and engineering teams to assess current environments, evaluate emerging technologies, and develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency, cybersecurity, resilience, automation, and mission effectiveness.

Leveraging expertise across enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies, networking, virtualization, identity management, endpoint management, and cybersecurity, you will provide strategic guidance, lead technical assessments, and recommend innovative solutions that support long-term mission objectives. The ideal candidate is a trusted technical advisor with strong analytical and communication skills who excels at solving complex infrastructure challenges and driving technology modernization initiatives.

Job Responsibilities:

Serve as the senior technical advisor on enterprise infrastructure modernization, engineering, and technology strategy initiatives.
Evaluate existing infrastructure, operational processes, and technology implementations to identify opportunities for modernization, automation, efficiency improvements, and cost savings.
Research and assess emerging technologies, industry trends, and vendor solutions relevant to DoD, research, and enterprise environments.
Develop technical assessments, business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and technology recommendations for Government leadership.
Analyze and evaluate technologies across Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms; identity services; networking; storage; virtualization; endpoint management; cybersecurity; and cloud environments.
Develop modernization roadmaps and strategic recommendations aligned with mission, security, operational, and budget requirements.
Assist infrastructure and engineering teams in troubleshooting complex technical issues and resolving enterprise-wide challenges.
Participate in architecture reviews, engineering assessments, and technology evaluation efforts.
Review proposed technical solutions and provide recommendations regarding feasibility, scalability, security, supportability, and operational impact.
Identify opportunities to leverage automation, orchestration, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), AI-enabled technologies, and process improvements to increase operational effectiveness.
Support cybersecurity initiatives by evaluating technologies against RMF, Continuous ATO, Zero Trust, STIG, and vulnerability management requirements.
Develop technical white papers, decision briefs, recommendations, and executive presentations for Government stakeholders.
Present findings, recommendations, risks, and modernization strategies to Government and contractor leadership.
Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and industry best practices to support continuous improvement and innovation.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

Compensation Range:

$135,000 - $175,000
Full-Time (Mon-Fri)

Several factors influence the final salary rate, including but not limited to contract wage determinations, relevant work experience, role-specific skills and competencies, educational background, and certifications.

Qualifications

U.S. Citizen.
Must be willing to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret Clearance.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline.
Twelve (12+) years of progressive experience supporting, engineering, architecting, or modernizing enterprise IT environments.
Experience conducting technology assessments, architecture reviews, infrastructure analyses, and modernization planning activities.
Strong knowledge of enterprise Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.
Experience with Active Directory, identity and access management, networking, storage, virtualization, endpoint management, and cloud technologies.
Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Nutanix, VMware, Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, Microsoft Entra ID, or equivalent technologies.
Experience developing technical recommendations, business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and executive-level briefings.
Knowledge of automation, scripting, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and operational efficiency best practices.
Demonstrated ability to analyze and assist in resolving complex infrastructure and technology challenges.
Strong analytical, written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

Preferred:

Active Secret Clearance.
IAT Level II certification equivalent or higher (CompTIA Security+ CE, CISSP, CySA, etc.) in accordance with DoD 8570/8140 requirements.
Experience serving as a Chief Infrastructure Engineer, Infrastructure Architect, Enterprise Architect, Chief Systems Engineer, Technical Director, Solutions Architect, or similar senior technical role.
Experience supporting DoD, Federal, research, laboratory, or scientific computing environments.

new_jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering, Reuters
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Director, Software Engineering
will lead Reuters' content management systems engineering organization, with direct responsibility for the platform underpinning content creation, editorial workflows, and publishing on Reuters.com. Reporting to the VP, Software Engineering, this leader will direct the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of Reuters' CMS platform through a major transition, building and leading the engineering, editorial-tooling, and delivery teams responsible for its day-to-day operation and long-term evolution.

This is a hands-on leadership role: the Director is expected to act as a principal engineer when needed, providing direct technical guidance on both front-end and back-end challenges, not just organizational oversight. This leadership position will shape the technical roadmap for Reuters' CMS platform, translating editorial and business requirements into a scalable, reliable architecture.

The ideal candidate will build and lead a high-performing engineering organization spanning platform engineering, editorial tooling, and delivery operations, while establishing the standards, processes, and talent needed to support Reuters' journalism at scale. Success requires deep technical expertise in modern web and cloud architecture, proven people leadership across multiple teams, and a clear point of view on where AI can responsibly accelerate how the organization builds and ships software.

Relocation Support & Travel: Available upon discussion; minimal travel expected.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical architecture and long-term roadmap for Reuters' content management platform, directing design decisions around scalability, performance, and cost across backend services and AWS infrastructure.
Establish and maintain uptime and reliability standards for a production platform serving external customers at scale, while evaluating and guiding the platform's modern web rendering strategy.
Partner with editorial stakeholders to translate newsroom workflows into platform requirements, directing the roadmap for editorial tooling and identifying opportunities for AI-assisted content workflows that support without compromising journalistic standards.
Lead the teams responsible for platform delivery, including release management and production support, while owning the technical execution of the platform transition and establishing metrics to track platform health and operational risk.
Build, mentor, and lead a multi-team engineering organization, including managers and individual contributors, while fostering a high-performing culture grounded in ownership and continuous improvement across distributed teams.
Communicate technical strategy and tradeoffs credibly to engineers, product partners, executives, and customers while championing AI upskilling and adoption programs across the engineering organization.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing engineers, including experience managing managers or leading multiple teams
Demonstrated ownership of a production platform serving external customers at scale with experience in Agile methodologies and DevOps practices
Deep knowledge of AWS, serverless architecture, and distributed systems; strong grasp of modern web rendering (server-side and client-side rendering, React, build tooling); and working knowledge of HTTP, caching semantics, and CDN behavior in high-traffic environments
Experience with microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), test automation frameworks, and browser/system performance testing methodologies
Ability to communicate technical concepts credibly to engineers, product partners, executives, and customers, with demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams across multiple functions

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in SaaS or platform businesses where developers are among customers
Background in publishing, media technology, or content management systems, or experience leading an organization through platform consolidation or modernization
Familiarity with enterprise-scale CDN providers (particularly Akamai or CloudFront) and cloud cost optimization at scale
Experience integrating teams with divergent engineering cultures under shared standards, or exposure to AI/ML technologies with a track record of adopting AI into engineering workflows responsibly
Resilience and adaptability in the face of ambiguity, with passion for technology and its potential to drive business value; strong advocacy for diversity, inclusion, and cultural sensitivity across distributed organizations

What’s in it For You?

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $158,900 USD - $295,100 USD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

This job posting will close 10/23/2026.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

About Poshmark

Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection.
Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

About The Team

The Growth Engineering team builds experiences and platforms that drive sustainable growth across the Poshmark marketplace. The team works across the customer journey—from acquisition and onboarding to engagement, retention, and reactivation—using technology, data, and experimentation to create meaningful customer and business impact.

Growth Engineering operates in highly collaborative, cross-functional squads, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Analytics, Marketing, and other engineering teams.

As Director of Engineering (Growth)
, you will lead multiple engineering teams and managers responsible for critical growth initiatives across Poshmark. You will shape the technical strategy, build strong engineering leaders, and create a culture focused on customer outcomes, experimentation, execution, and engineering excellence.

This is not a pure management role. We expect our Directors to have the technical depth to engage in architecture discussions, challenge technical decisions, and help teams navigate complex technical and product problems.

Responsibilities

Lead multiple engineering teams and Engineering Managers across the Growth organization.
Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Analytics, and Marketing to define Growth strategy, roadmaps, and priorities.
Drive measurable improvements across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and other key growth opportunities.
