State Street is seeking a visionary AWS Federated Platform Operations Lead to lead the evolution of cloud operations toward an intelligent, automated, and AI-enabled operating model.

This role is responsible for the operational strategy, reliability, resiliency, observability, security operations governance, and operational transformation of the AWS Federated platform. The successful candidate will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, AI, and Enterprise Operations teams to deliver a secure, resilient, scalable, and highly automated cloud platform supporting the firm's most critical business workloads.

This is not a traditional infrastructure operations leadership role. Instead, the AWS Federated Platform Operations Lead will drive the next generation of cloud operations by leveraging AI, agentic workflows, automation, operational intelligence, reliability engineering, and platform-based support models to improve service quality, reduce operational risk, and accelerate innovation.

The role serves as a key member of the AWS Federated leadership team and will play a pivotal role in shaping the future multi-cloud operating model across State Street.

Key Responsibilities

Define and Execute the Cloud Operations Strategy

Develop and execute the long-term operational vision and roadmap for AWS Federated.
Establish operational standards, governance frameworks, and service management practices aligned with enterprise objectives.
Drive continuous improvement in operational maturity, platform reliability, customer experience, and service quality.
Partner with engineering leaders to integrate operability, observability, resiliency, and supportability into platform design decisions.
Influence enterprise cloud operating model strategy and operational transformation initiatives.

Lead the Transformation to AI-Powered Operations

Drive adoption of Agentic AI capabilities across cloud operations and platform management.
Establish a roadmap for autonomous cloud operations utilizing AI agents, automation, and operational intelligence platforms.
Implement AI-enabled capabilities for:
Incident correlation
Root cause analysis
Capacity forecasting
Operational insights
Risk identification
Automated remediation

Develop AI-powered operational assistants that improve engineering productivity and accelerate troubleshooting.
Partner with AI platform teams to operationalize emerging capabilities including foundation models, operational copilots, workflow orchestration, and intelligent automation.
Establish governance, controls, and guardrails for the responsible adoption of AI within operational processes.

Drive Reliability Engineering and Platform Resilience

Establish and mature Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices across AWS Federated.
Define service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, reliability scorecards, and resilience metrics.
Build platform reliability programs focused on prevention rather than reaction.
Lead resiliency engineering initiatives including:
Disaster recovery
Recovery automation
Chaos engineering
Failure testing
Cyber resiliency validation

Ensure operational readiness requirements are consistently incorporated into platform architecture and service enablement initiatives.

Define Next-Generation Observability and Operational Intelligence

Establish the strategic direction for observability across cloud, infrastructure, application, data, and security domains.
Create a unified operational intelligence framework that combines telemetry, operational events, security signals, and platform insights.
Drive adoption of modern observability capabilities including:
Distributed tracing
Metrics aggregation
Log analytics
AI-driven anomaly detection
Predictive analytics

Leverage machine learning and analytics to proactively identify capacity, performance, reliability, and operational risks.
Enable data-driven operational decision making through real-time dashboards and executive reporting.

Accelerate Automation and Platform Productivity

Establish Operations-as-Code and Automation-as-a-Product principles across the platform.
Lead initiatives to eliminate repetitive operational activities through automation and self-service capabilities.
Develop reusable automation frameworks that standardize platform operations and reduce operational complexity.
Drive adoption of event-driven automation and intelligent workflows.
Measure and improve operational efficiency through AI-assisted engineering, automation, and workflow optimization.

Strengthen Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk Management

Partner with Cyber Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to continuously improve platform security posture.
Drive operational governance for vulnerability remediation, patch strategy, cloud controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Implement automated compliance and continuous assurance capabilities wherever feasible.
Support cyber resilience and cyber-immunity initiatives through automation, monitoring, and operational controls.
Ensure cloud operational practices remain aligned with evolving enterprise security standards.

Provide Strategic Leadership During Critical Operational Events

Serve as the senior operational leader for AWS Federated during significant service-impacting events.
Provide strategic decision-making and executive communication during major incidents and platform disruptions.
Drive post-event learning, systemic improvement initiatives, and reliability investments.
Partner with engineering teams to ensure long-term corrective actions are implemented and measured.

Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing organization spanning reliability engineering, observability, operational intelligence, automation, and platform operations disciplines.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
Develop future leaders with expertise in cloud engineering, AI-enabled operations, resiliency engineering, and platform management.
Champion adoption of emerging technologies and modern engineering practices across the organization.

Bachelors degree
12+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering, reliability engineering, operations transformation, infrastructure engineering, or related disciplines.
5+ years of leadership experience managing large-scale technology organizations.
Deep expertise operating enterprise-scale AWS environments in regulated industries.
Proven experience establishing operational strategy for complex cloud platforms.
Strong knowledge of cloud architecture, networking, security, identity, automation, and service management disciplines.
Experience leading large-scale operational transformation initiatives.

Customer-centric mindset

Continuous learning mentality

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This is an opportunity to join Ascot Group - one of the world’s preeminent specialty risk underwriting organizations.

Designed as a modern-era company operating through an ecosystem of interconnected global operating platforms, we’re bound by a common mission and purpose. Our greatest strength is a talented team who flourish in a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture, steeped in underwriting excellence, integrity, and a passion to find a better way, The Ascot Way.

The Ascot Way guides our people and our organization. Our underwriting platforms collaborate to find creative ways to deploy our capital in a true cross-product and cross-platform approach. These platforms work as one, deploying our capital creatively through our Client Centric, Risk Centric and Technology Centric strategies

Built to be resilient, Ascot offers clients leading financial security while delivering bespoke products and world class service — both pre- and post-claims. Ascot exists to solve for our clients’ brightest tomorrow, through agility, collaboration, resilience, and discipline.

Ascot is embedding artificial intelligence (AI) and automation across the organisation to enhance decision‑making, efficiency, and quality of outcomes. In this role, you will be expected to work confidently alongside AI‑enabled tools, apply sound judgment when interpreting insights, and adapt as technology continues to evolve. We value curiosity, critical thinking, and a willingness to embrace change as part of how we work.

Job Summary

The Vice President, Infrastructure Operations & Services provides guidance and leadership to the Infrastructure DevOps and DBA team and will report into the Senior Vice President, Infrastructure Operations & Service. This role will manage a team of direct reports that are responsible for DevOps and Databases across the group, as well as working alongside peers to support the US Infrastructure Operation. The role will be a mixture of strategically focused infrastructure and team organization, as well as hands-on technical work. The role must have hands-on technical knowledge, with the ability to step into all areas of infrastructure and assist the team with escalations. A working knowledge of Azure Cloud Computing is essential. Secure by Design is an underlying principle at Ascot, so a solid understanding of the importance of IT security and the constant requirement to update and evolve protection is essential. As a senior member of the IT team, excellent communication skills are required, both with internal stakeholders and the wider business. Experience of writing both technical and business facing documentation would be a clear advantage.

The ideal candidate will lead by example by providing exceptional customer service and fostering a strong working relationship with internal IT teams and external service providers. They will manage the day-to-day activities and performance of the team. That should work to maintain strong working relationships with Departments ensuring clear communication of resource plans. As well as developing the team to enable them to reach their full potential. This role will be an in-office position with a hybrid schedule.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership for internally focused services and infrastructure.
Procedure Development: Develop, maintain, and document procedures.
Efficiency Optimization: Identify opportunities to drive greater efficiencies through automation and best practices.
Problem Investigation: Investigate problems in systems, processes, and services, and contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures.
ITIL Best Practices: Apply ITIL best practices and understand product lifecycles.
Technical Concept Explanation: Explain technical concepts and understand how to fit into the wider technical landscape.
Resource Management: Overcome resource shortages through resource management techniques, reallocation, and informing senior management of any issues.
Project Support: Provide support to project managers on resource management issues and processes.
Compliance: Ensure risk, compliance, and audit requirements are met across the IT organization.
Communication: Work with internal/external communications on IT, business, and industry messaging.
People Leadership: Provide daily operational and strategic leadership, coaching and performance management to a team of direct reports.
Commitment to The Ascot Way: Embody The Ascot Way in daily interactions, fostering colleague engagement, collaboration, inclusivity, and accountability

Requirements

Experience: 10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience.
Education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Global Teams: Demonstrated success managing global teams and strategic vendor partnerships.
Cloud Transformation: Experience with cloud transformation and modern Azure technologies.
Organizational Management: Demonstrated track record managing across the organization, both IT and Business.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Data-driven decision-making capabilities leveraging portfolio analytics.
Operational Efficiency: Expertise in improving IT operational efficiency and service delivery.
Communication Skills: Strong business acumen, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**This role can be filled at a different level, depending on experience.**

Compensation

Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to experience, subject matter expertise, and skills. The base pay is just one component of Ascot’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include an annual cash bonus and other forms of discretionary compensation awarded by the Company.

About GNC

Since 1935, GNC has been a global leader in health and wellness innovation, inspiring people to achieve their goals with a trusted and dynamic range of products. As #TeamGNC, we prioritize our consumers, constantly collaborating and developing new ideas to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Our team is passionate about driving change and turning aspirations into actions. We believe that good health is the greatest gift, and there's nothing more rewarding than helping others achieve it. Join us in empowering others to Live Well!

What We’re Looking For:

At GNC we embrace a “Live Well” philosophy, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation meets passion. Whether someone is an athlete or just starting to focus on their health, we want to deliver the cutting-edge products they deserve. We are looking for an individual who is excited and eager to play a pivotal role in driving excellence in the health and wellness industry. This position offers the opportunity to engage in a collaborative environment where you will make a personal impact every day.

The Senior Director and Head of Infrastructure & Technology Services owns the technology backbone that every function within GNC depends on: cloud, network, data center, end user computing, and hardware, together with the service management and help desk experience through which employees interact with technology every day.

Reporting directly to the EVP, Chief Digital & Technology Officer, this role carries end-to-end accountability for infrastructure reliability, security posture, and service quality across GNC. It sits at the intersection of infrastructure reliability and fueling GNC’s growth by modernizing how the organization runs technology, balancing the discipline of always-on operations with a forward-looking roadmap for cloud maturity, AI-ready technology stack, consumption models that scale, workplace technology, and service excellence.

This is a hands-on operating leadership role. The person in this seat is accountable not just for uptime and tickets closed, but for the day-to-day experience of every employee and customer-facing system that depends on GNC's technology environment, including stores, distribution centers, corporate offices, and digital platforms alike.

This role is ideally based in Pittsburgh, PA. Remote candidates located on the East Coast will also be considered, with the expectation of regular travel to GNC's headquarters in Pittsburgh for leadership meetings, team engagement, and key business initiatives.

What You’ll Do:

This is a Full-Time Salary Position

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture.
Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for GNC's cloud, network, and data center infrastructure. Ensure infrastructure decisions scale with the business, support GNC's broader technology stack, and are built for resilience, security, and cost efficiency.
Cloud & Network Operations.
Lead the teams responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, network engineering, and data center management, ensuring high availability across GNC's corporate, retail, and distribution environments.
AI-Ready Infrastructure & Scalable Platforms.
Build and evolve the infrastructure foundation required to fuel GNC’s AI ambitions, including secure, high-performance cloud platforms, scalable consumption models, and the compute, connectivity, and operational capabilities needed to move AI use cases from experimentation into reliable enterprise solutions.
End User Computing & Hardware.
Oversee the full lifecycle of end user computing and hardware, including procurement, deployment, refresh cycles, and support, across corporate offices, stores, and distribution centers, ensuring employees have reliable, well-managed technology.
IT Service Management & Help Desk.
Own the service management function and help desk/service desk operations, including incident, problem, and change management. Drive a service culture defined by responsiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement in employee and customer experience.
Reliability, Resilience & Security.
Ensure infrastructure and end user environments meet enterprise standards for uptime, disaster recovery, business continuity, and patch/vulnerability management, in close partnership with Security and Risk teams.
Vendor & Cost Management.
Manage infrastructure, hardware, telecom, and cloud vendor relationships and spend, driving transparency and value in technology investment decisions in partnership with Finance.
Executive Partnership & Governance.
Act as a trusted advisor to the CDTO and senior technology and business leaders, translating infrastructure performance, risk, and investment needs into clear executive-ready updates and decisions.
Team Leadership & Capability Building.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure and service management organization. Establish clear roles, career paths, and a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Infrastructure is stable, secure, and scales ahead of business need rather than reacting to it
Employees and stores experience fast, reliable technology support with minimal friction
Service management practices are mature, measurable, and consistently meet SLA commitments
Infrastructure and hardware spend is transparent, well-managed, and aligned to business priorities
The infrastructure organization is viewed as a trusted, responsive partner, not a bottleneck
GNC’s infrastructure is AI-ready, scalable, secure, and cost-efficient.

Environmental Factors & Working Schedule:

This position may be based in either:
Pittsburgh, PA in a hybrid work environment, with an expectation of 3-4 days per week in the office; or
on in the East Coast, working remotely with up to 50% travel to support store engagement, field testing, business reviews, leadership meetings, and visits to the Pittsburgh headquarters.
Regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands or fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear
Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.
Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include long periods of computer screen usage, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus
The noise level in the work environment is usually low/moderate

*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud operations, IT service management, or technology operations leadership roles
Demonstrated ownership of enterprise cloud (Azure preferred), network, data center, and end user computing environments
Proven experience building and running IT service management and help desk functions, including ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management practices
Experience supporting distributed environments, including retail stores, distribution centers, and corporate offices, strongly preferred
Strong track record managing infrastructure and vendor budgets, including cost optimization and contract negotiation
Exceptional executive presence, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Experience with Retail technology environments strongly preferred

Leadership Attributes

Operationally rigorous, with a strong bias for reliability and follow-through
Service-minded: treats every employee and store as a customer of the infrastructure organization
Calm under pressure; effective incident commander when things go wrong

Trusted partner to executives and hands-on coach to their team

The Vice President, Infrastructure Services leads the strategy, operating model, engineering, delivery, and operation of enterprise infrastructure and employee technology services. This executive is accountable for the reliability, scalability, resilience, and performance of cloud and on-premises platforms, connectivity, digital workplace and end-user services, business service availability, distribution center technology enablement, and responsive IT service management.

Develop and maintain a multi-year Infrastructure Services strategy and roadmap aligned with business growth, customer commitments, operational requirements, regulatory expectations, and enterprise technology priorities. 
Define and evolve the Infrastructure Services operating model, organizational structure, service ownership, and decision rights across cloud and platform engineering, network and communications, digital workplace and end-user services, site reliability engineering and operations, warehouse technology enablement, and infrastructure architecture, automation, and AI. 
Establish infrastructure investment priorities across platform modernization, lifecycle management, resiliency, technical debt, capacity, automation, and emerging capabilities; develop business cases and sequence investments based on business need, risk, service impact, and financial considerations.

Drive modernization of infrastructure platforms while reducing technical debt and improving lifecycle management, standardization, and operational efficiency. 
Establish governance for cloud consumption, capacity, performance, and cost optimization while ensuring infrastructure investments align with business requirements.

Direct Network and Communications services across corporate offices, distribution centers, cloud environments, and remote operations.

Establish network architecture, availability, capacity, performance, and lifecycle standards to support business continuity, operational growth, and high-availability requirements. 
Ensure clear ownership, escalation, and engineering accountability for network reliability and business-critical connectivity.

Establish enterprise standards and governance for end-user technology platforms, administrative services, endpoint engineering, and technology asset lifecycle management. 
Provide executive oversight of Service Desk and technology service management capabilities, including tiered support, executive support, request fulfillment, asset and knowledge management, service catalog capabilities, and continuous improvement of the employee technology experience. 
Establish strategy and governance for endpoint lifecycle and technology asset management, including device standards, provisioning, refresh planning, mobile devices, asset controls, licensing, vendor and leasing strategy, and secure disposition. 
Establish clear service ownership, service levels, operating standards, and accountability to provide consistent technology experiences across all supported business environments. 

Site Reliability Engineering, Service Management & Resilience:

Establish Site Reliability Engineering and operations practices for end-to-end business services, including monitoring and observability, incident and problem management, capacity management, service levels, operational readiness, backup validation, disaster recovery, and business continuity exercises. 
Establish the Infrastructure Services IT service management operating model and governance across incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, and service management. 
Define clear service ownership, escalation pathways, SLAs/OLAs, operating standards, and continuous improvement expectations across Infrastructure Services. 
Establish the enterprise infrastructure resilience strategy, including availability standards, recovery objectives, capacity and redundancy requirements, disaster recovery governance, and operational readiness for business-critical services. 
Ensure integrated service delivery and accountability across infrastructure engineering, Service Desk and End User Services, SRE, warehouse technology, Applications, Cybersecurity, and Operations. 
Provide executive leadership during major technology incidents and ensure effective escalation, communication, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and organizational learning.

Coordinate with Operations, application teams, technology leaders, and external vendors on conveyor and warehouse control system interfaces, PLC connectivity, facility upgrades, infrastructure dependencies, and peak-season readiness. 
Establish appropriate ownership and escalation models between frontline support, infrastructure engineering, operational technology resources, and business operations. 
Ensure distribution center technology is des
igned and supported to meet business-critical availability, resilience, performance, and recovery requirements.

Set infrastructure architecture, engineering standards, reference designs, lifecycle plans, and target-state direction across Infrastructure Services. 
Establish architecture governance that promotes standardization, interoperability, scalability, security, resiliency, and effective lifecycle management. 
Reduce technical debt and expand reusable platforms, infrastructure as code, automation, orchestration, and self-service capabilities. 
Introduce practical AI-assisted support and infrastructure operations in partnership with the AI Center of Excellence and Cybersecurity, with appropriate governance, data protection, security, and human oversight. 
Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where adoption can materially improve infrastructure performance, service reliability, employee experience, scalability, or cost effectiveness. 

Cybersecurity, Risk & Governance:

Ensure alignment with enterprise requirements for identity and access controls, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, endpoint and administrative controls, technology asset governance, monitoring, change controls, and audit and regulatory requirements. 
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Procurement, application leaders, Operations, and other technology functions on shared standards, priorities, dependencies, and enterprise initiatives. 
Ensure infrastructure risks, control gaps, lifecycle exposures, and service vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, communicated, and appropriately mitigated. 

Financial, Vendor & Performance Management:

High-availability design, observability, incident and problem management, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

Starting Pay: $225k+

Overview Of Position

The Vice President of Technology Platforms and Enablement is an executive leader responsible for the planning, strategy, governance, enablement, and operational performance of ESSC’s application ecosystem and technology platforms. This role ensures that business, clinical, and enterprise platforms are stable, secure, scalable, and optimized to drive measurable improvements across service delivery, clinical operations, and associate productivity. The position leads application support, AI enablement, and business liaison functions, while partnering across IT leadership to advance integration, workflow improvement, and continuous value delivery. In all responsibilities, the position demonstrates a strong commitment to ESSC’s mission and values by supporting a high-quality, person-centered service environment.

Essential Functions

Defines and executes enterprise application and platform strategy aligned with ESSC priorities; establishes governance for lifecycle management, ownership, and platform standards; and oversees platform performance, reliability, service delivery, documentation, security, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manages the development of in-house created integration software including incorporating best practices around the re-use of those products.
Leads activities around the use of AI in applications, working in conjunction with IT Security and Compliance.
Provides guidance to IT teams that work directly with the user community.
Ensures that all transactional systems at ESSC are appropriately supported, staffed, and managed so that patches, upgrades, releases, and hot fixes are applied appropriately and on time.
Works with entities outside of ESSC that are involved in the application support process to ensure their work is consistent with ESSC standards and delivered on time and within budget.
Plays an active role in defining workflow or process improvements that transactional software can facilitate.
Develops and implements risk management and compliance strategies to ensure regulatory compliance, mitigate organizational risk, and uphold ethical standards.
Leads financial planning and resource governance for assigned enterprise applications and technology platforms, including budget oversight, vendor spend management, workforce and capacity planning, and investment recommendations within CIO-approved financial parameters.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited program, or equivalent years of experience, is required.
ITIL or similar framework certification is strongly preferred.

Experience

Minimum of 15 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years of leadership experience in healthcare and 10 years managing enterprise application portfolios.
Experience implementing AI at an institutional level, EMR and systems integration experience, and experience leading IT operations in a behavioral health environment are preferred.

Number Of Direct And Indirect Reports

Direct: 5
Indirect: 10-15

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

Strong knowledge of IT governance, platform strategy, enterprise application architecture, systems integration, data governance, application lifecycle management, and scalable platform operations.
Demonstrated ability to lead enterprise technology strategy, platform modernization, digital enablement, and technology adoption initiatives in alignment with organizational priorities.
Ability to establish governance frameworks, operating models, service standards, and performance metrics for enterprise technology platforms and application support functions.
Strong executive leadership skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, facilitate cross-functional decisions, and communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale change management, process improvement, and adoption efforts across diverse stakeholder groups.
Strong fiscal management skills, including budget planning, vendor cost oversight, resource allocation, and evaluation of technology investments.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and risk management principles as they relate to enterprise applications and technology platforms.
Ability to lead, develop, and coach high-performing teams; build leadership capability; and foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Strong vendor, contract, and partner management skills, including the ability to manage service-level expectations and hold external partners accountable for performance.
Ability to evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, and guide responsible adoption in partnership with security, compliance, clinical, and operational leaders.
Ability to obtain fingerprint clearance per ESSC and/or program requirements.
Ability to pass a post-offer medical examination.
Ability to travel locally; reliable transportation; valid California driver’s license; clean driving record; proper auto insurance; and vehicle registration. Appropriate vehicle for transportation of program participants if program requires.

new_jobs.title: VP, Information Technology Engineering
new_jobs.description:
About Bestow

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov .

About The Team

We are at an exciting inflection point. As we scale our platform and deepen our footprint across the enterprise, technology is no longer just a support function; t's a core driver of how we compete, operate, and grow. This role leads the full technology infrastructure, business technology, and IT strategy for a fast-growing SaaS company, and the person who succeeds here will think about every IT challenge as an engineering problem first. . Our entire infrastructure is cloud-based, our predominantly remote workforce operates on Macs, and our core collaboration stack includes Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and Claude. You'll inherit a solid foundation and a capable team of 8. Your job is to bring the executive leadership, process maturity, and strategic vision needed to evolve IT into a world-class function that grows alongside the business.

What You'll Do

Define and execute a multi-year IT strategy aligned to company growth objectives, with a focus on scalability, security, and operational excellence.
Own the strategy, administration, and optimization of enterprise business systems including CRM (Salesforce), telephony and contact center platforms, productivity suites, and other business-critical SaaS applications.
Partner with functional leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to ensure business systems support their workflows, reporting needs, and growth objectives.
Lead the evaluation and selection of a next-generation telephony and contact center platform, with a focus on AI-native capabilities, automation, and modern customer engagement workflows.
Oversee all enterprise IT infrastructure including cloud environments, networks, endpoints, and SaaS platforms, ensuring systems availability, performance, and reliability meet or exceed SLAs.
Implement and operationalize cybersecurity policies and standards set by the CISO, covering identity and access management, threat detection, incident response, and data protection.
Drive automation of routine IT tasks including ticket triage, provisioning, access management, and reporting, with the goal of eliminating manual overhead wherever possible.
Own AI cost governance including vendor relationship management, usage tracking, quota management, and reporting to budget owners across the organization.
Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing IT team of 8, fostering a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and collaboration.
Own the IT budget, driving cost efficiency without sacrificing quality or reliability. Manage strategic vendor relationships and negotiate contracts to maximize value.

Who You Are

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, with at least 2 years in a VP-level or equivalent executive role at a SaaS or technology company.
Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), enterprise security frameworks, and modern ITSM practices in a cloud-native, predominantly remote, Mac-endpoint environment.
Experience owning enterprise business systems (CRM, telephony, ERP) and partnering with business stakeholders on system strategy and optimization.
Hands-on, daily experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and a strong point of view on how AI should transform IT operations.
Knowledge of the iPaaS and integration platform landscape (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, n8n, Zapier, Make) and when to use each. First-hand experience building on at least one platform, not just evaluating vendors. You can speak to the trade-offs between orchestration platforms and custom code.
Experience architecting or operating a data layer (ITSM, data lake, or analytics infrastructure) and a clear point of view on how ITSM, iPaaS, and data infrastructure work together as the core enablers of IT operations.
Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and inspire cross-functional technology teams with strong executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strategic thinker who balances long-term vision with short-term execution, is comfortable operating in ambiguity, and sees routine manual work as a problem to be solved — not accepted.

TOTAL REWARDS

Benefits

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits for full-time employees include:

Competitive salary and equity based on role
Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs
100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance
Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing
Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote
Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting
Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards Include

Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

Overview

Frontdoor is reimagining how homeowners maintain and repair their most valuable asset – their home. As the parent company of two leading brands, we bring over 50 years of experience in providing our members with comprehensive options to protect their homes from costly and unexpected breakdowns through our extensive network of pre-qualified professional contractors. American Home Shield, the category leader in home service plans with approximately two million members, gives homeowners budget protection and convenience, covering up to 23 essential home systems and appliances. Frontdoor is a cutting edge, one-stop app for home repair and maintenance. Enabled by our Streem technology, the app empowers homeowners by connecting them in real time through video chat with pre-qualified experts to diagnose and solve their problems. The Frontdoor app also offers homeowners a range of other benefits including DIY tips, discounts and more. For more information about American Home Shield and Frontdoor, please visit frontdoorhome.com .

Responsibilities

Summary
The Senior Manager, Cloud & Platform Engineering leads teams responsible for designing, building, and operating cloud infrastructure and internal platforms that power mission‑critical services at scale. This role is accountable for cloud foundations, platform reliability and resiliency, automation, and recoverability by design, while ensuring a strong partnership with other cross-functional teams to deliver results.

This is a technical leadership role requiring deep experience in cloud and platform engineering, combined with strong people leadership, execution discipline, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable engineering solutions.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop Cloud Engineers and Platform Engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Own the technical vision and roadmap for cloud foundations and internal platforms.
Establish cloud standards, architectural patterns, and governance frameworks across the organization.
Define and evolve AWS infrastructure – networking, compute, storage, IAM, security, and resiliency.
Ensure all cloud and platform services are reliable and resilient by design, not by operational heroics.
Drive adoption of multi‑AZ and multi‑region resilience patterns where required.
Plan and lead large infrastructure projects in collaboration with Engineering, Corporate IT, GRC, and Security teams, and partner with peer leaders across Product and Engineering to deliver end‑to‑end outcomes
Partner with Security and GRC teams to meet security standards, end-of-life and vulnerability remediations, audit and compliance (e.g., PCI, SOX controls), data protection and recovery expectations.
Champion automation‑first and infrastructure‑as‑code practices.
Manage cloud budgets, forecast usage, and drive cost optimization initiatives.
Recommend software improvements to achieve higher availability, scalability, and efficiency.
Manage on-call rotations and be on the escalation path of the on-call rotation to respond to incidents.
May include other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

Deep hands‑on knowledge of AWS at an architectural level.
Excellent problem solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Proven people‑management experience leading cloud or platform engineering teams.
Experience managing direct reports remotely.
Experience leading large‑scale cloud migrations or platform transformations.
Experience managing complex projects.
Proven experience building internal platforms or shared engineering services at scale.
Deep understanding of Linux environments, networking, and cloud architecture fundamentals.
Experience with DevOps/SRE methodologies & tools
Experience in performance engineering and capacity planning
Experience with software development and testing processes in an agile environment
Experience with Kubernetes, Helm-charts, Gitlab, Elasticsearch, Confluent Kafka.
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and drive results
Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across competing priorities.
Familiar with secure development processes across the full SDLC, including secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and CVE remediation.
Familiar with GRC review, PCI audit and SOC2 compliance processes.
Able to manage multiple priority projects at the same time.
Solid understanding of cloud and platform engineering, IaC, CI/CD pipelines, observability, reliability and resilience patterns.
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences (verbal and written).
Able to go deep technically when needed, while operating primarily at the systems and strategy level.
Demonstrated ability to use data to make informed decisions about priorities and measure the cost of problems and the impact of solutions.
Demonstrated ability to build solutions to automate monitoring systems to ensure the highest level of uptime for production systems.
Experience managing cloud costs, budgets, and optimization initiatives.

Preferred Skills:

AWS
Terraform
Confluent Kafka
GitLab
Kubernetes
Docker
Good working knowledge of Istio service mesh
Good working knowledge of Akamai
Understanding of Kubernetes and networking in a microservice architecture
Agile development certification

Physical Role Requirements
Be seated at a computer intermittently for up to eight hours a day. Move up to 10 pounds occasionally, by lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, or otherwise repositioning objects. Sitting for long periods of time while using office equipment such as computers and phones. Repetitive motions using hands and digits; such as movement of wrists, hands and fingers while picking, pinching and typing during your normal working environment.

Minimum Education, Licensure and Professional Certification requirements:
Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. AWS certifications are preferred

Minimum Experience required
(number of years necessary to perform role): 6+ years of experience required in platform, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps or SRE roles. 5+ years of people leadership experience managing engineering teams

Travel:
Up to 5%

Other/State Specific

This role pays between $ 165k to $ 205k , and your actual base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, responsibilities, experience, and location.

At Frontdoor certain roles are eligible for additional rewards and incentives. Speak directly to your recruiter to learn more.

new_jobs.description:

Job Description

Position Overview

Methods+Mastery is seeking a visionary, growth-minded Senior Vice President, Director of Performance Measurement & Infrastructure to join our leadership team. Reporting to Agency Executive Leadership, you will set the multi-year vision, go-to-market strategy, and overall roadmap for our agency's data, infrastructure, and AI capability suites. That vision includes hiring, developing, and mentoring a high-performing analytics team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, rigorous quality control, and intellectual curiosity.

In this role, you will lead the strategic expansion of our intelligence offerings, establish practice-wide data governance, and cultivate high-level relationships across Fortune 50 client stakeholders. You will lead, coach, and collaborate with a team of senior analysts and directors to architect solutions for agency-wide innovation across data engineering, modern machine learning models, autonomous agents, and enterprise measurement analytics.

Methods+Mastery is actively committed to increasing our team’s diversity, aggressively eliminating systemic barriers to equity, and fostering a culture where different backgrounds and perspectives are respected and celebrated. We strongly encourage applications from women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ+ community, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and neurodivergent people.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Client Leadership & Growth Strategy
Client Advisory & Growth: Serve as an executive sponsor and primary strategic advisor to Fortune 50 clients, guiding their long-term marketing technology, AI adoption, and data maturity strategies.
Business Strategy & Development: Drive practice growth by shaping new IP, packaging, and pricing intelligence products, and leading pitch strategies for major enterprise agency proposals.
Industry Thought Leadership: Represent Methods+Mastery as an industry authority on modern data architecture, AI governance, and social/marketing/communications intelligence trends.
Enterprise Architecture, Measurement & AI Innovation
Practice Vision & AI Strategy: Architect the overall vision for agency data capabilities, balancing traditional business intelligence workflows with next-generation machine learning and autonomous AI agents.
Scalable IP & Offerings: Guide the transformation of bespoke client solutions into proprietary, scalable, and automated agency products and offerings to meet our clients’ critical intelligence needs.
Measurement Deliverables and Consultation: Act as a client and project lead analyst to develop goals, KPIs, and measurement methodologies, and to deliver a variety of products, including performance reports, cultural/trend analyses, audience profiles, influencer assessments, and other intelligence to inform and drive business objectives and decision making.
Infrastructure Investment & Partnerships: Direct technical roadmap decisions, vendor alliances, cloud infrastructure investments, and data governance frameworks across the organization.
Organizational Leadership & Organizational Growth
Department Management: Co-lead and scale the multi-disciplinary Insights & Analytics organization, establishing career pathways and directly managing team members, including VP and Director-level leaders.
Executive Alignment: Partner seamlessly across Planning, Strategy, Content, Communications, Operations, and Account Management to ensure data infrastructure powers all agency disciplines.
Culture & Inclusion: Drive an inclusive, high-performing culture that prioritizes psychological safety, continuous learning, and equitable talent development.

Qualifications

Must-Haves:

Experience: 14+ years of experience leading data infrastructure, marketing analytics, or data engineering practices, with significant time spent in senior executive agency or management consulting roles.
Practice Leadership: Proven track record of growing a multi-million-dollar analytics practice, managing department P&Ls, and scoping large-scale enterprise project-level and annual agreements.
Executive Presence: Master-level ability to synthesize and present complex technological capabilities (AI, infrastructure, pipelines) into strategic business imperatives for C-level executives.
Domain Mastery: Deep familiarity with social listening infrastructure, consumer intelligence engines (e.g., Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Talkwalker), custom database builds, and modern data stack ecosystems.
People Leadership: Demonstrated success managing, scaling, and developing multi-tiered analytics and engineering teams (VPs, Directors, Managers).

Nice-to-Haves

Executive experience steering enterprise adoption of modern AI/ML frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, MLOps, Algorithmic Governance/XAI).
Expertise in enterprise cloud strategies (GCP, AWS, Azure) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Direct experience leading measurement and analytics technical evaluations, vendor partnerships, or co-development deals.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000-215,000.

Salary is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and geography. A range of medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, paid time off, and/or other benefits also are available.

Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Our objective is to increase this requirement over time, and many of our agencies as well as Omnicom’s corporate group already require five days of in-office attendance.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer
programs spanning the full care continuum
, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades,
Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview

The Senior Manager, QA Engineering is a Quality Engineering leader responsible for developing people, advancing engineering quality practices, and driving scalable quality capabilities across the organization. This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes of the QA Tools practice, including automation frameworks, CI/CD quality enablement, and quality insights, while leading and developing Quality Engineers supporting product teams.

Through strong technical leadership, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional partnership, this role helps build shared ownership of quality and enables teams to deliver reliable, high-quality experiences for our customers.

You are a strategic, proactive leader who creates clarity from ambiguity and takes ownership of outcomes. You understand technology deeply enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and guide experienced engineers without needing to be the person writing the code.

You build strong relationships and know how to garner buy-in without requiring consensus. You communicate the “why,” listen to different perspectives, make thoughtful trade-offs, and move teams toward clear decisions.

You are pragmatic and adaptable. You favor simple, scalable, and standardized solutions over unnecessary complexity while recognizing where innovation, including AI, can meaningfully improve how teams work.

Core Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop Quality Engineers, building an empowered and accountable team through clear expectations, feedback, recognition, career development, and performance management.
Own the QA Tools strategy, roadmap, and priorities in alignment with broader Quality Engineering and Engineering goals.
Drive the technical direction of Quality Engineering capabilities, including scalable automation frameworks, CI/CD quality practices, and quality gates...
Provide technical leadership across automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled engineering by setting direction, evaluating approaches, challenging assumptions, and guiding experienced technical engineers without being the primary hands-on implementer.
Evolve quality metrics and reporting to provide actionable insights, connect quality practices to key outcomes, identify risk, and enable data-driven decisions.
Build trusted relationships across Engineering, Product, and QA leadership; engage stakeholders early, communicate the “why,” and build buy-in for quality practices and organizational change.
Partner with QA leadership to define and evolve Quality Engineering standards, driving adoption and measurable outcomes across Engineering teams.
Develop a strong working understanding of the product, customer workflows, and team ownership to effectively lead team members, identify quality risks, and reinforce shared ownership of quality.
Translate organizational direction into clear priorities and trade-offs, independently managing execution, risks, dependencies, and change while favoring pragmatic, scalable solutions and adapting as needs evolve.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven track record of leading, developing, and empowering Quality Engineering or software engineering teams, including experienced technical contributors.
Strong foundation in modern Quality Engineering, including test automation best practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, and scalable testing approaches.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-team initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable outcomes.
Strategic and data-driven problem solver who can establish priorities, navigate ambiguity, evaluate outcomes, and adapt direction when needed.
Strong communicator and influencer who builds trusted relationships, explains complex concepts clearly, and creates buy-in across teams and levels.
Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated software environment is a plus.

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.

Employee Stock Purchase Program

new_jobs.title: Senior, Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM)
new_jobs.description:
TAE Power Solutions (TPS) is the electrification spin-off from TAE Technologies, a leader in nuclear fusion technology. The company is leveraging unique power management technology originally developed for nuclear fusion and applying it in adjacent industries including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and DC Fast Charging for electric vehicles.

About The Role

The main objective of this role is to identify technical gaps in engineering tasks to ensure scalable and predictable engineering execution. The Senior EDM owns the internal engineering execution architecture. This role turns high-level engineering objectives into a complete task breakdown with clear owners, dependencies, deliverables, and readiness criteria, ensuring there are no gaps or overlaps across disciplines. The role partners closely with PMO, which owns the integrated master schedule and external communications with customers and vendors, to ensure seamless execution of internal and external milestones.

Engineering Execution Architecture

Build and maintain the engineering work breakdown structure across systems, electrical, mechanical, controls, software, compliance, test, manufacturing readiness, and field readiness.
Define clear scope boundaries, handoffs, and ownership to prevent gaps and duplicated work across teams.
Create phase gate readiness criteria for key milestones such as requirements freeze, design freeze, build readiness FAT readiness, certification readiness, and release readiness.
Translate engineering changes into task level impacts and provide schedule and resourcing inputs to PMO for baseline updates.

Operating Cadence and Leadership Partnership

Work directly with the Director of Engineering on task planning and scope checks, and highlight critical path risks early.
Run a recurring engineering execution cadence including weekly progress reviews, dependency reviews, and risk issue decision tracking.
Drive cross functional alignment on deliverables, sequencing, and acceptance criteria.

Operational Processes and Continuous Improvement

Design and implement operational processes to track and quantify engineering outcomes and execution efficiency.
Establish a consistent operating system for engineering execution including WBS standards, JIRA structure, engineering RAID and decision logs, and milestone readiness reviews.
Use Six Sigma CTQ to support structured trade-off decisions (scope, schedule, cost, risk) and to reduce rework and variability in engineering outputs.
Define metrics, track trends, and lead continuous operational optimization with the Director of Engineering.

Tools and Reporting

Provide technical deliverable inputs and task breakdown at the level of detail required to manage dependencies and provide clean inputs to the PMO master schedule.
Build and maintain a JIRA structure that reflects the WBS and supports traceable execution, including EPICs, Stories, definitions of completed, and clear ownership.
Create concise technical executive readouts for progress, risks, decisions needed, and forecast to key milestones (with PMO)

Interfaces and Stakeholders

Director of Engineering
PMO team for integrated schedule governance and external milestone coordination
Engineering discipline leaders across hardware and software
Compliance and certifications
Quality and reliability
Supply chain and manufacturing engineering
Contract manufacturers and key vendors as needed for internal readiness planning

Manufacturing and Production Engineering:

Establish and enforce configuration control and ECN discipline.
Provide technical oversight of contract manufacturers to ensure build quality and process adherence.
Own unit level build, test, and quality readiness prior to release to execution teams.

Success Measures

No gaps or overlaps in scope across engineering workstreams and phase gates.
Improved predictability of execution, measured by engineering KPI and reduced critical path instability.
Higher closure rate and faster time to closure for critical risks and issues.
Improved planning quality, measured by estimate accuracy and reduced rework driven by missing tasks or unclear ownership.
Clean handoff of task level plans and change impacts to PMO with minimal rework.
Improved quality and execution consistency, measured through CTQ adoption, reduced variability, and reduced rework.

Required

Extensive interdisciplinary background in BESS development, validation, certification, and manufacturing.
7 years of direct experience with stationary BESS, power electronics, controls, and safety compliance programs.
Extensive experience leading execution planning for complex hardware and software products.
Demonstrated ability to build detailed work breakdown structures and dependency maps that stand up to robust audit and reduced execution surprises.
Advanced proficiency in MS Project and JIRA, including building structures that scale across teams and releases.
Extensive experience applying Six Sigma CTQ methods to drive engineering decisions, operational rigor, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to define CTQ, build measurable acceptance criteria, and use data to drive closure on cross-functional issues.
Strong executive communication skills, including clear status, risk framing, and decision requests.
Ability to influence without authority and drive closure across multiple functions.

Preferred

Experience with large-scale BESS system integration or EPC delivery for turnkey projects, including system engineering, multiple vendor scope coordination, and commissioning handoffs.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Material Flow Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

Anduril’s Supply Chain team is seeking a Senior Manager of Material Flow Engineering to join us. Working with a global network of suppliers, to support a global manufacturing platform takes people who are willing to work hard and find ways to win. You will create a strategic plan to optimize warehouse and material flow operations across our Columbus, OH facilities, create a standard set of metrics to monitor team performance, set goals for improving performance, and identify areas to reduce cost while maintaining quality. The right person for this role has extensive supply chain knowledge, has implemented or improved ERP/WMS, and has a track record of managing complex, high-value inventory. If you are someone who can operate autonomously to keep a material flow engineering and warehouse team motivated and enjoys process improvement, this may be the role for you.

What You'll Do

Design, develop and implement innovative material management strategies, policies, and procedures to optimize material flow and support production requirements for efficient movement of parts & materials using lean principles across multiple sites.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including procurement, production, logistics, and quality, to aid in accurate demand forecasting, procurement planning, and timely delivery of materials
Collaborate with production planning teams to align material availability with production schedules, minimize disruptions, and meet customer demand on time
Own the metrics, KPIs, and reporting associated with monitoring production line health and efficiency, such as cycle time, throughput rate, capacity, utilization, process non-conformities, and inventory accuracy. Analyze material usage trends, identify opportunities for process improvements, and implement lean practices to optimize material handling, storage, and distribution
Support and implement inventory control measures, including cycle counting, regular audits, and reconciliation, to ensure inventory accuracy and prevent stockouts or overstocking
Utilize ERP (Oracle) & WMS software (Odoo) systems and tools to track inventory, generate reports, and provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and optimize material-related processes
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, safety standards, and quality control protocols in all material management activities
Passionately work across multiple programs from development to full rate production to scale best-in-class solutions to align with maturity of manufacturing process
Proactively identify imbalances and bottlenecks caused by inventory processes, line layouts, parts shortages, staffing shortages, and other production constraints; flag constraints with the appropriate owners across Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality and drive to resolution
Develop processes to optimize workplans for highly variable demands across multiple sites.
Translate tools and reports into actionable tasks that impact the health of warehouse operations across a plethora of processes and sites.
Produce and maintain tools to increase accuracy of work demand for new facilities and maturing processes using a data-driven approach using tools such as Value Stream Mapping/ Process Mapping/ Line Balancing techniques
Identify and solve complex problems related to the movement of materials within a manufacturing environment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering or other technical field/supply chain management
10+ years of experience with 5+ years of people management experience in material flow engineering and management, inventory control, or supply chain management roles, preferably in a manufacturing or production environment
5+ years of experience in a high-rate supply chain or manufacturing environment, where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies are built with heavy data utilization
Ability to read technical documentation such as drawings and CAD data, understanding of a variety of hardware manufacturing processes for both electronics (PCBAs, sensor hardware, etc.) and structures, mechanical components, and electromechanical systems
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Columbus, OH

Preferred Qualifications

Strong knowledge of supply chain principles, inventory management techniques, and material planning strategies
Strong problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills are crucial for collaborating with different teams.
Experience with department or factory design and set up - value stream mapping, flow lines, continuous flow, one piece flow, workstation design
Ability to completely own a value chain from start to finish, measuring each step of the process, creating actionable tasks that culminated in a significant and sustainable business improvement
Demonstrated ability of presenting project results to a cross functional team with clearly relating data to proposed next steps
Prior experience with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production operations or Warehouse Management System (WMS)
Prior knowledge of NetSuite, Oracle or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system
Have direct experience scoping, buying off and commissioning warehouse automation.
Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles which drive manufacturing productivity
Experience in delivering successful project by being hands on with the process. Including gemba walks, operational analysis, poka yoke solutions among others to allow teams to be successful without massive CAPEX
Experience interacting with SQL databases - storage of information and building custom queries for tracking production and inventory-related metrics
Experience with using Siemens Plant Simulation or Process Simulation software to model a production line and run production scenarios
Experience with both commercial and federal inventory procedures, requirements, processes
Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

US Salary Range

$143,000—$191,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior, Engineering Delivery Manager (EDM)
new_jobs.description:
TAE Power Solutions (TPS) is the electrification spin-off from TAE Technologies, a leader in nuclear fusion technology. The company is leveraging unique power management technology originally developed for nuclear fusion and applying it in adjacent industries including Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and DC Fast Charging for electric vehicles.

About The Role

The main objective of this role is to identify technical gaps in engineering tasks to ensure scalable and predictable engineering execution. The Senior EDM owns the internal engineering execution architecture. This role turns high-level engineering objectives into a complete task breakdown with clear owners, dependencies, deliverables, and readiness criteria, ensuring there are no gaps or overlaps across disciplines. The role partners closely with PMO, which owns the integrated master schedule and external communications with customers and vendors, to ensure seamless execution of internal and external milestones.

Engineering Execution Architecture

Build and maintain the engineering work breakdown structure across systems, electrical, mechanical, controls, software, compliance, test, manufacturing readiness, and field readiness.
Define clear scope boundaries, handoffs, and ownership to prevent gaps and duplicated work across teams.
Create phase gate readiness criteria for key milestones such as requirements freeze, design freeze, build readiness FAT readiness, certification readiness, and release readiness.
Translate engineering changes into task level impacts and provide schedule and resourcing inputs to PMO for baseline updates.

Operating Cadence and Leadership Partnership

Work directly with the Director of Engineering on task planning and scope checks, and highlight critical path risks early.
Run a recurring engineering execution cadence including weekly progress reviews, dependency reviews, and risk issue decision tracking.
Drive cross functional alignment on deliverables, sequencing, and acceptance criteria.

Operational Processes and Continuous Improvement

Design and implement operational processes to track and quantify engineering outcomes and execution efficiency.
Establish a consistent operating system for engineering execution including WBS standards, JIRA structure, engineering RAID and decision logs, and milestone readiness reviews.
Use Six Sigma CTQ to support structured trade-off decisions (scope, schedule, cost, risk) and to reduce rework and variability in engineering outputs.
Define metrics, track trends, and lead continuous operational optimization with the Director of Engineering.

Tools and Reporting

Provide technical deliverable inputs and task breakdown at the level of detail required to manage dependencies and provide clean inputs to the PMO master schedule.
Build and maintain a JIRA structure that reflects the WBS and supports traceable execution, including EPICs, Stories, definitions of completed, and clear ownership.
Create concise technical executive readouts for progress, risks, decisions needed, and forecast to key milestones (with PMO)

Interfaces and Stakeholders

Director of Engineering
PMO team for integrated schedule governance and external milestone coordination
Engineering discipline leaders across hardware and software
Compliance and certifications
Quality and reliability
Supply chain and manufacturing engineering
Contract manufacturers and key vendors as needed for internal readiness planning

Manufacturing and Production Engineering:

Establish and enforce configuration control and ECN discipline.
Provide technical oversight of contract manufacturers to ensure build quality and process adherence.
Own unit level build, test, and quality readiness prior to release to execution teams.

Success Measures

No gaps or overlaps in scope across engineering workstreams and phase gates.
Improved predictability of execution, measured by engineering KPI and reduced critical path instability.
Higher closure rate and faster time to closure for critical risks and issues.
Improved planning quality, measured by estimate accuracy and reduced rework driven by missing tasks or unclear ownership.
Clean handoff of task level plans and change impacts to PMO with minimal rework.
Improved quality and execution consistency, measured through CTQ adoption, reduced variability, and reduced rework.

Required

Extensive interdisciplinary background in BESS development, validation, certification, and manufacturing.
7 years of direct experience with stationary BESS, power electronics, controls, and safety compliance programs.
Extensive experience leading execution planning for complex hardware and software products.
Demonstrated ability to build detailed work breakdown structures and dependency maps that stand up to robust audit and reduced execution surprises.
Advanced proficiency in MS Project and JIRA, including building structures that scale across teams and releases.
Extensive experience applying Six Sigma CTQ methods to drive engineering decisions, operational rigor, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to define CTQ, build measurable acceptance criteria, and use data to drive closure on cross-functional issues.
Strong executive communication skills, including clear status, risk framing, and decision requests.
Ability to influence without authority and drive closure across multiple functions.

Preferred

Experience with large-scale BESS system integration or EPC delivery for turnkey projects, including system engineering, multiple vendor scope coordination, and commissioning handoffs.

The compensation range for this role is between $165,000 - $195,000 + Benefits

Please Note - Preferred location:
Irvine, California. Remote candidates may be considered if they are out of the area
